## FILE: crm/templates/attendance.html
```html
{# attendance.html (v0.33) — Employee-facing Attendance page. APX
   Attendance v0.9 pilot, Build Order Step 2 (+ a Step 3 nav hook).

   v0.33 — Phase 1 of the 6-phase feature batch (app.py v0.43): the admin
   card's "Who's Present Today" button is removed — app.py's
   attendance_home() now redirects an admin session straight to
   settings_attendance_today() before this template ever renders for them,
   so the card below is a harmless fallback only, kept in case that
   redirect is ever reverted. "Settings & Attendance" button stays.

   v0.32 — Chunk C (app.py v0.37 / cls_db.py v2.46): this ENTIRE page's
   existing content (top "View My Calendar & Export" link, the "Today"
   badge/Punch In-Out/Weekoff-Leave card, the personal mini-calendar)
   is now wrapped in {% if current_user.role != 'admin' %} — admins
   don't punch, so none of it applies to them. An admin instead sees a
   small card linking to the new Who's-Present-Today view and Settings
   > Attendance. Checked as the LITERAL role=='admin' string, NOT via
   OVERSIGHT_ROLES/can_view_all_leads — manager is completely
   unaffected and still sees/uses this page exactly as before.

   v0.31 — Chunk B (app.py v0.36 / cls_db.py v2.45): the OLD separate
   "Weekoff / Leave" card (single-date-only forms posting to the now-
   PAUSED /attendance/weekoff and /attendance/leave routes) is REMOVED,
   along with the "Correction Request" card next to it (front-end only
   — attendance_correction_request()/the admin Corrections queue are
   untouched). Replaced by a single "Weekoff / Leave" button directly
   below Login/Logout above, opening an inline Weekoff-vs-Leave choice:
   Weekoff confirms today's date and POSTs (JSON, fetch) to the new
   /attendance/weekoff/submit; Leave opens a small vanilla-JS multi-
   select calendar (no library exists in this repo, built from scratch
   — past dates rendered visibly disabled, never just server-rejected)
   and POSTs the selected dates to /attendance/leave/submit. Both new
   endpoints return JSON {success, message}, shown inline via
   showWeekoffLeaveResult() — no page reload, unlike the old form-POST
   flow. The 2-column grid that held the two removed cards is gone too
   (it held nothing else).

   v0.30 — geofence-breach color backport: the mini-calendar's breach
   border is now ORANGE (#FF8C00, 2px), matching the Step 3 Dashboard
   exactly (was RED in Step 2's original build) — same fix in both the
   cell style and the legend swatch. No other change in this pass.

   Login/Logout have NO native camera code yet (a later build-order
   step) — both buttons feature-detect window.AndroidBridge and call
   .punchIn()/.punchOut() if present, else show a "use the mobile app"
   message. android_pilot's CURRENT AndroidBridge (v9) doesn't have
   these two methods either, so the fallback message is what shows
   even inside the native app's WebView today — expected, not a bug.

   Weekoff/Leave is fetch()+JSON as of v0.31 above (was a plain form
   POST through v0.30); Correction Request is gone from this page as of
   v0.31 too. The mini calendar below stays a personal, single-user
   view (unchanged from Step 2) — v0.29 just adds a link to the new
   Step 3 Dashboard (settings_attendance_dashboard(), force-scoped
   server-side to this user's own records; the route isn't
   @admin_required, but nothing linked to it for a non-admin before now). #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Attendance{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
{% if current_user.role == 'admin' %}
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin:0;">Attendance</h2>
</div>

<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <strong style="font-size:15px;">Admin</strong>
  <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:8px 0 12px;">
    Admins don't punch in/out — manage the team's attendance from here instead.
  </p>
  <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance') }}" class="btn">Settings &amp; Attendance</a>
  </div>
</div>
{% else %}
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin:0;">Attendance</h2>
  {# v0.29 — Build Order Step 3: this page's own admin_required-free
     dashboard route, force-scoped server-side to this user's own
     records (see app.py's _resolve_attendance_dashboard_scope()). #}
  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance_dashboard') }}" class="btn" style="font-size:13px; padding:6px 14px;">View My Calendar &amp; Export</a>
</div>

<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
  <strong style="font-size:15px;">Today — {{ today }}</strong>
  {% if today_status %}
    <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">
      Status:
      <span class="badge" style="background:
        {% if today_status.status == 'present' %}var(--green)
        {% elif today_status.status == 'late' %}var(--amber)
        {% elif today_status.status == 'absent' %}var(--red)
        {% elif today_status.status == 'leave' %}#7C5CBF
        {% else %}var(--ink-soft){% endif %};">{{ today_status.status or 'not marked' }}</span>
      {% if today_status.login_ts %}
        &middot; In: {{ today_status.login_ts|ampm }}
        {% if today_status.login_geofence_breach %}<span class="badge" style="background:var(--red); margin-left:4px;">Outside geofence</span>{% endif %}
      {% endif %}
      {% if today_status.logout_ts %}
        &middot; Out: {{ today_status.logout_ts|ampm }}
        {% if today_status.logout_geofence_breach %}<span class="badge" style="background:var(--red); margin-left:4px;">Outside geofence</span>{% endif %}
      {% endif %}
      {% if today_status.late_minutes %}
        &middot; {{ today_status.late_minutes }} min late
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% else %}
    <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">Not marked yet.</div>
  {% endif %}

  <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:14px;">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="punchIn()">Login</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="punchOut()">Logout</button>
  </div>
  <p id="punchFallback" style="display:none; font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:8px;">
    Login/Logout with photo verification is only available in the Asian Properties CRM mobile app.
  </p>

  <div style="margin-top:10px;">
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="toggleWeekoffLeaveChoice()">Weekoff / Leave</button>
  </div>

  <div id="weekoffLeaveChoice" style="display:none; margin-top:12px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);">
    <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="startWeekoff()">Weekoff</button>
      <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="startLeave()">Leave</button>
    </div>

    <div id="leaveCalendarPanel" style="display:none; margin-top:12px; max-width:320px;">
      <div id="leaveCalendarGrid"></div>
      <div id="leaveSelectedSummary" style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:8px;"></div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px; display:flex; gap:8px;">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="submitLeaveSelection()">Submit Leave</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="cancelLeaveSelection()">Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p id="weekoffLeaveResult" style="display:none; font-size:13px; margin-top:10px;"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="card">
  <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
    <a href="{{ url_for('attendance_home', year=prev_year, month=prev_month) }}" class="btn" style="padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">&larr;</a>
    <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ month_name }} {{ year }}</strong>
    <a href="{{ url_for('attendance_home', year=next_year, month=next_month) }}" class="btn" style="padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">&rarr;</a>
  </div>

  <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:14px; font-size:13px;">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        {% for wd in ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'] %}
        <th style="padding:6px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:600; font-size:12px;">{{ wd }}</th>
        {% endfor %}
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for week in weeks %}
      <tr>
        {% for day in week %}
        {% if day == 0 %}
        <td style="padding:6px;"></td>
        {% else %}
        {% set date_str = '%04d-%02d-%02d'|format(year, month, day) %}
        {% set row = month_data[date_str] if date_str in month_data else none %}
        <td style="padding:6px; text-align:center; border-radius:6px;
          {% if row and row.status == 'present' %}background:#E3F5E9;
          {% elif row and row.status == 'late' %}background:#FCEFD8;
          {% elif row and row.status == 'absent' %}background:#FBE3E3;
          {% elif row and row.status == 'weekoff' %}background:#EDEDED;
          {% elif row and row.status == 'leave' %}background:#E9E3F7;
          {% elif date_str in holidays %}background:#FDE9D9;
          {% endif %}
          {% if row and (row.login_geofence_breach or row.logout_geofence_breach) %}border:2px solid #FF8C00;{% endif %}">
          {{ day }}
          {% if date_str == today %}<div style="font-size:9px; color:var(--blue); font-weight:700;">TODAY</div>{% endif %}
        </td>
        {% endif %}
        {% endfor %}
      </tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div style="display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:12px; font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft);">
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#E3F5E9; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Present</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#FCEFD8; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Late</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#FBE3E3; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Absent</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#EDEDED; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Weekoff</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#E9E3F7; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Leave</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#FDE9D9; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Holiday</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; border:2px solid #FF8C00; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Geofence breach</span>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// v0.28 — same feature-detect pattern as settings.html v0.20's
// openDeviceSyncSettings(): calls the native bridge if present, else
// shows an inline fallback message. punchIn()/punchOut() don't exist
// on android_pilot's AndroidBridge yet (a later build-order step), so
// the fallback is expected everywhere today, including inside the app.
function punchIn() {
  if (window.AndroidBridge && typeof AndroidBridge.punchIn === 'function') {
    AndroidBridge.punchIn();
  } else {
    document.getElementById('punchFallback').style.display = 'block';
  }
}
function punchOut() {
  if (window.AndroidBridge && typeof AndroidBridge.punchOut === 'function') {
    AndroidBridge.punchOut();
  } else {
    document.getElementById('punchFallback').style.display = 'block';
  }
}

// ── v0.31 Chunk B: Weekoff/Leave button+modal (app.py v0.36 /       ──
// cls_db.py v2.45's two new JSON endpoints back this). No modal/date-
// picker library exists anywhere in this repo — everything below is
// plain vanilla JS/DOM, matching this codebase's existing style
// (inline confirm(), toggled display:none/block panels).
var leaveSelectedDates = new Set();
var leaveCalendarMonth = null; // Date, always the 1st of the displayed month

function toggleWeekoffLeaveChoice() {
  var panel = document.getElementById('weekoffLeaveChoice');
  var showing = panel.style.display !== 'none';
  panel.style.display = showing ? 'none' : 'block';
  document.getElementById('leaveCalendarPanel').style.display = 'none';
  hideWeekoffLeaveResult();
}

function showWeekoffLeaveResult(message, ok) {
  var p = document.getElementById('weekoffLeaveResult');
  p.textContent = message;
  p.style.color = ok ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)';
  p.style.display = 'block';
}
function hideWeekoffLeaveResult() {
  document.getElementById('weekoffLeaveResult').style.display = 'none';
}

// 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> 'DD-MM-YYYY', for confirm()/result messages only —
// every value sent to the server stays 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
function formatDDMMYYYY(dateStr) {
  var parts = dateStr.split('-');
  return parts[2] + '-' + parts[1] + '-' + parts[0];
}

function startWeekoff() {
  document.getElementById('leaveCalendarPanel').style.display = 'none';
  hideWeekoffLeaveResult();
  var todayStr = "{{ today }}";
  if (!confirm('Confirm Weekoff for today, ' + formatDDMMYYYY(todayStr) + '?')) return;
  fetch("{{ url_for('attendance_weekoff_submit') }}", {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
  })
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data) { showWeekoffLeaveResult(data.message, data.success); })
    .catch(function() { showWeekoffLeaveResult('Network error — please try again.', false); });
}

function startLeave() {
  hideWeekoffLeaveResult();
  leaveSelectedDates = new Set();
  var today = new Date();
  leaveCalendarMonth = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1);
  document.getElementById('leaveCalendarPanel').style.display = 'block';
  renderLeaveCalendar();
}

function cancelLeaveSelection() {
  document.getElementById('leaveCalendarPanel').style.display = 'none';
  leaveSelectedDates = new Set();
}

function toLeaveDateStr(y, m, d) {
  var mm = String(m + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  var dd = String(d).padStart(2, '0');
  return y + '-' + mm + '-' + dd;
}

// Renders the current leaveCalendarMonth as a 7-col grid. Past dates
// (< today, string-compared since both sides are 'YYYY-MM-DD') are
// rendered VISIBLY disabled (greyed out, no click handler) — never
// just silently rejected only on the server. Server-side validation
// in cls_db.submit_leave() ALSO re-checks this independently.
function renderLeaveCalendar() {
  var grid = document.getElementById('leaveCalendarGrid');
  var y = leaveCalendarMonth.getFullYear();
  var m = leaveCalendarMonth.getMonth();
  var monthNames = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July',
                     'August','September','October','November','December'];
  var todayStr = "{{ today }}";
  var realToday = new Date();
  var isCurrentMonth = (y === realToday.getFullYear() && m === realToday.getMonth());
  var firstDow = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay();
  var daysInMonth = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();

  var html = '';
  html += '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px;">';
  html += '<button type="button" class="btn" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="navLeaveMonth(-1)"' +
          (isCurrentMonth ? ' disabled' : '') + '>&lsaquo;</button>';
  html += '<strong style="font-size:14px;">' + monthNames[m] + ' ' + y + '</strong>';
  html += '<button type="button" class="btn" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="navLeaveMonth(1)">&rsaquo;</button>';
  html += '</div>';
  html += '<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:4px; font-size:11px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:4px;">';
  ['S','M','T','W','T','F','S'].forEach(function(d) { html += '<div>' + d + '</div>'; });
  html += '</div>';
  html += '<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:4px;">';
  for (var i = 0; i < firstDow; i++) { html += '<div></div>'; }
  for (var day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
    var dateStr = toLeaveDateStr(y, m, day);
    var isPast = dateStr < todayStr;
    var isSelected = leaveSelectedDates.has(dateStr);
    var cellStyle = 'padding:8px 0; text-align:center; border-radius:6px; font-size:13px; border:1px solid var(--line);';
    if (isPast) {
      cellStyle += 'color:var(--ink-soft); background:var(--paper); cursor:not-allowed; opacity:0.5;';
      html += '<div style="' + cellStyle + '">' + day + '</div>';
    } else {
      cellStyle += 'cursor:pointer;';
      cellStyle += isSelected
        ? 'background:var(--green); color:#fff; border-color:var(--green); font-weight:600;'
        : 'background:#fff;';
      html += '<div style="' + cellStyle + '" onclick="toggleLeaveDate(\'' + dateStr + '\')">' + day + '</div>';
    }
  }
  html += '</div>';
  grid.innerHTML = html;
  updateLeaveSelectedSummary();
}

function navLeaveMonth(delta) {
  var next = new Date(leaveCalendarMonth.getFullYear(), leaveCalendarMonth.getMonth() + delta, 1);
  var today = new Date();
  var floor = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1);
  leaveCalendarMonth = next < floor ? floor : next;
  renderLeaveCalendar();
}

function toggleLeaveDate(dateStr) {
  if (leaveSelectedDates.has(dateStr)) {
    leaveSelectedDates.delete(dateStr);
  } else {
    leaveSelectedDates.add(dateStr);
  }
  renderLeaveCalendar();
}

function updateLeaveSelectedSummary() {
  var el = document.getElementById('leaveSelectedSummary');
  if (leaveSelectedDates.size === 0) {
    el.textContent = 'No dates selected yet.';
    return;
  }
  var sorted = Array.from(leaveSelectedDates).sort();
  el.textContent = sorted.length + ' date(s) selected: ' + sorted.map(formatDDMMYYYY).join(', ');
}

function submitLeaveSelection() {
  if (leaveSelectedDates.size === 0) {
    showWeekoffLeaveResult('Select at least one date first.', false);
    return;
  }
  var sorted = Array.from(leaveSelectedDates).sort();
  var rangeText = sorted.length === 1
    ? formatDDMMYYYY(sorted[0])
    : formatDDMMYYYY(sorted[0]) + ' to ' + formatDDMMYYYY(sorted[sorted.length - 1]) + ' (' + sorted.length + ' day(s))';
  if (!confirm('Confirm Leave for ' + rangeText + '?')) return;

  fetch("{{ url_for('attendance_leave_submit') }}", {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({dates: sorted})
  })
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
      showWeekoffLeaveResult(data.message, data.success);
      if (data.success) {
        document.getElementById('leaveCalendarPanel').style.display = 'none';
        leaveSelectedDates = new Set();
      }
    })
    .catch(function() { showWeekoffLeaveResult('Network error — please try again.', false); });
}
</script>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/attendance_today_summary.html
```html
{# attendance_today_summary.html (v2) — Item 7: "Daily Achievements".
   Self-scoped only (route never passes a company_wide option). Reuses
   dashboard_today.html's .stat-card/.stat-card-grid classes verbatim
   — no new CSS.

   v2 — show_logout_button (bool, optional, default falsy): when True
   — set only by app.py's /logout route — an extra "Continue to
   logout" button renders at the bottom, linking to logout_confirm()
   (the route that actually clears the session). /attendance/today-
   summary itself never sets this flag, so that standalone route keeps
   rendering exactly as before, with no logout action on the page. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Today's Achievements{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0;">Today's Achievements</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Your own activity today. Resets at midnight.
</p>

{% if achievements %}
<div class="stat-card-grid">

  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Calls Made</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-ink">{{ achievements.calls_attempted }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Site Visits Scheduled</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-blue">{{ achievements.site_visits_created }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Site Visits Conducted</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-green">{{ achievements.site_visits_conducted }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Follow-ups Scheduled</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-blue">{{ achievements.follow_ups_created }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Follow-ups Completed</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-green">{{ achievements.follow_ups_completed }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Stage Changes</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-ink">{{ achievements.stage_changes }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  {% if achievements.time_worked %}
  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Time Worked Today</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-ink">{{ achievements.time_worked }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  {% endif %}

</div>
{% else %}
<p style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px;">No activity to show.</p>
{% endif %}

{% if show_logout_button %}
<div style="margin-top:24px;">
  <a href="{{ url_for('logout_confirm') }}" class="btn-pill-green" style="display:inline-block;">Continue to logout</a>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

```

```html
<!-- base.html v0.22 — NEW pull-to-refresh gesture, installed-PWA-mode replacement
     for the native browser gesture that standalone display mode suppresses.
     Touch-only (touchstart/touchmove/touchend), arms only when scrollY===0
     and no overlay (nav drawer / notif dropdown / fields popover) is open,
     72px threshold, full window.location.reload() on commit — no AJAX
     partial-refresh path, consistent with sw.js's existing "always fresh
     over cached" stance. New .ptr-indicator/.ptr-spinner CSS block and one
     new #ptrIndicator div right after <body>; new self-contained JS IIFE
     appended to the bottom <script> block, placed OUTSIDE the
     the "current_user" guard so it also works on login.html. No other
     existing behavior (drawer, notifications, sw registration) touched.
     v0.21 — INCIDENT FIX: bell dropdown rows were unclickable.
     renderNotifList() built each row's onclick="openNotification(...)"
     by string-concatenating JSON.stringify(n.cls_id) directly into a
     double-quoted HTML attribute — JSON.stringify() always double-quotes
     its output, the SAME quote character already closing onclick="...",
     so the attribute got truncated right after the first argument on
     EVERY row (cls_id is always a UUID string, so this wasn't an edge
     case, it fired every single time). Rows looked clickable (real
     <button>, cursor:pointer) but the handler never actually ran. Fixed
     by switching to data-notification-id/data-cls-id attributes (run
     through the same escapeHtml() already used for message/created_at)
     plus one delegated click listener on #notifList, instead of a fresh
     inline onclick per row. openNotification()'s own logic — POST
     /api/notifications/<id>/read, then navigate to /leads/<cls_id> — is
     UNCHANGED; only how each row's data reaches it changed. "Mark all
     read" (markAllNotificationsRead()) was never affected by this bug —
     it has no interpolated onclick data, which is also why it kept
     working while individual-row clicks silently didn't.
     v0.20 — INCIDENT FIX: the v0.19 bell button was visually
     colliding with the native Android app's floating btn_sync icon
     (android_pilot) — both landing in the same top-right corner. Root
     cause turned out NOT to be a CSS bug in this file: btn_sync is a
     native Android View drawn in a separate layer on top of the
     WebView, hand-positioned in activity_main.xml against this file's
     own header CSS — it broke the moment that CSS changed (this session
     replaced the empty 22px spacer btn_sync was calculated against with
     a real bell button). No amount of flexbox here could ever reach a
     native View in a different rendering layer, so the real fix is on
     the Android side: btn_sync is REMOVED from activity_main.xml
     entirely (see MainActivity.kt v15 / activity_main.xml's own
     changelog notes) and replaced with a same-looking "Sync Recordings"
     icon HERE, in this file's own header, wired to the existing
     AndroidBridge.syncRecordings() JS bridge method (MainActivity.kt
     v15) instead of a floating native button. Both header icons now sit
     in a shared `.header-icons` flex row (`display:flex; gap:12px`)
     rather than via absolute-position math, so they lay out side-by-
     side naturally and won't re-collide if either one's size changes
     later. The sync icon is feature-detected (`typeof AndroidBridge.
     syncRecordings === 'function'`) and hidden by default — it only
     appears inside the native app, never in a normal desktop browser.
     v0.19 — Notifications v1.0: header bell (icon + badge +
     dropdown), replacing the empty right-hand spacer in the appbar.
     Badge count comes server-side on first paint from
     inject_current_user()'s new unread_notification_count (app.py
     v0.56), then poll30s() (bottom <script> block) keeps it live via
     GET /api/notifications/unread-count without a page reload. Opening
     the dropdown fetches GET /api/notifications and renders the list;
     clicking an item POSTs /api/notifications/<id>/read then navigates
     to that lead. "Mark all read" POSTs /api/notifications/read-all.
     DEVIATION FROM THE BUILD BRIEF, flagged in app.py v0.56's own
     changelog: the brief said to place this "near the existing
     assignment-badge" — verified live and there wasn't one (unread_
     assignment_count was injected into context but never rendered
     anywhere in this file), so this is a new header element, not a

     v0.18 — Chunk B cosmetic: new SCOPED .btn-pill-green CSS
     class (green, oval/pill) applied ONLY to the logout link below —
     .btn/.btn-primary/.drawer-link defaults used everywhere else are

     Weekoff/Leave rebuild this same change lands alongside.

     employee /attendance page (app.py v0.28, APX Attendance v0.9 pilot,

     v0.16 — Settings drawer link un-admin-gated (see the

     v0.15: NEW shared filterOptRows(input) function (bottom <script>

     v0.14: REMOVED the standalone "Export" drawer link added in v0.13

     v0.13: NEW "Export" drawer link (between Reports and Settings),
       visible to every logged-in user (role-agnostic in this template,
       same as "Reports" — each export type scopes itself internally
       via cls_db.can_view_all_leads()). Task 4 of the APX v0.7 batch.
       SUPERSEDED by v0.14 above — kept here for history, not reverted.
     v0.12: NEW .stat-card / .stat-card-grid classes for the Sell.do-
       style 2-column card theme on all 3 dashboard tabs. .card and
       every other class untouched.
     v0.11: NEW impersonation banner (shown when inject_current_user()'s
       `impersonator` is set), sticky above the appbar via :has().
     v0.10: NEW "Reminders" drawer link (between Leads and Settings)
       with a pending-count badge, fed by inject_current_user()'s new
       pending_reminder_count. -->
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>{% block title %}Dashboard{% endblock %} · Asian Properties CRM</title>

<!-- PWA app-shell plumbing -->
<link rel="manifest" href="{{ url_for('static', filename='manifest.json') }}">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1F2A44">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Asian Properties">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
  :root{
    --navy: #1F2A44;
    --navy-light: #2B3A5C;
    --paper: #F7F8FA;
    --card: #FFFFFF;
    --line: #E3E6EC;
    --ink: #1B2430;
    --ink-soft: #5B6472;
    --blue: #2F80ED;
    --amber: #E08C2B;
    --green: #27AE60;
    --red: #D64545;
    --gray: #8A93A3;
  }
  *{ box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body{ height: 100%; }
  body{
    margin: 0;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    background: var(--paper);
    color: var(--ink);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  a{ color: var(--blue); text-decoration: none; }
  a:hover{ text-decoration: underline; }
  a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible{
    outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  header.appbar{
    background: var(--navy);
    color: #fff;
    padding: 14px 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  /* Admin "View as" banner (v0.11). Sticky above the appbar (higher
     z-index) whenever an admin is impersonating a salesperson/manager
     — see inject_current_user()'s `impersonator` context var. The
     :has() selector below demotes the appbar's OWN sticky pinning only
     while the banner is present, so the two stack cleanly instead of
     both trying to pin to top:0. Widely supported in evergreen
     browsers including mobile Safari 16.4+. */
  .impersonation-banner{
    background: #F5B301;
    color: #1B2430;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #C68600;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 15;
  }
  body:has(.impersonation-banner) header.appbar{ top: auto; }
  header.appbar .menu-btn{
    background: none; border: none; color: #fff; padding: 4px;
    cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center;
  }
  header.appbar .brand{
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    font-size: 19px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  header.appbar .brand-logo{
    height: 30px;
    width: auto;
    display: block;
  }

  .nav-scrim{
    display: none;
    position: fixed; inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    z-index: 19;
  }
  .nav-scrim.show{ display: block; }

  .nav-drawer{
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0;
    width: 260px;
    background: #fff;
    z-index: 20;
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    box-shadow: 2px 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  }
  .nav-drawer.open{ transform: translateX(0); }
  .drawer-user{
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 20px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .drawer-avatar{
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--navy); color: #fff;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .drawer-link{
    display: block; padding: 14px 20px;
    color: var(--ink); font-size: 15px;
  }
  .drawer-link:hover{ background: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; }
  .drawer-link.active{ background: #EAF0FC; color: var(--blue); font-weight: 600; border-right: 3px solid var(--blue); }
  .drawer-divider{ height: 1px; background: var(--line); margin: 8px 0; }
  .drawer-footer{ margin-top: auto; padding: 16px 20px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* Sell.do-style bottom action bar — used on lead detail, and now also
     the dashboard tab bar + leads-list icon bar (v0.8). CHANGED from
     `position: sticky` to `position: fixed`: sticky only starts
     pinning once its natural in-flow position scrolls into view — on
     a long leads list, that meant scrolling past every card before
     the bar appeared at all. Fixed pins it to the viewport bottom
     from the moment the page loads, exactly like the appbar header
     above (which achieves the same "always there" feel via
     sticky+top:0, since it's the FIRST thing on the page — this bar
     is the LAST thing, so sticky can't do the same job here; fixed
     is the correct tool for a bottom nav bar). main.wrap gets matching
     bottom padding below so content never sits underneath it. */
  .action-bar{
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 12;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    background: #fff;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 10px 6px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  }
  .action-btn{
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
    background: none; border: none; color: var(--navy);
    font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 8px; cursor: pointer;
  }
  .action-btn svg{ width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .action-btn.disabled{ color: var(--gray); cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.55; }

  .fields-popover{
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 6px);
    right: 0;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    padding: 12px 16px;
    z-index: 15;
    min-width: 160px;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
    max-height: 60vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .fields-popover.open{ display: block; }

  /* Pull-to-refresh indicator (v0.22). Installed/standalone PWA mode has
     no native pull-to-refresh (that's a browser-chrome feature, suppressed
     outside a browser tab), so this is a minimal custom replacement.
     Purely visual — actual refresh is a full page reload, matching this
     app's existing "always fresh over cached" philosophy (see sw.js). */
  .ptr-indicator{
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 60px;
    transform: translateY(-60px);
    transition: transform 0.15s ease;
    z-index: 25;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ptr-indicator.dragging{ transition: none; }
  .ptr-spinner{
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    border: 2.5px solid var(--line);
    border-top-color: var(--navy);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
  .ptr-spinner.spin{
    animation: ptr-spin 0.7s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes ptr-spin{
    to{ transform: rotate(360deg); }
  }

  main.wrap{
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    /* v0.8 — reserves space for the now-fixed .action-bar so the last
       card/button on any page isn't hidden underneath it. Only takes
       effect where a page actually includes an action-bar; harmless
       extra whitespace on pages that don't. */
    padding-bottom: calc(78px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  }

  .card{
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 18px 20px;
  }

  /* Sell.do-style stat tile (v0.12) — used on all 3 dashboard tabs.
     Separate from .card by design; .card is used app-wide and stays
     untouched. */
  .stat-card{
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.05;
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .stat-card:hover{ background: #FAFBFC; text-decoration: none; }
  .stat-card-header{
    background: #EDEEF3;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    text-align: center;
  }
  .stat-card-body{
    background: var(--card);
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 12px 10px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .stat-card-number{
    font-size: 40px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .stat-card-caption{
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    line-height: 1.35;
  }
  .stat-num-green{ color: var(--green); }
  .stat-num-red  { color: var(--red);   }
  .stat-num-amber{ color: var(--amber); }
  .stat-num-blue { color: var(--blue);  }
  .stat-num-ink  { color: var(--ink);   }
  .stat-num-gray { color: var(--gray);  }

  .stat-card-grid{
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .badge{
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    white-space: nowrap;
    background: var(--ink-soft); /* default so any unmapped stage name is still visible */
  }
  .stage-Incoming{ background: var(--gray); }
  .stage-Prospect{ background: var(--blue); }
  .stage-Opportunity{ background: var(--amber); }
  .stage-SiteVisited{ background: var(--green); }
  .stage-Booked{ background: #1E8449; }
  .stage-Lost, .stage-Unqualified{ background: var(--red); }
  .stage-ReAssigned{ background: #7E57C2; }
  .stage-other{ background: var(--ink-soft); }

  .btn{
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 9px 16px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: #fff;
    color: var(--ink);
    font-size: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .btn:hover{ text-decoration: none; border-color: var(--blue); }
  .btn-primary{ background: var(--navy); color: #fff; border-color: var(--navy); }
  .btn-primary:hover{ background: var(--navy-light); }

  /* v0.36 — Chunk B: scoped green pill style for ONLY the login submit
     button and the logout link (login.html / this file's nav drawer
     below). Deliberately its OWN class, not a change to .btn/
     .btn-primary/.drawer-link above/below — every other button and the
     rest of the nav drawer across the whole app keeps its current look
     untouched. */
  .btn-pill-green{
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 9px 22px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid var(--green);
    background: var(--green);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .btn-pill-green:hover{ background: #1E8449; border-color: #1E8449; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; }

  input[type="text"], input[type="email"], input[type="password"],
  input[type="tel"], input[type="date"], input[type="time"], select{
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 14px;
    background: #fff;
    color: var(--ink);
    height: 42px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
  }
  input[type="text"]:focus, input[type="email"]:focus, input[type="password"]:focus,
  input[type="tel"]:focus, input[type="date"]:focus, input[type="time"]:focus, select:focus{
    outline: none; border-color: var(--blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,128,237,0.15);
  }
  select{
    appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; -moz-appearance: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding-right: 34px;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='12' height='8' viewBox='0 0 12 8'><path d='M1 1l5 5 5-5' fill='none' stroke='%235B6472' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/></svg>");
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-position: right 12px center;
  }
  select:hover, input[type="text"]:hover, input[type="tel"]:hover{ border-color: #C3C9D2; }

  table.leads{ width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; }
  table.leads th{
    text-align: left; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft);
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  table.leads td{ padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: middle; }
  table.leads tr:hover td{ background: #FAFBFC; }

  .empty-state{ text-align: center; padding: 48px 20px; color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* Flash messages (v0.5 — success/error feedback after write actions) */
  .flash{
    padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .flash-success{ background: #E8F6EE; color: #1E8449; border: 1px solid #BEE6CE; }
  .flash-error{ background: #FBEAEA; color: var(--red); border: 1px solid #F3C9C9; }

  /* Simple write forms on the lead detail page (v0.5) */
  .write-form{ margin-top: 10px; }
  .write-form textarea{
    width: 100%; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-family: inherit;
    resize: vertical; min-height: 60px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .write-form input[type="datetime-local"]{
    padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .write-form-row{ display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 8px; }
  details.write-toggle{ margin-top: 10px; }
  details.write-toggle > summary{
    cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; color: var(--blue); font-weight: 600;
    list-style: none;
  }
  details.write-toggle > summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display: none; }

  .activity-item{
    padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 14px;
  }
  .activity-item:last-child{ border-bottom: none; }
  .activity-meta{ font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-top: 2px; }
  .temp-badge{
    display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; margin-left: 6px;
  }
  .temp-Hot{ background: #FBEAEA; color: var(--red); }
  .temp-Warm{ background: #FDF3E7; color: var(--amber); }

  .field-label{ font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .field-value{ font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 14px; }

  /* Dense lead cards (v0.3) — replaces the old one-field-per-line
     table-turned-cards. Packs several fields per line so more leads
     fit on screen without scrolling, closer to Sell.do's density. */
  .lead-card-list{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .lead-card{
    position: relative; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .lead-card:hover{ background: #FAFBFC; }
  .lead-card-stretch{ position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; border-radius: 8px; }
  .lead-card-head{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .lead-card-no{ font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 600; }
  .lead-card-name{ font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; flex: 1; min-width: 100px; }
  .lead-card-grid{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 16px; }
  .lc-field{ font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; }
  .lc-label{ color: var(--ink-soft); margin-right: 3px; }
  .lead-card-phone{ position: relative; z-index: 2; }

  /* Mobile: table becomes stacked cards */
  @media (max-width: 700px){
    main.wrap{ padding: 10px; padding-bottom: calc(78px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
    table.leads thead{ display: none; }
    table.leads, table.leads tbody, table.leads tr, table.leads td{ display: block; width: 100%; }
    table.leads tr{ background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 4px 0; }
    table.leads td{ border-bottom: none; padding: 5px 12px; }
    table.leads td[data-label]::before{
      content: attr(data-label);
      display: block;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 1px;
    }
  }

/* Header icon buttons (v0.19 bell, v0.20 native-app sync) — sit in a
   shared flex row so they lay out side-by-side naturally instead of via
   hand-tuned absolute-position math (see v0.20 changelog: that's exactly
   what broke last time). */
header.appbar .header-icons{
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
}
header.appbar .bell-btn, header.appbar .sync-btn{
  background: none; border: none; color: #fff; padding: 4px;
  cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; position: relative;
}
.bell-badge{
  position: absolute; top: -2px; right: -4px;
  background: var(--red); color: #fff;
  border-radius: 999px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
  min-width: 16px; height: 16px; line-height: 16px; text-align: center;
  padding: 0 3px;
}
.notif-dropdown{
  display: none;
  position: fixed; top: 56px; right: 12px; z-index: 50;
  width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 24px)); max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
}
.notif-dropdown.open{ display: block; }
.notif-dropdown-header{
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-weight: 600;
}
.notif-dropdown-header button{
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--blue);
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
}
.notif-item{
  display: block; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
  background: none; width: 100%; text-align: left; border-left: none; border-right: none; border-top: none;
}
.notif-item:last-child{ border-bottom: none; }
.notif-item.unread{ background: #EAF2FE; font-weight: 600; }
.notif-item .notif-time{
  display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-soft);
}
.notif-empty{ padding: 20px 14px; text-align: center; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 13px; }
</style>
{% block head %}{% endblock %}
</head>
<body>
<div class="ptr-indicator" id="ptrIndicator"><div class="ptr-spinner" id="ptrSpinner"></div></div>
{% if impersonator %}
<div class="impersonation-banner">
  ⚠️ Viewing as <strong>{{ current_user.full_name }}</strong>
  (real login: {{ impersonator.email }})
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('impersonate_exit') }}" style="display:inline; margin-left:12px;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn" style="padding:4px 14px; font-size:13px; background:#fff; border-color:#C68600;">
      Exit to admin
    </button>
  </form>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% if current_user %}
<header class="appbar">
  <button class="menu-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('navDrawer').classList.add('open'); document.getElementById('navScrim').classList.add('show');" aria-label="Open menu">
    <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/></svg>
  </button>
  <div class="brand">
    <!-- Logo goes here once provided — see note below.
         <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename='logo.png') }}" alt="Asian Properties" class="brand-logo"> -->
    Asian Properties CRM
  </div>
  <div class="header-icons">
    <button id="syncBtn" class="sync-btn" onclick="triggerAndroidSync()" aria-label="Sync Recordings" style="display:none;">
      <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 1-15.3 6.4L3 15.5"/><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 1 15.3-6.4L21 8.5"/><path d="M3 21v-5.5h5.5"/><path d="M21 3v5.5h-5.5"/></svg>
    </button>
    <button class="bell-btn" onclick="toggleNotifDropdown()" aria-label="Notifications">
      <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 8a6 6 0 0 0-12 0c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"/><path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0"/></svg>
      <span id="notifBadge" class="bell-badge" style="{{ '' if unread_notification_count and unread_notification_count > 0 else 'display:none;' }}">{{ unread_notification_count }}</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</header>

<div id="notifDropdown" class="notif-dropdown">
  <div class="notif-dropdown-header">
    <span>Notifications</span>
    <button onclick="markAllNotificationsRead()">Mark all read</button>
  </div>
  <div id="notifList"><div class="notif-empty">Loading…</div></div>
</div>

<div id="navScrim" class="nav-scrim" onclick="document.getElementById('navDrawer').classList.remove('open'); this.classList.remove('show');"></div>

<nav id="navDrawer" class="nav-drawer">
  <div class="drawer-user">
    <div class="drawer-avatar">{{ current_user.full_name[:2]|upper if current_user.full_name else 'U' }}</div>
    <div>
      <div style="font-weight:600;">{{ current_user.full_name }}</div>
      <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft);">{{ current_user.email }} · {{ current_user.role }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  {% if current_user.role == 'manager' %}
  {# v0.41 — manager view-mode toggle: flips the default scope of this
     login's own leads/dashboard views between company-wide and
     own-leads-only (cls_db.py v2.50's effective_company_wide()). Posts
     to toggle_view_mode(), which redirects back to whatever page this
     was clicked from. Does not affect write access or report access —
     see app.py v0.41's changelog. #}
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('toggle_view_mode') }}" style="padding:0 20px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
    <button type="submit" style="width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink); font-size:13px; cursor:pointer;">
      <span>View: <strong>{{ 'Team-wide' if (current_user.view_mode or 'manager') == 'manager' else 'My leads only' }}</strong></span>
      <span style="color:var(--blue); font-weight:600;">Switch</span>
    </button>
  </form>
  {% endif %}
  <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard') }}" class="drawer-link {{ 'active' if request.endpoint == 'dashboard' }}">Dashboard</a>
  <a href="{{ url_for('leads_list') }}" class="drawer-link {{ 'active' if request.endpoint in ['leads_list', 'lead_detail'] }}">Leads</a>
  <a href="{{ url_for('reminders_tomorrow') }}" class="drawer-link {{ 'active' if request.endpoint == 'reminders_tomorrow' }}">
    Reminders
    {% if pending_reminder_count and pending_reminder_count > 0 %}
    <span class="badge" style="background:var(--red); padding:1px 8px; font-size:11px; margin-left:4px;">{{ pending_reminder_count }}</span>
    {% endif %}
  </a>
  <a href="{{ url_for('attendance_home') }}" class="drawer-link {{ 'active' if request.endpoint == 'attendance_home' }}">Attendance</a>
  <a href="{{ url_for('reports_home') }}" class="drawer-link {{ 'active' if request.endpoint in ['reports_home', 'report_view'] }}">Reports</a>
  <!-- v0.16 — Settings link is no longer admin-only: /settings itself
       is now @login_required (app.py v0.26), and every logged-in user
       needs a way to actually NAVIGATE there to reach the new
       role-agnostic "Device Sync" section (settings.html v0.20) — a
       non-admin has nothing to see there but that one section, same as
       before for everything else, but they need to be able to find the
       page at all. Un-admin-gating this link is what makes that
       reachable via normal navigation instead of only a raw URL. -->
  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" class="drawer-link {{ 'active' if request.endpoint in ['settings_home', 'whatsapp_templates_admin', 'whatsapp_reminder_templates_admin'] }}">Settings</a>
  <div class="drawer-divider"></div>
  <a href="{{ url_for('logout') }}" class="btn-pill-green" style="margin:10px 20px; display:block;">Log out</a>
  <div class="drawer-footer">Asian Properties CRM{% if app_version %} · APX v{{ app_version }}{% endif %}</div>
</nav>
{% endif %}

<main class="wrap">
{% with messages = get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true) %}
  {% for category, message in messages %}
    <div class="flash flash-{{ category }}">{{ message }}</div>
  {% endfor %}
{% endwith %}
{% block content %}{% endblock %}
</main>

<script>
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').catch(function(err){
      console.log('Service worker registration failed:', err);
    });
  });
}

// Pull-to-refresh (v0.22). Touch-only, only arms when scrollY===0
// and no overlay (nav drawer / notif dropdown / fields popover) is
// open — see base.html CHANGELOG v0.22 for the full rationale.
(function(){
  var indicator = document.getElementById('ptrIndicator');
  var spinner = document.getElementById('ptrSpinner');
  var THRESHOLD = 72;
  var MAX_PULL = 90;
  var startY = null;
  var pulling = false;
  var committed = false;

  function overlayOpen(){
    var drawer = document.querySelector('.nav-drawer.open');
    var notif = document.getElementById('notifDropdown');
    var popover = document.querySelector('.fields-popover.open');
    return !!(drawer || (notif && notif.classList.contains('open')) || popover);
  }

  document.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
    if (window.scrollY !== 0 || overlayOpen() || e.touches.length !== 1) {
      startY = null;
      return;
    }
    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    pulling = false;
    committed = false;
  }, { passive: true });

  document.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
    if (startY === null || committed) return;
    var deltaY = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;
    if (deltaY <= 0) {
      startY = null;
      indicator.classList.remove('dragging');
      indicator.style.transform = 'translateY(-60px)';
      return;
    }
    if (window.scrollY !== 0) {
      startY = null;
      indicator.classList.remove('dragging');
      indicator.style.transform = 'translateY(-60px)';
      return;
    }
    pulling = true;
    e.preventDefault();
    var capped = Math.min(deltaY, MAX_PULL);
    indicator.classList.add('dragging');
    indicator.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (capped - 60) + 'px)';
    spinner.classList.toggle('spin', deltaY >= THRESHOLD);
  }, { passive: false });

  document.addEventListener('touchend', function(){
    if (!pulling || startY === null) {
      startY = null;
      pulling = false;
      return;
    }
    var pulledEnough = spinner.classList.contains('spin');
    indicator.classList.remove('dragging');
    if (pulledEnough) {
      committed = true;
      indicator.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
      spinner.classList.add('spin');
      window.location.reload();
    } else {
      indicator.style.transform = 'translateY(-60px)';
      spinner.classList.remove('spin');
    }
    startY = null;
    pulling = false;
  }, { passive: true });
})();

// v0.15 — shared checkbox/radio-list search filter (Export's Task B,
// now reused by Bulk Reassign too instead of a second copy). Filters
// visible .opt-row labels by textContent match, live, never touches
// checked/selected state. Scoped to the .opt-list immediately
// following whichever search box triggered it, so multiple search
// boxes on one page (Campaign, Project, Owner, ...) never cross-filter
// each other's lists. Pages using this: export_leads.html,
// export_site_visits.html, bulk_reassign_filter.html.
function filterOptRows(input){
  var term = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var list = input.nextElementSibling;
  if (!list) return;
  list.querySelectorAll('.opt-row').forEach(function(row){
    var text = row.textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    row.style.display = (!term || text.indexOf(term) !== -1) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

// Notifications v1.0 (v0.19) — header bell. Badge count polled every
// 30s; the dropdown's own list is only fetched on open (not on every
// poll tick), same "don't over-fetch" instinct as everything else in
// this file.
{% if current_user %}
function escapeHtml(s){
  var d = document.createElement('div');
  d.textContent = s == null ? '' : String(s);
  return d.innerHTML;
}

function updateNotifBadge(count){
  var badge = document.getElementById('notifBadge');
  if (!badge) return;
  if (count > 0){
    badge.textContent = count;
    badge.style.display = '';
  } else {
    badge.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function pollNotifUnreadCount(){
  fetch('/api/notifications/unread-count')
    .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data){ updateNotifBadge(data.count || 0); })
    .catch(function(){});
}
setInterval(pollNotifUnreadCount, 30000);

// v0.20 — "Sync Recordings" header icon, native-app only. Replaces the
// old floating native btn_sync (removed from android_pilot's
// activity_main.xml, MainActivity.kt v15) — that button's on-screen
// position was hand-calculated against this file's own header CSS and
// broke (visually collided with the new bell above) the moment this CSS
// changed. Triggering it from here instead means there's nothing left
// to collide with — it's a normal flex child in the same row as the
// bell, not a native overlay guessing at this page's layout.
// Same feature-detection convention already used for AndroidBridge.
// punchIn/punchOut (attendance.html) — silently stays hidden in a
// normal desktop/browser session, or on an older installed APK that
// predates syncRecordings().
if (window.AndroidBridge && typeof AndroidBridge.syncRecordings === 'function'){
  var syncBtn = document.getElementById('syncBtn');
  if (syncBtn) syncBtn.style.display = '';
}
function triggerAndroidSync(){
  if (window.AndroidBridge && typeof AndroidBridge.syncRecordings === 'function'){
    AndroidBridge.syncRecordings();
  }
}

function renderNotifList(notifications){
  var listEl = document.getElementById('notifList');
  if (!notifications || notifications.length === 0){
    listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="notif-empty">No notifications yet.</div>';
    return;
  }
  // v0.21 — data-* attributes instead of an inline onclick= built from
  // interpolated string data. The old version did
  // `onclick="openNotification(' + n.notification_id + ', ' +
  // JSON.stringify(n.cls_id) + ')"` — JSON.stringify() always wraps its
  // result in double quotes, the SAME character already closing the
  // onclick="..." HTML attribute, so the attribute got truncated right
  // after the first argument on every single row (every cls_id is a
  // UUID string, so this fired every time, not an edge case). Rows
  // LOOKED clickable (real <button>, cursor:pointer) but the handler
  // itself never actually ran. data-* values go through the same
  // escapeHtml() already used for message/created_at below, and the
  // delegated listener right after this function reads them back off
  // the element instead of re-embedding them in JS source text.
  listEl.innerHTML = notifications.map(function(n){
    var cls = n.read_at ? 'notif-item' : 'notif-item unread';
    return '<button type="button" class="' + cls + '" data-notification-id="' + n.notification_id +
      '" data-cls-id="' + escapeHtml(n.cls_id || '') + '">' +
      escapeHtml(n.message) +
      '<span class="notif-time">' + escapeHtml(n.created_at || '') + '</span></button>';
  }).join('');
}

// v0.21 — one delegated listener on the list container rather than a
// fresh inline onclick per row (see renderNotifList()'s comment above
// for why). notifList is a static element present at page load, so
// this only needs to be attached once. Reuses the SAME openNotification()
// mark-read-then-navigate logic that already existed — only how each
// row's data reaches it changed, not what happens on click.
document.getElementById('notifList').addEventListener('click', function(e){
  var item = e.target.closest('.notif-item');
  if (!item) return;
  openNotification(item.dataset.notificationId, item.dataset.clsId);
});

function toggleNotifDropdown(){
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('notifDropdown');
  var opening = !dropdown.classList.contains('open');
  dropdown.classList.toggle('open');
  if (opening){
    document.getElementById('notifList').innerHTML = '<div class="notif-empty">Loading…</div>';
    fetch('/api/notifications')
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data){ renderNotifList(data.notifications || []); })
      .catch(function(){
        document.getElementById('notifList').innerHTML = '<div class="notif-empty">Couldn\'t load notifications.</div>';
      });
  }
}

function openNotification(notificationId, clsId){
  fetch('/api/notifications/' + notificationId + '/read', {method: 'POST'})
    .then(function(){ pollNotifUnreadCount(); })
    .catch(function(){})
    .finally(function(){
      if (clsId){ window.location.href = '/leads/' + encodeURIComponent(clsId); }
    });
}

function markAllNotificationsRead(){
  fetch('/api/notifications/read-all', {method: 'POST'})
    .then(function(){
      pollNotifUnreadCount();
      var dropdown = document.getElementById('notifDropdown');
      if (dropdown.classList.contains('open')){
        fetch('/api/notifications')
          .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
          .then(function(data){ renderNotifList(data.notifications || []); });
      }
    })
    .catch(function(){});
}

// Click outside the bell/dropdown closes it.
document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('notifDropdown');
  var bellBtn = document.querySelector('.bell-btn');
  if (!dropdown || !dropdown.classList.contains('open')) return;
  if (dropdown.contains(e.target) || (bellBtn && bellBtn.contains(e.target))) return;
  dropdown.classList.remove('open');
});
{% endif %}
</script>
</body>
</html>

```


## FILE: crm/templates/bulk_reassign_filter.html
```html
{# bulk_reassign_filter.html (v1.1) — Settings > Bulk Reassign, step 1 of 3
   (filter form -> preview -> commit; see app.py's settings_bulk_reassign*
   routes, Task 3 of the APX v0.7 batch). Admin-only.

   Same accordion pattern/CSS classes as leads_filter.html (filter-
   accordion-item / opt-row / toggleFA), trimmed to just the 6 fields
   this feature offers: date range, campaign (checkbox multi-select),
   project, stage, source, current owner — plus the target owner picker,
   which is NOT a filter (it doesn't narrow the matched set) so it sits
   in its own section below the accordion, not inside it.

   Submits via GET straight to the preview screen — nothing is written
   by this form or the preview that follows; only "Confirm & Reassign"
   on the preview screen (a POST) actually changes anything.

   v1.1 (Bulk Reassign Filter UX Rework, matching Export's v1.1/v1.2):
   - CRITICAL: two distinct owner fields on this page, do not conflate.
     "Current Owner" below is the FILTER (which leads match) — now a
     checkbox multi-select, name="owners". "Reassign matched leads to",
     in its own card below the accordion, is the bulk action's
     DESTINATION — stays a single <select name="to_owner">, untouched.
   - Campaign (was already checkbox multi-select, name="campaigns") and
     Project (stays radio, single-select — not asked to change) both
     gained a plain-text search box above their list (Task 1).
   - Pipeline Stage changed from radio to checkbox (name="stages",
     was name="stage") — Task 2.
   - Current Owner (the FILTER, see above) changed from radio to
     checkbox (name="owners", was name="owner") — Task 2 — and also
     gained the search box, for consistency with how Export's Owner
     section works (not explicitly asked, matches the established
     pattern).
   - filterOptRows() is NOT defined here — it's the shared copy in
     base.html v0.15 (same function Export already used; Task 1 says
     reuse, not duplicate). #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Bulk Reassign{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style>
.filter-accordion-item {
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:10px;
  margin-top:10px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--card);
}
.filter-accordion-header {
  width:100%; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  background:transparent; border:none; padding:14px 16px;
  font-size:15px; font-weight:700; text-align:left; cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--ink); font-family:inherit;
}
.filter-accordion-header .fa-current { color:var(--blue); font-weight:400; font-size:13px; margin-left:6px; }
.filter-accordion-chevron { color:var(--ink-soft); transition:transform .15s ease; font-size:13px; }
.filter-accordion-item.open .filter-accordion-chevron { transform:rotate(180deg); }
.filter-accordion-body { display:none; padding:0 16px 16px 16px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.filter-accordion-item.open .filter-accordion-body { display:block; padding-top:12px; }
.opt-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 0; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; }
.opt-row input { cursor:pointer; }
.opt-search { width:100%; padding:7px 10px; margin-bottom:8px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; font-family:inherit; font-size:13px; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Settings</a>
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin:0;">Bulk Reassign</h2>
  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_bulk_jobs') }}" class="btn" style="font-size:13px;">Past Bulk Jobs</a>
</div>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:4px;">
  Filter down to a set of leads, then pick who they should move to. Nothing is changed here —
  the next screen shows exactly how many leads matched before anything is written.
</p>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('settings_bulk_reassign_preview') }}" id="bulkFilterForm">

  <div id="filterAccordion">

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.date_preset %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="date">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('date')">
        <span>Date Range{% if filters.date_preset %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ date_preset_labels.get(filters.date_preset, 'Custom') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <div class="field-label">Quick select</div>
        <select name="date_preset" id="datePresetSelect" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:10px;" onchange="onDatePresetChange(this)">
          <option value="" {% if not filters.date_preset %}selected{% endif %}>— Select —</option>
          {% for key in date_preset_order %}
          <option value="{{ key }}" {% if filters.date_preset == key %}selected{% endif %}>{{ date_preset_labels[key] }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>
        <div id="customDateFields" style="{% if filters.date_preset != 'custom' %}display:none;{% endif %}">
          <div class="field-label">From</div>
          <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:10px;">
          <div class="field-label">To</div>
          <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" style="width:100%;">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.campaigns %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="campaign">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('campaign')">
        <span>Campaign{% if filters.campaigns %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.campaigns|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% if campaign_options %}<input type="text" class="opt-search no-print" placeholder="Search campaigns…" oninput="filterOptRows(this)">{% endif %}
        <div class="opt-list">
          {% for c in campaign_options %}
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="campaigns" value="{{ c }}" {% if c in filters.campaigns %}checked{% endif %}> {{ c }}</label>
          {% endfor %}
          {% if not campaign_options %}<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">No campaign values recorded yet.</p>{% endif %}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.project %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="project">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('project')">
        <span>Project{% if filters.project %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.project }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <input type="text" class="opt-search no-print" placeholder="Search projects…" oninput="filterOptRows(this)">
        <div class="opt-list">
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="project" value="" {% if not filters.project %}checked{% endif %}> All projects</label>
          {% for p in projects %}
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="project" value="{{ p }}" {% if filters.project == p %}checked{% endif %}> {{ p }}</label>
          {% endfor %}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.stages %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="stage">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('stage')">
        <span>Pipeline Stage{% if filters.stages %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.stages|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% for s in stages %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="stages" value="{{ s }}" {% if s in filters.stages %}checked{% endif %}> {{ s }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.source %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="source">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('source')">
        <span>Source{% if filters.source %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.source }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="source" value="" {% if not filters.source %}checked{% endif %}> All sources</label>
        {% for s in source_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="source" value="{{ s }}" {% if filters.source == s %}checked{% endif %}> {{ s }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# FILTER by current owner — narrows which leads match. Distinct from
       "Reassign matched leads to" below, which is the bulk action's
       destination, not a filter — do not confuse the two. #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.owners %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="owner">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('owner')">
        <span>Current Owner{% if filters.owners %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.owners|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% if owner_options %}<input type="text" class="opt-search no-print" placeholder="Search owners…" oninput="filterOptRows(this)">{% endif %}
        <div class="opt-list">
          {% for o in owner_options %}
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="owners" value="{{ o }}" {% if o in filters.owners %}checked{% endif %}> {{ o }}</label>
          {% endfor %}
          {% if not owner_options %}<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">No owners recorded yet.</p>{% endif %}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  {# DESTINATION of the bulk action — "move all matched leads to ___".
     Single-select on purpose: you cannot reassign one batch to multiple
     different destination owners in one job. NOT a filter — sits
     outside the accordion above and stays a plain <select>. #}
  <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
    <div class="field-label">Reassign matched leads to</div>
    <select name="to_owner" required style="width:100%; padding:9px 10px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; font-family:inherit; font-size:14px;">
      <option value="">Select a target owner…</option>
      {% for u in target_owners %}
      <option value="{{ u.owner_match_name }}">{{ u.full_name }} ({{ u.owner_match_name }})</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
    {% if not target_owners %}
    <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:8px;">
      No users with a linked owner_match_name yet — link one under <a href="{{ url_for('settings_users') }}">Settings → Team</a> first.
    </p>
    {% endif %}
  </div>

  <div class="write-form-row" style="margin-top:20px; margin-bottom:24px;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Preview Matched Leads →</button>
  </div>
</form>

<script>
function toggleFA(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-accordion-item').forEach(function(item){
    if (item.dataset.fa === name) {
      item.classList.toggle('open');
    } else {
      item.classList.remove('open');
    }
  });
}
function onDatePresetChange(sel){
  var customBox = document.getElementById('customDateFields');
  if (sel.value === 'custom') {
    customBox.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  customBox.style.display = 'none';
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/bulk_reassign_preview.html
```html
{# bulk_reassign_preview.html (v1.1) — Settings > Bulk Reassign, step 2
   of 3. Nothing has been written yet — this just shows what WOULD
   happen (matched count + target owner) with one "Confirm & Reassign"
   button (POST -> settings_bulk_reassign_commit, the only step that
   actually writes, inside cls_db.bulk_reassign_leads()'s one
   transaction). The confirm form resubmits every filter param as a
   hidden field so the commit route re-derives the EXACT same matched
   set server-side rather than trusting a client-supplied list of ids.

   v1.1 — Stage and (filter-)Owner are now multi-select (Bulk Reassign
   Filter UX Rework): the single hidden `stage`/`owner` fields are
   replaced with per-value hidden `stages`/`owners` loops, same pattern
   already used for `campaigns`. `to_owner` (the DESTINATION, not a
   filter) is untouched — still one hidden field, still single-select. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Confirm Bulk Reassign{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_bulk_reassign', **filters) }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to filters</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px; margin-bottom:14px;">Confirm Bulk Reassign</h2>

<div class="card" style="background:#FBF6E9; border-color:#EAD9A0;">
  <p style="margin:0; font-size:15px;">
    <strong>{{ matched|length }} lead{{ '' if matched|length == 1 else 's' }}</strong> match{{ 's' if matched|length == 1 else '' }} these filters and will be reassigned to
    <strong>{{ to_owner }}</strong>.
  </p>
  <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:8px 0 0;">
    This changes lead_owner on every matched lead in one step and cannot be undone from here —
    review the list below before confirming.
  </p>
</div>

{% if matched %}
<div class="report-table-wrap" style="margin-top:14px; overflow-x:auto;">
  <table class="report-table" style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">#</th>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">Name</th>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">Stage</th>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">Current Owner</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for lead in matched %}
      <tr>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;">#{{ lead.crm_lead_no or '—' }}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;">{{ lead.full_name or '(no name)' }}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;">{{ lead.current_stage or '—' }}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;">{{ lead.lead_owner or '—' }}</td>
      </tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:14px;">
  <p>No leads match these filters — nothing to reassign.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

<form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_bulk_reassign_commit') }}" style="margin-top:20px; margin-bottom:24px;">
  <input type="hidden" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="date_preset" value="{{ filters.date_preset }}">
  {% for c in filters.campaigns %}<input type="hidden" name="campaigns" value="{{ c }}">{% endfor %}
  <input type="hidden" name="project" value="{{ filters.project }}">
  {% for s in filters.stages %}<input type="hidden" name="stages" value="{{ s }}">{% endfor %}
  <input type="hidden" name="source" value="{{ filters.source }}">
  {% for o in filters.owners %}<input type="hidden" name="owners" value="{{ o }}">{% endfor %}
  <input type="hidden" name="to_owner" value="{{ to_owner }}">
  <div class="write-form-row">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" {% if not matched %}disabled{% endif %}>Confirm &amp; Reassign</button>
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_bulk_reassign', **filters) }}" class="btn">Cancel</a>
  </div>
</form>
{% endblock %}

```

```html
{# dashboard.html (v0.16) — "Stats Overview" top-tab view, itself living

   reused — no new CSS). Link to new routes no_future_activity_list /

   v0.14 (2026-08-09) — Item 2: removed the "View all leads →" button

   v0.13 (2026-07-29) — the old plain <h2>Stats</h2> heading is replaced

   v0.11 — Stat tiles migrated from ad-hoc .card markup to the shared

   v0.10 — NEW "Tomorrow's Reminders" tile, placed after the existing

   v0.7 (July 2026, Srikanth's decisions 1+2):
   - New Enquiries card now links to /new-enquiries (new_enquiries_list

   - "Follow-ups Due" -> "MISSED FOLLOWUPS", "Site Visits Due" ->
```
