```html
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Dashboard{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
{% include "_dashboard_view_tabbar.html" %}

<div class="stat-card-grid" style="margin-top:16px;">

  <a href="{{ url_for('new_enquiries_list') }}" class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">New Enquiries</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-green">{{ new_enquiries_count }}</div>
      <div class="stat-card-caption">Untouched since arrival &middot; tap to view</div>
    </div>
  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('reengaged_list') }}" class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Reengaged</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-blue">{{ reengaged_count }}</div>
      <div class="stat-card-caption">Untouched since re-entry &middot; tap to view</div>
    </div>
  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('due_list', kind='follow_up') }}" class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">MISSED FOLLOWUPS</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-amber">{{ follow_up_due_count }}</div>
      <div class="stat-card-caption">Due today or overdue &middot; tap to view</div>
    </div>
  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('due_list', kind='site_visit') }}" class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">MISSED SITE VISITS</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-amber">{{ site_visit_due_count }}</div>
      <div class="stat-card-caption">Due today or overdue &middot; tap to view</div>
    </div>
  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('no_future_activity_list') }}" class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">No Future Activity</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-amber">{{ no_future_activity_count }}</div>
      <div class="stat-card-caption">No follow-up or visit scheduled &middot; tap to view</div>
    </div>
  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('missed_calls_list') }}" class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Missed Calls</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-amber">{{ missed_calls_count }}</div>
      <div class="stat-card-caption">Pending callback &middot; tap to view</div>
    </div>
  </a>

</div>

<a href="{{ url_for('reminders_tomorrow') }}" class="card" style="display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit; margin-top:14px;">
  <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
    <div>
      <div class="field-label">Tomorrow's Reminders</div>
      <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">Site visits scheduled for tomorrow &middot; tap to send WhatsApp reminders</div>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:34px; font-weight:700; color:var(--amber);">{{ pending_reminder_count }}</div>
  </div>
</a>

<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:18px; max-width:560px;">
  "Reengaged" counts existing contacts who came back in through Meta (matched
  by phone/email to a prior lead) and haven't had any activity logged since —
  it clears the moment someone touches the lead.
</p>

{% if current_user.role == 'admin' %}
<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;">
  <div class="field-label">Today's Attendance</div>
  <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:10px;">

      <td style="padding:5px 0; font-size:13px; border:none; text-align:right; color:var(--ink-soft);">
        {% if row.not_marked %}Not marked yet{% else %}{{ row.status.replace('_', ' ')|title }}{% endif %}
      </td>

    {% endfor %}
    {% if not today_attendance %}
    <tr><td colspan="2" style="padding:5px 0; font-size:13px; border:none; color:var(--ink-soft);">No active employees.</td></tr>
    {% endif %}
  </table>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% include "_dashboard_tabbar.html" %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{# dashboard_agenda.html (v1.1, 2026-08-16) — 4th top-level dashboard
   tab — "Today's Agenda". Was originally built nested inside
   dashboard_today.html (commit c33a36b, v0.9) — that was a structural
   mistake; this is the corrected standalone tab, same base pattern as
   dashboard_pipeline.html (extends base.html, includes
   _dashboard_tabbar.html at the bottom with active_tab="agenda").
   Content is the SAME two-column Site Visits / Followups block that
   was removed from dashboard_today.html — cls_db.get_todays_agenda()
   itself is unchanged, only its caller (app.py's dashboard_agenda()
   route) and this template are new.

   v1.1 (2026-08-16) — polish: "Site Visits"/"Followups" column
   headings switched from the small, muted .field-label class (meant
   for form-field captions, not section headings) to an inline
   font-weight:700/font-size:16px style — reads as a clear step up
   from the 13px body/caption text on this page, but stays well below
   the h2 "Today's Agenda" title's ~24px default size. Verified
   visually via the preview server, not just eyeballed. Inline style
   matches this template's existing convention (no new CSS class for a
   2-line change). {% if %}/{% for %} list-rendering logic, empty-state
   text, flex layout, and the _dashboard_tabbar include are all
   otherwise unchanged. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Today's Agenda{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0;">Today's Agenda</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Site visits and follow-ups scheduled for today.
</p>

<div style="display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:14px;">

  <div style="flex:1; min-width:240px;">

        <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">{{ v.scheduled_at }}</div>
      </a>
      {% endfor %}
    {% else %}

    {% endif %}

  <div style="flex:1; min-width:240px;">
    <div style="font-weight:700; font-size:16px; margin-bottom:4px;">Followups</div>

      {% endfor %}
    {% else %}

    {% endif %}
  </div>

</div>

{% include "_dashboard_tabbar.html" %}
{% endblock %}
```

## FILE: crm/templates/dashboard_booking_summary.html
```html
{# dashboard_booking_summary.html (v1, 2026-07-29) — "Leads to Booking
   Summary" top tab (see _dashboard_view_tabbar.html), reached via
   app.py's dashboard_booking_summary() route. READ-ONLY report page —
   no writes to leads/activity_log/site_visits/follow_ups anywhere here.

   Layout mirrors the two Sell.do mobile screenshots Srikanth attached:
   filter bar (Project / Source / Sales Person / Date range) -> 4 Quick
   Summary cards -> 3 sub-tabs (Leads / Site Visits / Bookings), each
   with several "label -> count" breakdown tables. Sub-tabs are a plain
   client-side JS show/hide (all 3 panels render server-side on one
   request; simplest option for a small-team app, no partial-fetch
   plumbing needed) — "Leads" shown first by default, matching the
   screenshots.

   Data definitions (all period-bound: date_from/date_to + Project/
   Source/Sales Person filters) live entirely in cls_db.py v2.31's new
   BOOKING SUMMARY functions — see that section's docstrings for the
   full reasoning behind each definition, especially:
     - "Value (INR)" ships as "—" (Decision 1, deferred — no booking_
       value column exists yet).
     - "Bookings" is an EVENT count (Decision 3) — stage_change ->
       Booked transitions in range, not a live current_stage='Booked'
       snapshot.
     - Site Visit status mapped to our 4-value enum (Decision 4) — no
       "Pending"/"Dropped" rows.
     - "Lead By Project"/"Lead By Source" (Decision 2 relabel — ours are
       single-value columns, not Sell.do's multi-select). #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Leads to Booking Summary{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style>
  .report-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 10px; }
  .report-table th, .report-table td {
    text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .report-table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .report-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--paper); }
  .report-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }

  .bks-filter-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .bks-filter-row select, .bks-filter-row input[type="date"] {
    height: 36px; font-size: 13px; padding: 4px 8px; flex: 1; min-width: 130px;
  }
  .bks-locked-field {
    height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--paper);
    border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; flex: 1; min-width: 130px;
  }

  .bks-subtabbar { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 20px; }
  .bks-subtab {
    flex: 1; text-align: center; padding: 9px 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;
  }
  .bks-subtab.active { color: #fff; background: var(--blue); border-color: var(--blue); }
  .bks-subpanel { display: none; }
  .bks-subpanel.active { display: block; }

  .bks-breakdown-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px;
    margin-top: 14px; background: var(--card);
  }
  .bks-breakdown-card h4 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 14px; }
  .bks-bar-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .bks-bar-track {
    flex: 1; max-width: 160px; height: 10px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--paper);
  }
  .bks-bar-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--blue); }
</style>

{% include "_dashboard_view_tabbar.html" %}

{# ── FILTER BAR ── #}
<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('dashboard_booking_summary') }}" id="bksFilterForm" style="margin-top:4px;">
  <div class="bks-filter-row">
    <select name="project" onchange="this.form.submit()">
      <option value="">All Projects</option>
      {% for p in project_options %}
      <option value="{{ p }}" {% if filters.project == p %}selected{% endif %}>{{ p }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    <select name="source" onchange="this.form.submit()">
      <option value="">All Sources</option>
      {% for s in source_options %}
      <option value="{{ s }}" {% if filters.source == s %}selected{% endif %}>{{ source_labels.get(s, s) }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    {% if company_wide %}
    <select name="owner" onchange="this.form.submit()">
      <option value="">All Sales People</option>
      {% for o in owner_options %}
      <option value="{{ o }}" {% if filters.owner == o %}selected{% endif %}>{{ o }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
    {% else %}
    <div class="bks-locked-field">{{ filters.owner or 'Your leads' }}</div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>

  <div class="bks-filter-row">
    <select name="preset" id="bksDatePresetSelect" onchange="onBksDatePresetChange(this)">
      {% for key in date_preset_order %}
      <option value="{{ key }}" {% if filters.date_preset == key %}selected{% endif %}>{{ date_preset_labels[key] }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="bks-filter-row" id="bksCustomDateFields" style="{% if filters.date_preset != 'custom' %}display:none;{% endif %}">
    <input type="date" name="from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" aria-label="From date">
    <input type="date" name="to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" aria-label="To date">
    <button type="submit" class="btn" style="flex:0 0 auto;">Apply</button>
  </div>
</form>

<p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:8px;">
  {% if filters.date_from and filters.date_to %}
  Created At: {{ filters.date_from }}, 12:00 AM to {{ filters.date_to }}, 11:59 PM
  {% else %}
  Created At: All time (no date filter)
  {% endif %}
</p>

{# ── QUICK SUMMARY CARDS ── #}
<h3 style="margin:18px 0 0;">Quick Summary</h3>
<div class="stat-card-grid">
  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Total Leads</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-ink">{{ totals.total_leads }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Site Visits</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-blue">{{ totals.site_visits }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Bookings</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-green">{{ totals.bookings }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Value (INR)</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-gray" title="Not tracked yet">&mdash;</div>
      <div class="stat-card-caption">Not tracked yet</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

{# ── SUB-TABS ── #}
<div class="bks-subtabbar no-print">
  <div class="bks-subtab active" data-bkspanel="leads" onclick="showBksPanel('leads')">Leads</div>
  <div class="bks-subtab" data-bkspanel="site_visits" onclick="showBksPanel('site_visits')">Site Visits</div>
  <div class="bks-subtab" data-bkspanel="bookings" onclick="showBksPanel('bookings')">Bookings</div>
</div>

{% macro breakdown_table(rows, col1='Category', col2='Count', label_map=None) %}
  {% set counts = rows|map(attribute='count')|list %}
  {% set max_c = counts|max if counts else 0 %}
  <div class="report-table-wrap">
  <table class="report-table">
    <thead><tr><th>{{ col1 }}</th><th>{{ col2 }}</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
    {% for row in rows %}
      <tr>
        <td>{{ label_map.get(row.label, row.label) if label_map else row.label }}</td>
        <td>
          <div class="bks-bar-wrap">
            <div class="bks-bar-track"><div class="bks-bar-fill" style="width:{{ ((row.count / max_c * 100) if max_c else 0)|round(0, 'floor')|int }}%;"></div></div>
            <span style="font-weight:700;">{{ row.count }}</span>
          </div>
        </td>
      </tr>
    {% else %}
      <tr><td colspan="2" style="color:var(--ink-soft);">No data for this range.</td></tr>
    {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
{% endmacro %}

{# ── LEADS PANEL ── #}
<div class="bks-subpanel active" data-bkspanel="leads">
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Lead By Sales</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(leads_by_owner, col1='Sales Person') }}
  </div>
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Lead By Stage</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(stage_counts, col1='Lead Stage') }}
  </div>
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Lead By Project</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(leads_by_project, col1='Project') }}
  </div>
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Lead By Source</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(leads_by_source, col1='Source', label_map=source_labels) }}
  </div>
</div>

{# ── SITE VISITS PANEL ── #}
<div class="bks-subpanel" data-bkspanel="site_visits">
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Site Visits By Owner</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(visits_by_owner, col1='Sales Person') }}
  </div>
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Site Visits By Status</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(visits_by_status, col1='Status') }}
  </div>
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Site Visits By Project</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(visits_by_project, col1='Project') }}
  </div>
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Site Visits By Source</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(visits_by_source, col1='Source', label_map=source_labels) }}
  </div>
</div>

{# ── BOOKINGS PANEL ── #}
<div class="bks-subpanel" data-bkspanel="bookings">
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Bookings By Owner</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(bookings_by_owner, col1='Sales Person') }}
  </div>
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Bookings By Project</h4>
    {{ breakdown_table(bookings_by_project, col1='Project') }}
  </div>
  <div class="bks-breakdown-card">
    <h4>Booked Leads</h4>
    <div class="report-table-wrap">
    <table class="report-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Lead #</th><th>Name</th><th>Owner</th><th>Project</th><th>Booked Date</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {% for lead in booked_leads %}
        <tr>
          <td>{{ lead.crm_lead_no or '—' }}</td>
          <td>{{ lead.full_name or '—' }}</td>
          <td>{{ lead.lead_owner or 'Unassigned' }}</td>
          <td>{{ lead.project or 'Not Available' }}</td>
          <td>{{ lead.booked_at }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% else %}
        <tr><td colspan="5" style="color:var(--ink-soft);">No bookings in this range.</td></tr>
        {% endfor %}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function onBksDatePresetChange(sel){
  var customBox = document.getElementById('bksCustomDateFields');
  if (sel.value === 'custom') {
    customBox.style.display = 'flex';
    return;
  }
  customBox.style.display = 'none';
  sel.form.submit();
}
function showBksPanel(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.bks-subpanel').forEach(function(p){
    p.classList.toggle('active', p.dataset.bkspanel === name);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.bks-subtab').forEach(function(t){
    t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.bkspanel === name);
  });
}
</script>

{% include "_dashboard_tabbar.html" %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/dashboard_pipeline.html
```html
{# dashboard_pipeline.html (v0.9) — "Pipeline Analysis" tab. Stage tiles
   are a LIVE snapshot of where leads sit right now, UNCHANGED by the date
   picker below — deliberately different from "Total Leads", labelled
   so the difference isn't hidden. See cls_db.
   get_stage_snapshot_counts()'s docstring for the reasoning.

   v0.9 (2026-08-11) — Phase 4 of the 6-phase feature batch: stage tiles
   are now clickable, each linking to leads_list filtered to that one
   stage via the existing "stages" list param (app.py's
   _parse_lead_filters()/leads_list() — no new param invented). Owner-
   scoping is whatever leads_list() already applies for the logged-in
   session (company-wide for admin/manager oversight, self-scoped for
   salesperson) — nothing extra passed here. This REVERSES the v0.8-and-
   earlier "non-pressable tiles only" decision above, confirmed with
   Srikanth. "Total Leads" stays non-clickable — it's a date-ranged
   aggregate across every stage, not a single filterable view, and Phase
   4's spec only calls out the per-stage tiles.

   v0.7 — Tiles migrated from ad-hoc .card markup to the shared
   .stat-card / .stat-card-grid classes (base.html v0.12). "Total
   Leads" keeps its blue emphasis border, now applied via an inline
   border-color/border-width override on the .stat-card element
   itself. Intro paragraph unchanged.

   v0.8 — NEW date-range picker for "Total Leads" ONLY (cls_db.
   get_leads_created_in_range(), app.py v0.27's dashboard_pipeline()
   route). Reuses app.py's own DATE_PRESETS/DATE_PRESET_ORDER/
   DATE_PRESET_LABELS dict — same convention leads_filter.html and
   settings_telephony_recordings.html's date picker already use (see
   _parse_recordings_filters()'s docstring) — and the same
   auto-submit-unless-Custom JS pattern those pages use. Default
   preset on first load (no query string) is "today", preserving the
   pre-v0.8 behavior. Stage tiles below remain UNCHANGED: still a live
   snapshot regardless of the picker's value; the intro note now says
   so explicitly. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Pipeline Analysis{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0;">Pipeline Analysis</h2>
<p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:640px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Date range applies to "Total Leads" only — every stage tile below it is
  always a live count of where leads stand right now, not a historical
  figure for the selected range.
</p>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('dashboard_pipeline') }}" id="pipelineDateForm"
      style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; align-items:flex-end; margin-top:10px;">
  <div>
    <div class="field-label">Total Leads date range</div>
    <select name="date_preset" id="pipelineDatePresetSelect" onchange="onPipelineDatePresetChange(this)"
            style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
      {% for key in date_preset_order %}
      <option value="{{ key }}" {% if filters.date_preset == key %}selected{% endif %}>{{ date_preset_labels[key] }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
  </div>
  <div id="customPipelineDateFields"
       style="display:{{ 'flex' if filters.date_preset == 'custom' else 'none' }}; gap:6px; align-items:flex-end;">
    <div>
      <div class="field-label">From</div>
      <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="field-label">To</div>
      <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
    </div>
  </div>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="height:34px; padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Apply</button>
</form>

<script>
function onPipelineDatePresetChange(sel){
  var customBox = document.getElementById('customPipelineDateFields');
  if (sel.value === 'custom') {
    customBox.style.display = 'flex';
    return;
  }
  customBox.style.display = 'none';
  sel.form.submit();
}
</script>

<div class="stat-card-grid" style="margin-top:16px;">

  <div class="stat-card" style="border-color: var(--blue); border-width: 2px;">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Total Leads</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-blue">{{ leads_total }}</div>
      <div class="stat-card-caption">New intake — {{ date_preset_labels[filters.date_preset] if filters.date_preset in date_preset_labels else 'All time' }}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  {% for stage in all_stages %}
  <a href="{{ url_for('leads_list', stages=stage) }}" class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">{{ stage }}</div>
    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-ink">{{ stage_counts[stage] }}</div>
    </div>
  </a>
  {% endfor %}

</div>

{% include "_dashboard_tabbar.html" %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/dashboard_today.html
```html
{# dashboard_today.html (v0.10) — "Today's Performance" tab. Deliberately
   no "talk time" tile — see the banner below and cls_db.get_todays_
   activity_counts()'s docstring for why.

   v0.10 (2026-08-16) — Task 3 Part B CORRECTION / REVERT: removes the
   "Today's Agenda" block added in v0.9 (commit c33a36b). That was a

   linking to lead_detail. Reuses the existing .card/.field-label
   classes (base.html) — no new CSS. Outro paragraph and
   _dashboard_tabbar include unchanged, just pushed down.
   SUPERSEDED BY v0.10 ABOVE — kept here for history only.

   v0.8 (2026-08-11) — Phase 4 of the 6-phase feature batch: all 5 tiles

{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Today's Performance{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0;">Today's Performance</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:-6px;">

    Company-wide totals for today across every salesperson.
  {% else %}
    Your own activity today. Resets at midnight.
  {% endif %}
</p>

<div class="stat-card-grid">

  <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard_today_drilldown', metric='calls_made') }}" class="stat-card">

      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-ink">{{ perf.calls_attempted }}</div>

      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-blue">{{ perf.site_visits_created }}</div>

  <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard_today_drilldown', metric='site_visits_conducted') }}" class="stat-card">

    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-green">{{ perf.site_visits_conducted }}</div>
    </div>
  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard_today_drilldown', metric='follow_ups_scheduled') }}" class="stat-card">
    <div class="stat-card-header">Follow-ups Scheduled</div>

      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-blue">{{ perf.follow_ups_created }}</div>

  <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard_today_drilldown', metric='follow_ups_completed') }}" class="stat-card">

    <div class="stat-card-body">
      <div class="stat-card-number stat-num-green">{{ perf.follow_ups_completed }}</div>
    </div>
  </a>

</div>

<p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:18px; max-width:560px;">
```

## FILE: crm/templates/dashboard_today_drilldown.html
```html
{# dashboard_today_drilldown.html (v1, 2026-08-11) — Phase 4 of the
   6-phase feature batch. Shared drill-down list behind all 5 Today's
   Performance tiles (app.py v0.45's dashboard_today_drilldown(),
   cls_db.py v2.52's per-tile actor-scoped fetch functions). Mirrors
   due_list.html's card-list markup/classes. `items` rows come straight
   from cls_db's _activity_rows_today() shape: cls_id, crm_lead_no,
   full_name, lead_owner, actor, created_at, description. lead_owner is
   only shown when it differs from who logged the action (actor), since
   for a salesperson's own self-scoped view the two are almost always
   the same person and showing both would just be noise. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}{{ label }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0;">
  {{ label }}
  <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:400; font-size:16px;">({{ items|length }})</span>
</h2>
<p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:-6px;">Today only.</p>

{% if items %}
<div class="lead-card-list">
  {% for item in items %}
  <a href="{{ url_for('lead_detail', cls_id=item.cls_id) }}" class="lead-card">
    <div class="lead-card-head">
      <span class="lead-card-no">#{{ item.crm_lead_no or '—' }}</span>
      <span class="lead-card-name">{{ item.full_name or '(no name)' }}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="lead-card-grid">
      <span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">When</span> {{ item.created_at|ampm }}</span>
      <span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">By</span> {{ item.actor }}</span>
      {% if item.lead_owner and item.lead_owner != item.actor %}
      <span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">Owner</span> {{ item.lead_owner }}</span>
      {% endif %}
      {% if item.description %}<span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">Notes</span> {{ item.description }}</span>{% endif %}
    </div>
  </a>
  {% endfor %}
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p><strong>Nothing here yet today.</strong></p>
</div>
{% endif %}

<div style="margin-top:24px;">
  <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard_today') }}" class="btn">← Back to Today's Performance</a>
</div>
{% endblock %}

```

## FILE: crm/templates/export_activity.html
```html
{# export_activity.html (v1.1) — Settings > Export > Export Activity
   History. Admin-only (v1.0 was role-agnostic — see app.py v0.18).
   No Task B/C changes — this screen has no Campaign/Project/Stage/
   Owner filter (just date range + an optional single cls_id), so
   neither task touches it; not adding fields that weren't asked for.

   v1.1: filter form (GET, -> settings_export_activity_results) and
   results now share this template via show_results (Task D — nothing
   renders before an explicit Apply, same as the other two export
   screens / Bulk Reassign's filter -> preview split). #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Export Activity History{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style media="print">
  .appbar, .nav-drawer, .nav-scrim, .no-print { display: none !important; }
  main.wrap { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  .report-table { font-size: 11px; }
</style>
<style>
  .report-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 14px; }
  .report-table th, .report-table td { text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .report-table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .report-table td:nth-child(5) { white-space: normal; min-width: 260px; }
  .report-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_home') }}" class="no-print" style="font-size:14px;">← Export</a>
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin:0;">Export Activity History</h2>
  {% if show_results %}
  <div class="no-print" style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0;">
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_activity_excel', **export_args) }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="window.print();">Print / Save as PDF</button>
    <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_export_activity_email') }}" style="display:inline;">
      {% for k, v in filters.items() %}{% if k not in ['campaigns', 'stages', 'owners'] %}<input type="hidden" name="{{ k }}" value="{{ v }}">{% endif %}{% endfor %}
      <input type="hidden" name="cls_id" value="{{ cls_id }}">
      <button type="submit" class="btn">Email to Me</button>
    </form>
  </div>
  {% endif %}
</div>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('settings_export_activity_results') }}" class="no-print card" style="margin-top:14px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; align-items:end;">
  <div>
    <div class="field-label">From</div>
    <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="field-label">To</div>
    <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="field-label">Single lead (cls_id, optional)</div>
    <input type="text" name="cls_id" value="{{ cls_id }}" placeholder="Leave blank for all leads" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
  </div>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="height:34px;">Apply</button>
  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_activity_view') }}" class="btn" style="height:34px; display:flex; align-items:center;">Clear</a>
</form>

{% if show_results %}
{% if report.rows %}
<div class="report-table-wrap">
  <table class="report-table">
    <thead><tr>{% for key, label in report.columns %}<th>{{ label }}</th>{% endfor %}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for row in report.rows %}
      <tr>{% for key, label in report.columns %}<td>{{ row.get(key, '—') if row.get(key, '—') is not none else '—' }}</td>{% endfor %}</tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:14px;">
  <p>No activity matches these filters.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```

```html
   Download Excel / Print / Email to Me button row.

   DEVIATION FROM export_activity.html: NO "Single lead (cls_id,
   optional)" field. cls_db.get_capi_events_export() (cls_db.py v2.78)
   takes only date_from/date_to — no cls_id param — so that field would
   silently filter nothing. Omitted rather than shipped non-functional;
   see app.py v0.61's changelog for the full note. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Export CAPI Events{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style media="print">
  .appbar, .nav-drawer, .nav-scrim, .no-print { display: none !important; }
  main.wrap { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  .report-table { font-size: 11px; }
</style>
<style>
  .report-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 14px; }
  .report-table th, .report-table td { text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .report-table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .report-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_home') }}" class="no-print" style="font-size:14px;">← Export</a>
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin:0;">Export CAPI Events</h2>
  {% if show_results %}
  <div class="no-print" style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0;">
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_capi_events_excel', **export_args) }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="window.print();">Print / Save as PDF</button>
    <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_export_capi_events_email') }}" style="display:inline;">
      {% for k, v in filters.items() %}{% if k not in ['campaigns', 'stages', 'owners'] %}<input type="hidden" name="{{ k }}" value="{{ v }}">{% endif %}{% endfor %}
      <button type="submit" class="btn">Email to Me</button>
    </form>
  </div>
  {% endif %}
</div>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">Every CAPI (Conversions API) event fired to Meta, with the lead's snapshot at the moment it fired.</p>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('settings_export_capi_events_results') }}" class="no-print card" style="margin-top:14px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; align-items:end;">
  <div>
    <div class="field-label">From</div>
    <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="field-label">To</div>
    <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
  </div>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="height:34px;">Apply</button>
  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_capi_events_view') }}" class="btn" style="height:34px; display:flex; align-items:center;">Clear</a>
</form>

{% if show_results %}
{% if report.rows %}
<div class="report-table-wrap">
  <table class="report-table">
    <thead><tr>{% for key, label in report.columns %}<th>{{ label }}</th>{% endfor %}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for row in report.rows %}
      <tr>{% for key, label in report.columns %}<td>{{ row.get(key, '—') if row.get(key, '—') is not none else '—' }}</td>{% endfor %}</tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:14px;">
  <p>No CAPI events match these filters.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```

```html
   role-agnostic in v1.0 — see app.py v0.18's changelog for the

   v1.2 (2026-09-01) — NEW "Export CAPI Events" tile, alongside Export

      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="26" height="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--green)" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M16 2v4"/><path d="M8 2v4"/><path d="M3 10h18"/><path d="M9 16l2 2 4-4"/></svg>
      <span style="font-weight:700; font-size:16px;">Export Site Visits Conducted</span>

  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_activity_view') }}" class="card" style="display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit;">
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="26" height="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
      <span style="font-weight:700; font-size:16px;">Export Activity History</span>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:10px 0 0;">
```

## FILE: crm/templates/export_leads.html
```html
{# export_leads.html (v1.2) — Settings > Export > Export Leads.

   v1.2 — filterOptRows() moved to base.html v0.15 (shared with
   bulk_reassign_filter.html's new search boxes instead of a second
   copy); local definition removed here, no other change.
   Admin-only (v1.0 was role-agnostic/self-scoped — see app.py v0.18).

   v1.1 changes (APX Export Rework batch):
   - Filter form (GET, action -> settings_export_leads_results) and
     results (table + Excel/PDF/Email actions) now share this ONE
     template via show_results: the _view route renders it with
     show_results=False and report=None (no query run, no row count —
     Task D); the _results route renders it with show_results=True and
     the computed report. Mirrors Bulk Reassign's filter -> preview
     split.
   - Campaign and Project sections gained a plain-text search box
     (Task B) — vanilla JS, filters visible .opt-row labels by
     textContent match, never touches checked/selected state.
   - Stage and Owner are now checkboxes (Task C, was radio/single-
     select) — matching values are OR'd server-side via cls_db.py
     v2.30's new stages=/owners= list params. Owner also gained the
     Task B search box (consistent with Campaign/Project, applied here
     regardless of list length rather than picking a length threshold).
   - Owner section no longer gated behind is_oversight — Export is
     admin-only now, there's no non-admin caller left to hide it from. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Export Leads{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style media="print">
  .appbar, .nav-drawer, .nav-scrim, .no-print { display: none !important; }
  main.wrap { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  .report-table { font-size: 11px; }
</style>
<style>
  .report-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 14px; }
  .report-table th, .report-table td {
    text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .report-table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .report-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
  .filter-accordion-item { border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; margin-top:10px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--card); }
  .filter-accordion-header { width:100%; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; background:transparent; border:none; padding:14px 16px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink); font-family:inherit; }
  .filter-accordion-header .fa-current { color:var(--blue); font-weight:400; font-size:13px; margin-left:6px; }
  .filter-accordion-chevron { color:var(--ink-soft); transition:transform .15s ease; font-size:13px; }
  .filter-accordion-item.open .filter-accordion-chevron { transform:rotate(180deg); }
  .filter-accordion-body { display:none; padding:0 16px 16px 16px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
  .filter-accordion-item.open .filter-accordion-body { display:block; padding-top:12px; }
  .opt-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 0; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; }
  .opt-search { width:100%; padding:7px 10px; margin-bottom:8px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; font-family:inherit; font-size:13px; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_home') }}" class="no-print" style="font-size:14px;">← Export</a>
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin:0;">Export Leads</h2>
  {% if show_results %}
  <div class="no-print" style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0;">
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_leads_excel', **filters) }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="window.print();">Print / Save as PDF</button>
    <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_export_leads_email') }}" style="display:inline;">
      {% for k, v in filters.items() %}{% if k not in ['campaigns', 'stages', 'owners'] %}<input type="hidden" name="{{ k }}" value="{{ v }}">{% endif %}{% endfor %}
      {% for c in filters.campaigns %}<input type="hidden" name="campaigns" value="{{ c }}">{% endfor %}
      {% for s in filters.stages %}<input type="hidden" name="stages" value="{{ s }}">{% endfor %}
      {% for o in filters.owners %}<input type="hidden" name="owners" value="{{ o }}">{% endfor %}
      <button type="submit" class="btn">Email to Me</button>
    </form>
  </div>
  {% endif %}
</div>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('settings_export_leads_results') }}" class="no-print" id="exportFilterForm">
  <div id="filterAccordion">
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.date_preset %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="date">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('date')">
        <span>Date Range{% if filters.date_preset %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ date_preset_labels.get(filters.date_preset, 'Custom') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <select name="date_preset" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:10px;" onchange="onDatePresetChange(this)">
          <option value="" {% if not filters.date_preset %}selected{% endif %}>— All time —</option>
          {% for key in date_preset_order %}
          <option value="{{ key }}" {% if filters.date_preset == key %}selected{% endif %}>{{ date_preset_labels[key] }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>
        <div id="customDateFields" style="{% if filters.date_preset != 'custom' %}display:none;{% endif %}">
          <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:10px;">
          <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" style="width:100%;">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.campaigns %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="campaign">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('campaign')">
        <span>Campaign{% if filters.campaigns %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.campaigns|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% if campaign_options %}<input type="text" class="opt-search no-print" placeholder="Search campaigns…" oninput="filterOptRows(this)">{% endif %}
        <div class="opt-list">
          {% for c in campaign_options %}
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="campaigns" value="{{ c }}" {% if c in filters.campaigns %}checked{% endif %}> {{ c }}</label>
          {% endfor %}
          {% if not campaign_options %}<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">No campaign values recorded yet.</p>{% endif %}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.project %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="project">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('project')">
        <span>Project{% if filters.project %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.project }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <input type="text" class="opt-search no-print" placeholder="Search projects…" oninput="filterOptRows(this)">
        <div class="opt-list">
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="project" value="" {% if not filters.project %}checked{% endif %}> All projects</label>
          {% for p in projects %}
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="project" value="{{ p }}" {% if filters.project == p %}checked{% endif %}> {{ p }}</label>
          {% endfor %}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.stages %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="stage">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('stage')">
        <span>Pipeline Stage{% if filters.stages %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.stages|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% for s in stages %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="stages" value="{{ s }}" {% if s in filters.stages %}checked{% endif %}> {{ s }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.source %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="source">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('source')">
        <span>Source{% if filters.source %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.source }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="source" value="" {% if not filters.source %}checked{% endif %}> All sources</label>
        {% for s in source_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="source" value="{{ s }}" {% if filters.source == s %}checked{% endif %}> {{ s }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.owners %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="owner">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('owner')">
        <span>Owner{% if filters.owners %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.owners|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% if owner_options %}<input type="text" class="opt-search no-print" placeholder="Search owners…" oninput="filterOptRows(this)">{% endif %}
        <div class="opt-list">
          {% for o in owner_options %}
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="owners" value="{{ o }}" {% if o in filters.owners %}checked{% endif %}> {{ o }}</label>
          {% endfor %}
          {% if not owner_options %}<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">No owners recorded yet.</p>{% endif %}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="write-form-row" style="margin-top:14px;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Apply Filters</button>
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_leads_view') }}" class="btn">Clear All</a>
  </div>
</form>

{% if show_results %}
{% if report.rows %}
<div class="report-table-wrap">
  <table class="report-table">
    <thead><tr>{% for key, label in report.columns %}<th>{{ label }}</th>{% endfor %}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for row in report.rows %}
      <tr>{% for key, label in report.columns %}<td>{{ row.get(key, '—') if row.get(key, '—') is not none else '—' }}</td>{% endfor %}</tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:14px;">
  <p>No leads match these filters.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endif %}

<script>
function toggleFA(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-accordion-item').forEach(function(item){
    if (item.dataset.fa === name) { item.classList.toggle('open'); } else { item.classList.remove('open'); }
  });
}
function onDatePresetChange(sel){
  var customBox = document.getElementById('customDateFields');
  customBox.style.display = (sel.value === 'custom') ? 'block' : 'none';
}
// filterOptRows() (Task B's search-box filter) moved to base.html
// v0.15 — shared with bulk_reassign_filter.html, no longer duplicated
// here.
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/export_site_visits.html
```html
{# export_site_visits.html (v1.2) — Settings > Export > Export Site
   Visits Conducted. Admin-only (v1.0 was role-agnostic — see app.py
   v0.18). Same filter-accordion + print/table pattern as

{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Export Site Visits Conducted{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style media="print">
  .appbar, .nav-drawer, .nav-scrim, .no-print { display: none !important; }
  main.wrap { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  .report-table { font-size: 11px; }
</style>
<style>
  .report-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 14px; }
  .report-table th, .report-table td { text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .report-table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .report-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
  .filter-accordion-item { border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; margin-top:10px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--card); }
  .filter-accordion-header { width:100%; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; background:transparent; border:none; padding:14px 16px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink); font-family:inherit; }
  .filter-accordion-header .fa-current { color:var(--blue); font-weight:400; font-size:13px; margin-left:6px; }
  .filter-accordion-chevron { color:var(--ink-soft); transition:transform .15s ease; font-size:13px; }
  .filter-accordion-item.open .filter-accordion-chevron { transform:rotate(180deg); }
  .filter-accordion-body { display:none; padding:0 16px 16px 16px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
  .filter-accordion-item.open .filter-accordion-body { display:block; padding-top:12px; }
  .opt-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 0; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; }
  .opt-search { width:100%; padding:7px 10px; margin-bottom:8px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; font-family:inherit; font-size:13px; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_home') }}" class="no-print" style="font-size:14px;">← Export</a>
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin:0;">Export Site Visits Conducted</h2>
  {% if show_results %}
  <div class="no-print" style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0;">
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_site_visits_excel', **filters) }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="window.print();">Print / Save as PDF</button>
    <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_export_site_visits_email') }}" style="display:inline;">

      {% for o in filters.owners %}<input type="hidden" name="owners" value="{{ o }}">{% endfor %}
      <button type="submit" class="btn">Email to Me</button>
    </form>
  </div>
  {% endif %}
</div>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">Date range filters on when the visit was CONDUCTED, not when it was scheduled.</p>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('settings_export_site_visits_results') }}" class="no-print" id="exportFilterForm">
  <div id="filterAccordion">
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.date_preset %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="date">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('date')">
        <span>Date Range{% if filters.date_preset %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ date_preset_labels.get(filters.date_preset, 'Custom') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <select name="date_preset" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:10px;" onchange="onDatePresetChange(this)">
          <option value="" {% if not filters.date_preset %}selected{% endif %}>— All time —</option>
          {% for key in date_preset_order %}
          <option value="{{ key }}" {% if filters.date_preset == key %}selected{% endif %}>{{ date_preset_labels[key] }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>
        <div id="customDateFields" style="{% if filters.date_preset != 'custom' %}display:none;{% endif %}">
          <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:10px;">
          <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" style="width:100%;">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.owners %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="owner">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('owner')">
        <span>Owner{% if filters.owners %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.owners|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% if owner_options %}<input type="text" class="opt-search no-print" placeholder="Search owners…" oninput="filterOptRows(this)">{% endif %}
        <div class="opt-list">
          {% for o in owner_options %}
          <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="owners" value="{{ o }}" {% if o in filters.owners %}checked{% endif %}> {{ o }}</label>
          {% endfor %}
          {% if not owner_options %}<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">No owners recorded yet.</p>{% endif %}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="write-form-row" style="margin-top:14px;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Apply Filters</button>
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_export_site_visits_view') }}" class="btn">Clear All</a>
  </div>
</form>

{% if show_results %}
{% if report.rows %}
<div class="report-table-wrap">
  <table class="report-table">
    <thead><tr>{% for key, label in report.columns %}<th>{{ label }}</th>{% endfor %}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for row in report.rows %}
      <tr>{% for key, label in report.columns %}<td>{{ row.get(key, '—') if row.get(key, '—') is not none else '—' }}</td>{% endfor %}</tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:14px;">
  <p>No conducted site visits match these filters.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endif %}

<script>
function toggleFA(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-accordion-item').forEach(function(item){
    if (item.dataset.fa === name) { item.classList.toggle('open'); } else { item.classList.remove('open'); }
  });
}
function onDatePresetChange(sel){
  var customBox = document.getElementById('customDateFields');
  customBox.style.display = (sel.value === 'custom') ? 'block' : 'none';
}
// filterOptRows() (Task B's search-box filter) moved to base.html
// v0.15 — shared with bulk_reassign_filter.html, no longer duplicated
// here.
</script>
{% endblock %}

```

```html
   lead_detail.html v8 (July 2026) — stage pill picker replacing native

{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}{{ lead.full_name or 'Lead' }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style>
/* v2 — accordion + score badge. Self-contained here since base.html's
   shared stylesheet isn't part of this edit. Falls back gracefully if
   --ink/--border/--blue etc. aren't defined there (uses safe defaults). */
.score-badge {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  min-width:28px; height:22px; padding:0 7px; border-radius:11px;
  font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; line-height:1;
  vertical-align:middle;
}
.score-badge.score-hot  { background:var(--red, #D64545); }
.score-badge.score-warm { background:#E0A030; }
.score-badge.score-cold { background:var(--ink-soft, #8A8A8A); }

.accordion-item {
  border:1px solid var(--border, #E2E2E2);
  border-radius:10px;
  margin-top:12px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--card-bg, #fff);
}
.accordion-header {
  width:100%; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  background:transparent; border:none; padding:14px 16px;
  font-size:16px; font-weight:700; text-align:left; cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--ink, #1a1a1a); font-family:inherit;
}
.accordion-header .count { color:var(--ink-soft, #8A8A8A); font-weight:400; font-size:14px; margin-left:6px; }
.accordion-chevron { color:var(--ink-soft, #8A8A8A); transition:transform .15s ease; font-size:14px; }
.accordion-item.open .accordion-chevron { transform:rotate(180deg); }
.accordion-body { display:none; padding:0 16px 16px 16px; border-top:1px solid var(--border, #E2E2E2); }
.accordion-item.open .accordion-body { display:block; padding-top:14px; }

.activity-filter-icons { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.af-icon {
  border:1px solid var(--border, #E2E2E2); background:#fff; border-radius:20px;
  padding:6px 12px; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink, #1a1a1a);
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:inherit;
}
.af-icon.active { background:var(--blue, #2D6CDF); color:#fff; border-color:var(--blue, #2D6CDF); }

/* v3 — Lost/Unqualified reason panel + checkbox option rows, self-contained */
.opt-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 0; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; }
.opt-row input { cursor:pointer; }
#reasonPanel { margin-top:12px; padding:12px; border:1px solid var(--border, #E2E2E2); border-radius:8px; background:var(--paper, #F7F8FA); }

/* v0.9 — restricted (non-owner) view: grayed-out, non-expandable cards */
.accordion-item.disabled-card { opacity:0.55; }
.accordion-item.disabled-card .accordion-header { cursor:not-allowed; }
.accordion-item.disabled-card .accordion-chevron { display:none; }

/* v0.9.3 — ACTIONS button + modal. Edit name/phone, Edit property
   details, and Reassign owner moved here from the Contact info card;
   Site Visit Conducted (walk-in) is new. Self-contained, same
   safe-default CSS-variable-fallback pattern as the rest of this file. */
.btn-actions {
  background:var(--blue, #2D6CDF); color:#fff; border:none;
  padding:9px 18px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:14px;
  cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; white-space:nowrap;
}
.modal-overlay {
  position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.45); z-index:1000;
  display:none; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:center;
  padding:24px 16px; overflow-y:auto;
}
.modal-overlay.open { display:flex; }
.modal-box {
  background:var(--card-bg, #fff); border-radius:12px; max-width:480px;
  width:100%; padding:20px; margin-top:32px; position:relative;
}
.modal-box h3 { margin-top:0; margin-bottom:14px; padding-right:24px; }
.modal-close {
  position:absolute; top:14px; right:16px; background:none; border:none;
  font-size:22px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink-soft, #8A8A8A);
  font-family:inherit;
}

/* v8 — stage pill picker replacing native <select>. Badge (tap target)
   toggles this panel inline below the badge row; native <select> stays
   in the DOM (display:none, set inline) since #stageForm still submits
   from it. Card wrapper matches .accordion-item/.modal-box language
   (white bg, bordered, 12px radius) rather than inventing a new style. */
.stage-picker-panel {
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:10px;
  padding:16px; background:var(--card-bg, #fff);
  border:1px solid var(--border, #E2E2E2); border-radius:12px;
  max-width:320px;
}
.stage-pill {
  background:#F7F8FA; border:1px solid #E3E6EC; color:var(--ink, #1a1a1a);
  border-radius:24px; padding:12px 16px; font-size:15px; text-align:center;
  cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; transition:background 0.1s, color 0.1s;
}
.stage-pill:active { background:#2F80ED; color:#fff; border-color:#2F80ED; }
</style>

{% set ACTIVITY_BUCKETS = {
  'site_visit_scheduled'   : 'site_visit',
  'site_visit_conducted'   : 'site_visit',
  'site_visit_rescheduled' : 'site_visit',
  'site_visit_cancelled'   : 'site_visit',
  'site_visit_no_show'     : 'site_visit',
  'follow_up_scheduled'    : 'follow_up',
  'follow_up_completed'    : 'follow_up',
  'follow_up_postponed'    : 'follow_up',
  'follow_up_cancelled'    : 'follow_up',
  'note'                   : 'note',
  'stage_change'           : 'stage_change',
  'assignment_change'      : 'assignment_change',
  'contact_info_updated'   : 'contact_info',
  'lead_entered'           : 'other',
  'lead_reengaged'         : 'other',
  'call_recording'         : 'call_recording',
  'cross_project_reassigned' : 'assignment_change',
  'project_changed'          : 'assignment_change',
} %}

<a href="{{ url_for('leads_list') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to leads</a>

{% if restricted %}
<div style="background:#FBEAEA; color:var(--red); border:1px solid #F3C9C9; padding:12px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; margin-top:12px;">
  ⚠️ You are not the owner of this lead — you have view access to Contact info only. No other action is available on this lead.
</div>
{% elif not can_write %}
{# v0.9.5 — manager (oversight) viewing a lead they don't own: full read,
   no writes. #}
<div style="background:#EFEAF7; color:#5B3FA0; border:1px solid #D9CEEE; padding:12px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; margin-top:12px;">
  👁 Supervisor view — this lead is assigned to {{ lead.lead_owner or 'another team member' }}. You can see everything on it, but changes are made by the assigned owner.
</div>
{% endif %}

<h2 style="margin-bottom:4px;">
  {{ lead.full_name or '(no name)' }}
  <span style="font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:400;">#{{ lead.crm_lead_no or '—' }}</span>
</h2>
<span class="badge stage-{{ (lead.current_stage or 'other')|replace(' ', '') }}"{% if can_write and allowed_next_stages %} id="stageBadge" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="toggleStagePicker()"{% endif %}>
  {{ lead.current_stage or 'Unknown' }}
</span>
{% if lead.current_stage == 'Opportunity' and lead.opportunity_temperature %}
<span class="temp-badge temp-{{ lead.opportunity_temperature }}">{{ lead.opportunity_temperature }}</span>
{% endif %}
<span class="score-badge score-{{ lead.lead_score_band|lower }}" title="Lead score">{{ lead.lead_score }}</span>

{% if can_write and allowed_next_stages %}
{# v8 — pill picker: same allowed_next_stages as stageSelect below, just
   rendered as tappable pills instead of <option>s. Closed by default on
   every fresh page load, toggled open/closed by the badge's onclick. #}
<div id="stagePickerPanel" class="stage-picker-panel" style="display:none;">
  {% for s in allowed_next_stages %}
  <div class="stage-pill" onclick="selectStagePill('{{ s }}')">{{ s }}</div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% if can_write %}
<div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; margin-top:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
  {% if allowed_next_stages %}
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('change_lead_stage', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" id="stageForm" style="margin:0; flex:1; min-width:220px;">
    {# v3 — item 14: no more "Update stage" button. Selecting a stage
       auto-submits IMMEDIATELY, EXCEPT for Lost/Unqualified — those two
       pause here for a required reason (item 15/16) before anything is
       submitted. That's the one deliberate exception to "auto-submit on
       select," not an oversight. #}
    {# v8 — kept in the DOM (just hidden) since #stageForm still submits
       new_stage from this element; the pill picker above sets its value
       and calls handleStageSelect() directly instead of a visible onchange. #}
    <select name="new_stage" id="stageSelect" required onchange="handleStageSelect(this)" style="display:none;">
      <option value="" disabled selected>Change stage to…</option>
      {% for s in allowed_next_stages %}
      <option value="{{ s }}">{{ s }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    <div id="reasonPanel" style="display:none;">
      <div class="field-label" id="reasonPanelTitle">Reason</div>
      <div id="reasonOptions"></div>
      <textarea name="reason_notes" id="reasonNotes" placeholder="Brief explanation (required)" style="margin-top:8px; width:100%;"></textarea>
      <div class="write-form-row" style="margin-top:10px;">
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Confirm — Update Stage</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="cancelStageChange()">Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
  {% endif %}

  <button type="button" class="btn-actions" onclick="openActionsModal()">ACTIONS</button>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════ ACTIONS MODAL (v0.9.3) — Edit name/phone, Edit
     property details, Reassign owner (all 3 moved here from Contact
     info), plus NEW Site Visit Conducted (walk-in) ═══════════════ -->
<div class="modal-overlay" id="actionsModal">
  <div class="modal-box">
    <button type="button" class="modal-close" onclick="closeActionsModal()" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
    <h3>Actions</h3>

    <details class="write-toggle">
      <summary>Edit name / phone</summary>
      <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('update_contact_info_route', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Name</div>
        <input type="text" name="full_name" value="{{ lead.full_name or '' }}" placeholder="Full name">

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Phone</div>
        <input type="tel" name="phone_raw" value="{{ lead.phone_raw or '' }}" placeholder="e.g. +91 98765 43210">
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">
          Correcting this can affect future Sell.do sync matching for this lead — every change is logged below in Activity History.
        </div>

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Alternate phone</div>
        <input type="tel" name="alt_phone_raw" value="{{ lead.alt_phone_raw or '' }}" placeholder="e.g. +91 98765 43210 (optional)">
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">
          Storage/display only — never used for Sell.do sync matching.
        </div>

        <div class="write-form-row">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Save</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </details>

    <details class="write-toggle" style="margin-top:10px;">
      <summary>Edit property details</summary>
      <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('update_property_details_route', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Project</div>
        <select name="project_bucket">
          {% for p in project_buckets %}
          <option value="{{ p }}" {% if lead.project_bucket == p %}selected{% endif %}>{{ p }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Funding source</div>
        <select name="funding_source">
          <option value="">— Unchanged / not set —</option>
          {% for f in funding_sources %}
          <option value="{{ f }}" {% if lead.funding_source == f %}selected{% endif %}>{{ f }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Budget</div>
        <select name="budget">
          <option value="">— Unchanged / not set —</option>
          {% for b in budget_options %}
          <option value="{{ b }}" {% if lead.budget == b %}selected{% endif %}>{{ b }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Property type <span style="font-weight:400; text-transform:none;">(select any that apply)</span></div>
        {% set current_ptypes = (lead.property_type or '').split(',')|map('trim')|list %}
        {% for p in property_types %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="property_type" value="{{ p }}" {% if p in current_ptypes %}checked{% endif %}> {{ p }}</label>
        {% endfor %}

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Configuration <span style="font-weight:400; text-transform:none;">(select any that apply)</span></div>
        {% set current_configs = (lead.configuration or '').split(',')|map('trim')|list %}
        {% for c in configurations %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="configuration" value="{{ c }}" {% if c in current_configs %}checked{% endif %}> {{ c }}</label>
        {% endfor %}

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Facing <span style="font-weight:400; text-transform:none;">(select any that apply)</span></div>
        {% set current_facings = (lead.facing or '').split(',')|map('trim')|list %}
        {% for d in facing_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="facing" value="{{ d }}" {% if d in current_facings %}checked{% endif %}> {{ d }}</label>
        {% endfor %}

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Campaign</div>
        <input type="text" name="campaign" value="{{ lead.campaign or '' }}" placeholder="e.g. FB_Naishka_July">

        <div class="write-form-row">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Save</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </details>

    <details class="write-toggle" style="margin-top:10px;">
      <summary>Reassign owner</summary>
      <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('assign_lead', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
        <select name="new_owner" required>
          <option value="" disabled {% if not lead.lead_owner %}selected{% endif %}>Choose an owner…</option>
          {% for o in owner_options %}
          <option value="{{ o }}" {% if lead.lead_owner == o %}selected{% endif %}>{{ o }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">
          The new owner sees a badge next to "Leads" until they open this lead.
        </div>
        <div class="write-form-row">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Reassign</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </details>

    <details class="write-toggle" style="margin-top:10px;">
      <summary>Site Visit Conducted</summary>
      {# v0.9.3 — item 4: for an existing, in-touch lead who walked into a
         project WITHOUT a prior scheduled visit. Posts straight to
         cls_db.log_walkin_site_visit() — a status='conducted' row is
         written directly, no open 'scheduled' slot involved. Same
         date+time-input-combined-via-JS pattern as "+ Schedule a site
         visit" below, for consistency. #}
      <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('add_walkin_site_visit', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Project</div>
        <select name="project" required>
          <option value="" disabled selected>Choose a project…</option>
          {% for p in project_buckets %}
          <option value="{{ p }}">{{ p }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Conducted on</div>
        <div class="write-form-row">
          <input type="date" id="visitConductedDate" required>
          <input type="time" id="visitConductedTime" required>
          <input type="hidden" name="conducted_at" id="visitConductedAt">
        </div>

        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Notes</div>
        <textarea name="notes" placeholder="Feedback from the visit (optional)"></textarea>

        <div class="write-form-row" style="margin-top:10px;">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary"
                  onclick="document.getElementById('visitConductedAt').value = document.getElementById('visitConductedDate').value + ' ' + document.getElementById('visitConductedTime').value;">
            Submit
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </details>

    <details class="write-toggle" style="margin-top:10px;">
      <summary>Sitting Done</summary>
      {# v14 — Task 4 item 3: in-office negotiation/paperwork session,
         logged activity_log-only via cls_db.log_sitting_done() — no
         site_visits row, no date field (unlike Site Visit Conducted
         above), just notes. Same markup/classes as the block above. #}
      <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('add_sitting_done', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
        <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Notes</div>
        <textarea name="notes" placeholder="What was discussed/finalized (optional)"></textarea>

        <div class="write-form-row" style="margin-top:10px;">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Submit</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </details>

  </div>
</div>
{% endif %}

<div id="leadAccordion">

  <!-- ═══════════════ CARD 1 — CONTACT INFO (closed by default, v3) ═══════════════ -->
  <div class="accordion-item" data-card="contact">
    <button type="button" class="accordion-header" onclick="toggleCard('contact')">
      <span>Contact info</span>
      <span class="accordion-chevron">▾</span>
    </button>
    <div class="accordion-body">
      <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 4px 20px;">
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Name</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.full_name or '(no name)' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Phone</div>
          <div class="field-value">
            {% if lead.phone_norm %}
              <a href="tel:+91{{ lead.phone_norm }}" onclick="logCallTap();">{{ lead.phone_norm|fmt_phone }}</a>
            {% else %}
              —
            {% endif %}
          </div>
        </div>
        {% if lead.alt_phone_norm %}
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Alternate phone</div>
          <div class="field-value">
            <a href="tel:+91{{ lead.alt_phone_norm }}" onclick="logCallTap();">{{ lead.alt_phone_norm|fmt_phone }}</a>
          </div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Email</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.email_raw or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Project</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.project_bucket }} <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:12px;">({{ lead.project or 'raw: —' }})</span></div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Owner</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.lead_owner or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Source</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.source or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Match tier</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.match_tier or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Stage updated</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.stage_updated_at|ampm or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Last CLS update</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.cls_updated_at|ampm or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        {% if lead.selldo_url %}
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Sell.do profile</div>
          <div class="field-value"><a href="{{ lead.selldo_url }}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in Sell.do ↗</a></div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
        {% if lead.lead_source_detail %}
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Source detail</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.lead_source_detail }}</div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Budget</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.budget or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Facing</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.facing or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Funding</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.funding_source or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Property type</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.property_type or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Configuration</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.configuration or '—' }}</div>
        </div>
        {% if lead.campaign %}
        <div>
          <div class="field-label">Campaign</div>
          <div class="field-value">{{ lead.campaign }}</div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
      </div>

      {% if can_write %}
      {% if current_user.role == 'admin' and lead.lead_source_detail %}
      <details class="write-toggle" style="margin-top:14px;">
        <summary>Change source (admin only)</summary>
        <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('update_lead_source', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
          <select name="source_detail" required>
            {% for s in source_options %}
            <option value="{{ s }}" {% if lead.lead_source_detail == s %}selected{% endif %}>{{ s }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
          </select>
          <div class="write-form-row">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Update source</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </details>
      {% endif %}
      <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:14px;">
        Edit name/phone, property details, and reassign owner have moved to the
        <strong>ACTIONS</strong> button above.
      </div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══════════════ CARD 2 — ACTIVITY HISTORY ═══════════════ -->
  <div class="accordion-item{% if restricted %} disabled-card{% endif %}" data-card="activity">
    <button type="button" class="accordion-header" {% if not restricted %}onclick="toggleCard('activity')"{% else %}disabled title="Not your lead"{% endif %}>
      <span>Activity History {% if not restricted %}<span class="count">({{ activity_log|length }})</span>{% endif %}</span>
      <span class="accordion-chevron">▾</span>
    </button>
    {% if not restricted %}
    <div class="accordion-body">
      <div class="activity-filter-icons">
        <button type="button" class="af-icon active" data-filter="all" onclick="filterActivity('all', this)">🗂️ All</button>
        <button type="button" class="af-icon" data-filter="site_visit" onclick="filterActivity('site_visit', this)">📅 Site Visit</button>
        <button type="button" class="af-icon" data-filter="follow_up" onclick="filterActivity('follow_up', this)">⏰ Follow-up</button>
        <button type="button" class="af-icon" data-filter="note" onclick="filterActivity('note', this)">📝 Notes</button>
        <button type="button" class="af-icon" data-filter="stage_change" onclick="filterActivity('stage_change', this)">🔄 Stage</button>
        <button type="button" class="af-icon" data-filter="assignment_change" onclick="filterActivity('assignment_change', this)">👤 Assignment</button>
      </div>

      {% if activity_log %}
      <div id="activityItems">
        {% for a in activity_log %}
        <div class="activity-item" data-bucket="{{ ACTIVITY_BUCKETS.get(a.activity_type, 'other') }}">
          {% if a.activity_type == 'note' %}
            <div>📝 {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'stage_change' %}
            <div>🔄 <strong>Stage changed:</strong> <strong>{{ a.prev_value }}</strong> → <strong>{{ a.new_value }}</strong>{% if a.description %} — {{ a.description }}{% endif %}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'assignment_change' %}
            <div>👤 <strong>Reassigned:</strong> <strong>{{ a.prev_value or '(unassigned)' }}</strong> → <strong>{{ a.new_value }}</strong></div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'cross_project_reassigned' %}
            <div>🔀 <strong>Auto-reassigned:</strong> {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'project_changed' %}
            <div>🏗️ <strong>Project changed:</strong> {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'site_visit_scheduled' %}
            <div>📅 <strong>Site visit scheduled for</strong> {{ a.new_value|ampm }}{% if a.description %} — {{ a.description }}{% endif %}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'site_visit_conducted' %}
            <div>✅ <strong>Site visit conducted</strong> — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'site_visit_rescheduled' %}
            <div>🔁 <strong>Site visit rescheduled:</strong> {{ a.prev_value|ampm }} → {{ a.new_value|ampm }} — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'site_visit_cancelled' %}
            <div>❌ <strong>Site visit cancelled</strong> — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'site_visit_no_show' %}
```
