```html
            <div>🚫 <strong>Didn't visit</strong> — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'follow_up_scheduled' %}
            <div>⏰ <strong>Follow-up scheduled for</strong> {{ a.new_value|ampm }}{% if a.description %} — {{ a.description }}{% endif %}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'follow_up_completed' %}
            <div>✅ <strong>Follow-up completed</strong> — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'follow_up_postponed' %}
            <div>🔁 <strong>Follow-up postponed:</strong> {{ a.prev_value|ampm }} → {{ a.new_value|ampm }} — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'follow_up_cancelled' %}
            <div>❌ <strong>Follow-up cancelled</strong> — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'call_attempted' %}
            <div>📞 <strong>Called (tapped from CRM)</strong></div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'lead_created_manual' %}
            <div>➕ <strong>Lead created manually — started at</strong> {{ a.new_value|ampm }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'source_changed' %}
            <div>🏷️ <strong>Source changed:</strong> <strong>{{ a.prev_value or '(none)' }}</strong> → <strong>{{ a.new_value }}</strong></div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'property_details_updated' %}
            <div>🏠 <strong>Property details updated</strong> — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'contact_info_updated' %}
            <div>✏️ <strong>Contact info updated</strong> — {{ a.description }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'lead_entered' %}
            {% set _idx = (a.description.find(' (source:') if a.description else -1) %}
            {% if _idx != -1 %}
            <div>🆕 <strong>{{ a.description[:_idx]|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe }}</strong>{{ a.description[_idx:]|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe }}</div>
            {% else %}
            <div>🆕 {{ a.description|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe if a.description else '' }}</div>
            {% endif %}
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'lead_reengaged' %}
            <div>🔄 {{ a.description|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe if a.description else '' }}</div>
          {% elif a.activity_type == 'call_recording' %}
            <div>
              📞{% if a.direction and a.direction|upper == 'INCOMING' %} ↙{% elif a.direction and a.direction|upper == 'OUTGOING' %} ↗{% endif %} <strong>Call recording</strong>{% if a.duration_seconds is not none %} — {{ (a.duration_seconds // 60) }}:{{ '%02d'|format(a.duration_seconds % 60) }}{% endif %}
              <audio controls preload="none" style="display:block; margin-top:6px; max-width:320px; width:100%;">
                <source src="{{ url_for('serve_recording', lead_id=a.cls_id, filename=a.recording_file_path) }}" type="audio/mpeg">
              </audio>
            </div>
          {% else %}
            <div>{{ a.activity_type }}</div>
          {% endif %}
          <div class="activity-meta">{{ a.actor_name }} · {{ a.created_at|ampm }}</div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
      {% else %}
      <p style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px;">No activity logged for this lead yet.</p>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>

  <!-- ═══════════════ CARD 3 — SITE VISITS & FOLLOW-UPS ═══════════════ -->
  <div class="accordion-item{% if restricted %} disabled-card{% endif %}" data-card="visits">
    <button type="button" class="accordion-header" {% if not restricted %}onclick="toggleCard('visits')"{% else %}disabled title="Not your lead"{% endif %}>
      <span>Site Visits &amp; Follow-ups</span>
      <span class="accordion-chevron">▾</span>
    </button>
    {% if not restricted %}
    <div class="accordion-body">

      {% if site_visits %}
      <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:0; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; text-transform:none; letter-spacing:normal; color:var(--ink);">Site Visits</div>
      {% for v in site_visits %}
      <div class="activity-item">
        <div>
          {{ v.scheduled_at|ampm }}
          {% if v.status == 'conducted' %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--green);">Conducted</span>
          {% elif v.status == 'cancelled' %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--ink-soft);">Cancelled</span>
          {% elif v.status == 'no_show' %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--red);">Didn't Visit</span>
          {% elif v.missed %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--red);">Missed</span>
          {% else %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--blue);">Scheduled</span>
          {% endif %}
        </div>
        {% if v.notes %}<div class="activity-meta">Scheduled note: {{ v.notes }}</div>{% endif %}
        {% if v.outcome_reason %}<div class="activity-meta">Outcome: {{ v.outcome_reason }}</div>{% endif %}
        {% if can_write and v.status == 'scheduled' %}
        <details class="write-toggle" style="margin-top:6px;">
          <summary>Update this visit</summary>
          <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('update_site_visit_route', cls_id=lead.cls_id, visit_id=v.visit_id) }}" class="write-form">
            <select name="action" required onchange="var d=this.closest('form').querySelector('.reschedule-date'); var show = this.value === 'rescheduled'; d.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none'; d.querySelectorAll('input[type=date],input[type=time]').forEach(function(el){el.required = show;});">
              <option value="" disabled selected>Outcome…</option>
              <option value="conducted">Conducted</option>
              <option value="rescheduled">Rescheduled</option>
              <option value="cancelled">Cancelled</option>
              <option value="no_show">Didn't Visit</option>
            </select>
            <div class="reschedule-date write-form-row" style="display:none; margin-top:8px;">
              <input type="date" onchange="this.form.new_scheduled_at.value = this.form.querySelector('input[type=date]').value + ' ' + this.form.querySelector('input[type=time]').value;">
              <input type="time" onchange="this.form.new_scheduled_at.value = this.form.querySelector('input[type=date]').value + ' ' + this.form.querySelector('input[type=time]').value;">
              <input type="hidden" name="new_scheduled_at">
            </div>
            <textarea name="reason" placeholder="Reason (required)" required style="margin-top:8px;"></textarea>
            <div class="write-form-row">
              <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Submit</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </details>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
      {% endfor %}
      {% endif %}

      {% if can_write %}
      <details class="write-toggle" id="siteVisitForm">
        <summary>+ Schedule a site visit</summary>
        <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('add_site_visit', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
          <div class="write-form-row">
            <input type="date" id="siteVisitDate" required>
            <input type="time" id="siteVisitTime" required>
            <input type="hidden" name="scheduled_at" id="siteVisitScheduledAt">
          </div>
          <textarea name="notes" placeholder="Optional notes (e.g. bring brochure)"></textarea>
          <div class="write-form-row">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="document.getElementById('siteVisitScheduledAt').value = document.getElementById('siteVisitDate').value + ' ' + document.getElementById('siteVisitTime').value;">Schedule</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </details>
      {% endif %}

      {% if follow_ups %}
      <div class="field-label" style="margin-top:20px; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; text-transform:none; letter-spacing:normal; color:var(--ink);">Follow-ups</div>
      {% for f in follow_ups %}
      <div class="activity-item">
        <div>
          {{ f.scheduled_at|ampm }}
          {% if f.status == 'completed' %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--green);">Completed</span>
          {% elif f.status == 'cancelled' %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--ink-soft);">Cancelled</span>
          {% elif f.missed %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--red);">Missed</span>
          {% else %}
            <span class="badge" style="background:var(--blue);">Scheduled</span>
          {% endif %}
        </div>
        {% if f.notes %}<div class="activity-meta">Scheduled note: {{ f.notes }}</div>{% endif %}
        {% if f.outcome_reason %}<div class="activity-meta">Outcome: {{ f.outcome_reason }}</div>{% endif %}
        {% if can_write and f.status == 'scheduled' %}
        <details class="write-toggle" style="margin-top:6px;">
          <summary>Update this follow-up</summary>
          <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('update_follow_up_route', cls_id=lead.cls_id, followup_id=f.followup_id) }}" class="write-form">
            <select name="action" required onchange="var d=this.closest('form').querySelector('.reschedule-date'); var show = this.value === 'postponed'; d.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none'; d.querySelectorAll('input[type=date],input[type=time]').forEach(function(el){el.required = show;});">
              <option value="" disabled selected>Outcome…</option>
              <option value="completed">Completed</option>
              <option value="postponed">Postponed</option>
              <option value="cancelled">Cancelled</option>
            </select>
            <div class="reschedule-date write-form-row" style="display:none; margin-top:8px;">
              <input type="date" onchange="this.form.new_scheduled_at.value = this.form.querySelector('input[type=date]').value + ' ' + this.form.querySelector('input[type=time]').value;">
              <input type="time" onchange="this.form.new_scheduled_at.value = this.form.querySelector('input[type=date]').value + ' ' + this.form.querySelector('input[type=time]').value;">
              <input type="hidden" name="new_scheduled_at">
            </div>
            <textarea name="reason" placeholder="Reason (required)" required style="margin-top:8px;"></textarea>
            <div class="write-form-row">
              <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Submit</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </details>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
      {% endfor %}
      {% endif %}

      {% if can_write %}
      <details class="write-toggle" id="followUpForm">
        <summary>+ Schedule a follow-up</summary>
        <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('add_follow_up', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
          <div class="write-form-row">
            <input type="date" id="followUpDate" required>
            <input type="time" id="followUpTime" required>
            <input type="hidden" name="scheduled_at" id="followUpScheduledAt">
          </div>
          <textarea name="notes" placeholder="Optional notes"></textarea>
          <div class="write-form-row">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="document.getElementById('followUpScheduledAt').value = document.getElementById('followUpDate').value + ' ' + document.getElementById('followUpTime').value;">Schedule</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </details>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>

  <!-- ═══════════════ CARD 4 — NOTES ═══════════════ -->
  {% set note_entries = activity_log|selectattr('activity_type', 'equalto', 'note')|list %}
  <div class="accordion-item{% if restricted %} disabled-card{% endif %}" data-card="notes">
    <button type="button" class="accordion-header" {% if not restricted %}onclick="toggleCard('notes')"{% else %}disabled title="Not your lead"{% endif %}>
      <span>Notes {% if not restricted %}<span class="count">({{ note_entries|length }})</span>{% endif %}</span>
      <span class="accordion-chevron">▾</span>
    </button>
    {% if not restricted %}
    <div class="accordion-body">
      {% if can_write %}
      <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('add_lead_note', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="write-form">
        <textarea name="note_text" placeholder="Add a note about this lead…" required></textarea>
        <div class="write-form-row">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Add note</button>
        </div>
      </form>
      {% endif %}

      {% if note_entries %}
      <div style="margin-top:16px;">
        {% for a in note_entries %}
        <div class="activity-item">
          <div>📝 {{ a.description }}</div>
          <div class="activity-meta">{{ a.actor_name }} · {{ a.created_at|ampm }}</div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
      {% else %}
      <p style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px; margin-top:12px;">No notes yet.</p>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>

</div>

<!-- ═══════════════ ADMIN-ONLY — CAPI/Email history, now accordion cards (v0.9.2), same toggleCard() pattern as the rest ═══════════════ -->
{% if current_user.role == 'admin' %}
<div class="accordion-item" data-card="capi">
  <button type="button" class="accordion-header" onclick="toggleCard('capi')">
    <span>CAPI fire history <span class="count">({{ events|length }})</span></span>
    <span class="accordion-chevron">▾</span>
  </button>
  <div class="accordion-body">
    {% if events %}
    <table class="leads">
      <thead>
        <tr><th>Fired at</th><th>Prev stage</th><th>Stage</th><th>Meta event</th><th>Value (₹)</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {% for e in events %}
        <tr>
          <td data-label="Fired at">{{ e.fired_at }}</td>
          <td data-label="Prev stage">{{ e.prev_stage or '—' }}</td>
          <td data-label="Stage">{{ e.crm_stage }}</td>
          <td data-label="Meta event">{{ e.meta_event }}</td>
          <td data-label="Value">₹{{ "{:,}".format(e.value_inr) if e.value_inr else '—' }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endfor %}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    {% else %}
    <p style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px;">No CAPI events fired for this lead yet.</p>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</div>

<div class="accordion-item" data-card="email">
  <button type="button" class="accordion-header" onclick="toggleCard('email')">
    <span>Email history <span class="count">({{ comms|length }})</span></span>
    <span class="accordion-chevron">▾</span>
  </button>
  <div class="accordion-body">
    {% if comms %}
    <table class="leads">
      <thead>
        <tr><th>Sent at</th><th>Stage</th><th>Day</th><th>Template</th><th>Status</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {% for c in comms %}
        <tr>
          <td data-label="Sent at">{{ c.sent_at }}</td>
          <td data-label="Stage">{{ c.drip_stage }}</td>
          <td data-label="Day">Day {{ c.day_number }}</td>
          <td data-label="Template">{{ c.template_key }}</td>
          <td data-label="Status">{{ c.status }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endfor %}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    {% else %}
    <p style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px;">No drip emails sent to this lead yet.</p>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</div>

<form method="post" action="{{ url_for('delete_lead_route', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" style="margin-top:16px;"
      onsubmit="return confirm('Permanently delete lead #{{ lead.crm_lead_no }} ({{ lead.full_name or 'no name' }}) and ALL its data? This cannot be undone.');">
  <button type="submit" class="btn" style="background:var(--red); color:#fff; border-color:var(--red);">Delete this lead permanently</button>
</form>
{% endif %}

<div class="action-bar">
  <button type="button" class="action-btn{% if not can_write %} disabled{% endif %}" {% if not can_write %}disabled title="Not your lead"{% else %}onclick="openCardAndScroll('visits', 'siteVisitForm');" title="Schedule a site visit"{% endif %}>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/><line x1="8" y1="3" x2="8" y2="7"/><line x1="16" y1="3" x2="16" y2="7"/></svg>
    Site Visit
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="action-btn{% if not can_write %} disabled{% endif %}" {% if not can_write %}disabled title="Not your lead"{% else %}onclick="openCardAndScroll('visits', 'followUpForm');" title="Schedule a follow-up"{% endif %}>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="8"/><path d="M12 9v4l3 2"/><path d="M9 2h6"/></svg>
    Follow-up
  </button>
  {% if lead.phone_norm and can_write %}
  <a class="action-btn" href="tel:+91{{ lead.phone_norm }}" title="Call {{ lead.full_name }}" onclick="logCallTap();">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 0 1-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 0 1 4.11 2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.72c.127.96.361 1.903.7 2.81a2 2 0 0 1-.45 2.11L8.09 9.91a16 16 0 0 0 6 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 0 1 2.11-.45c.907.339 1.85.573 2.81.7A2 2 0 0 1 22 16.92z"/></svg>
    Call
  </a>
  {% else %}
  <button class="action-btn disabled" disabled title="{% if not can_write %}Not your lead{% else %}No phone number on file{% endif %}">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 0 1-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 0 1 4.11 2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.72c.127.96.361 1.903.7 2.81a2 2 0 0 1-.45 2.11L8.09 9.91a16 16 0 0 0 6 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 0 1 2.11-.45c.907.339 1.85.573 2.81.7A2 2 0 0 1 22 16.92z"/></svg>
    Call
  </button>
  {% endif %}
  <button class="action-btn disabled" disabled title="Deferred — not built yet, per your instruction">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="m22 6-10 7L2 6"/></svg>
    Email
  </button>
  {% if lead.phone_norm and can_write %}
  <a class="action-btn" href="{{ url_for('whatsapp_picker', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" title="Send WhatsApp">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 11.5a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9 3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1-7.6 4.7 8.38 8.38 0 0 1-3.8-.9L3 21l1.9-5.7a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9-3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1 4.7-7.6 8.38 8.38 0 0 1 3.8-.9h.5a8.48 8.48 0 0 1 8 8v.5z"/></svg>
    WhatsApp
  </a>
  {% else %}
  <button class="action-btn disabled" disabled title="{% if not can_write %}Not your lead{% else %}No phone number on file{% endif %}">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 11.5a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9 3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1-7.6 4.7 8.38 8.38 0 0 1-3.8-.9L3 21l1.9-5.7a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9-3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1 4.7-7.6 8.38 8.38 0 0 1 3.8-.9h.5a8.48 8.48 0 0 1 8 8v.5z"/></svg>
    WhatsApp
  </button>
  {% endif %}
</div>

<script>
// v0.3 — fire-and-forget call-attempt logging. Does not wait for or
// care about the response; the tel: link handoff proceeds regardless.
// See cls_db.py v1.9's log_call_tap() for what this can and can't
// actually capture (timestamp only — never duration or answered-status).
function logCallTap() {
  fetch("{{ url_for('call_tap', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}", { method: "POST" }).catch(function(){});
}

// v0.9.3 — ACTIONS modal open/close. Closing via the × button, a
// backdrop click, or Escape all just remove the .open class; nothing
// inside submits on its own (each <details> form still needs its own
// Save/Submit tap, same as before the move).
function openActionsModal() {
  document.getElementById('actionsModal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeActionsModal() {
  document.getElementById('actionsModal').classList.remove('open');
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var overlay = document.getElementById('actionsModal');
  if (overlay) {
    overlay.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target === overlay) { closeActionsModal(); }
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeActionsModal(); }
  });
});

// v2 — accordion: exactly one card open at a time. Clicking the
// currently-open card's header closes it; clicking any other opens it
// and closes the rest.
function toggleCard(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item').forEach(function(item){
    if (item.dataset.card === name) {
      item.classList.toggle('open');
    } else {
      item.classList.remove('open');
    }
  });
}

// v2 — force a specific card open (used by the bottom action-bar's
// quick "Site Visit"/"Follow-up" buttons so they still jump straight
// to the right form, same as before the accordion existed).
function openCard(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item').forEach(function(item){
    item.classList.toggle('open', item.dataset.card === name);
  });
}

function openCardAndScroll(cardName, detailsId) {
  openCard(cardName);
  var d = document.getElementById(detailsId);
  if (d) { d.open = true; }
  // Small delay lets the accordion body finish expanding before we
  // measure its position to scroll to it.
  setTimeout(function(){
    if (d) { d.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center'}); }
  }, 60);
}

// v2 — Activity History filter icons. Client-side only, no reload:
// each activity item already carries its bucket in data-bucket
// (computed server-side from ACTIVITY_BUCKETS above).
function filterActivity(bucket, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.af-icon').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('active'); });
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('#activityItems .activity-item').forEach(function(item){
    item.style.display = (bucket === 'all' || item.dataset.bucket === bucket) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

// v3 — item 14 + 15/16: auto-submit the stage dropdown immediately
// EXCEPT for Lost/Unqualified, which pause here for a required reason
// (radio, one of cls_db's LOST_REASONS/UNQUALIFIED_REASONS) plus a
// free-text note, both enforced again server-side by cls_db.
// update_lead_stage() — this client-side gate is a UX convenience,
// not the actual enforcement point.
var LOST_REASONS = {{ lost_reasons|tojson }};
var UNQUALIFIED_REASONS = {{ unqualified_reasons|tojson }};

function handleStageSelect(sel) {
  var stage = sel.value;
  var panel = document.getElementById('reasonPanel');
  var optsDiv = document.getElementById('reasonOptions');
  var title = document.getElementById('reasonPanelTitle');
  var notes = document.getElementById('reasonNotes');

  if (stage === 'Lost' || stage === 'Unqualified') {
    var list = stage === 'Lost' ? LOST_REASONS : UNQUALIFIED_REASONS;
    title.textContent = stage + ' reason (required)';
    optsDiv.innerHTML = list.map(function(r){
      var esc = r.replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
      return '<label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="reason_code" value="' + esc + '" required> ' + r + '</label>';
    }).join('');
    panel.style.display = 'block';
    notes.required = true;
  } else {
    panel.style.display = 'none';
    optsDiv.innerHTML = '';
    notes.required = false;
    sel.form.submit();
  }
}

function cancelStageChange() {
  document.getElementById('stageSelect').value = '';
  document.getElementById('reasonPanel').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('reasonOptions').innerHTML = '';
  document.getElementById('reasonNotes').required = false;
  var picker = document.getElementById('stagePickerPanel');
  if (picker) picker.style.display = 'none';
}

// v8 — pill picker: badge toggles the panel open/closed; each pill sets
// the (hidden) native select's value and reuses handleStageSelect() as-is
// rather than duplicating its Lost/Unqualified reason-panel logic.
function toggleStagePicker() {
  var panel = document.getElementById('stagePickerPanel');
  if (!panel) return;
  panel.style.display = (panel.style.display === 'none') ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function selectStagePill(stage) {
  var sel = document.getElementById('stageSelect');
  sel.value = stage;
  handleStageSelect(sel);
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/lead_new.html
```html
{# lead_new.html — v0.2 (2026-08-20), Task 4 item 6: dropped the "it
   can't start at Incoming" paragraph, no longer true now that
   cls_db.MANUAL_ENTRY_STAGES includes "Incoming" (Srikanth's explicit
   reversal, Task 4 item 6 — see cls_db.py v2.70's changelog and
   create_manual_lead()'s docstring for the reasoning). No prior
   top-of-file version comment existed in this file before this edit. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Add Lead{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0;">Add a lead manually</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:0;">
  For walk-ins, references, and offline inquiries — anything that didn't come
  through Meta or Sell.do's digital intake. Pick whichever stage it's
  genuinely at already — including "Incoming" for a walk-in who's right at
  the very start of the funnel.
</p>

<div class="card">
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('new_lead') }}">
    <div class="field-label">Name *</div>
    <input type="text" name="full_name" required style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">

    <div class="field-label">Phone *</div>
    <input type="tel" name="phone_raw" required placeholder="10-digit number" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">

    <div class="field-label">Alternate phone</div>
    <input type="tel" name="alt_phone_raw" placeholder="10-digit number (optional)" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">

    <div class="field-label">Email</div>
    <input type="email" name="email_raw" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">

    <div class="field-label">Project</div>
    <select name="project" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">
      <option value="">— Select —</option>
      {% for p in projects %}
      <option value="{{ p }}">{{ p }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    <div class="field-label">Source *</div>
    <select name="source_detail" required style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">
      <option value="" disabled selected>— Select —</option>
      {% for s in source_options %}
      <option value="{{ s }}">{{ s }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
    <p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:-10px; margin-bottom:14px;">
      Locked after creation — only an admin can change this later.
    </p>

    <div class="field-label">Initial stage *</div>
    <select name="initial_stage" required style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">
      <option value="" disabled selected>— Select —</option>
      {% for s in manual_entry_stages %}
      <option value="{{ s }}">{{ s }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    {% if current_user.role == 'admin' %}
    <div class="field-label">Owner (leave blank for yourself)</div>
    <input type="text" name="lead_owner" placeholder="Sell.do 'Attended By' name" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">
    {% endif %}

    {# v0.9 — item 12: qualification fields. All optional — a walk-in
       taken down quickly shouldn't be blocked on these; they're just
       as editable later via "Edit property details" on the lead page. #}
    <div class="field-label">Budget</div>
    <select name="budget" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">
      <option value="">— Not set —</option>
      {% for b in budget_options %}
      <option value="{{ b }}">{{ b }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    <div class="field-label">Configuration <span style="font-weight:400; text-transform:none;">(select any that apply)</span></div>
    <div style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      {% for c in configuration_options %}
      <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="configuration" value="{{ c }}"> {{ c }}</label>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>

    <div class="field-label">Property Type <span style="font-weight:400; text-transform:none;">(select any that apply)</span></div>
    <div style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      {% for p in property_type_options %}
      <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="property_type" value="{{ p }}"> {{ p }}</label>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>

    <div class="field-label">Facing <span style="font-weight:400; text-transform:none;">(select any that apply)</span></div>
    <div style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      {% for d in facing_options %}
      <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="facing" value="{{ d }}"> {{ d }}</label>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>

    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Create lead</button>
    <a href="{{ url_for('leads_list') }}" class="btn">Cancel</a>
  </form>
</div>

<style>
.opt-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 0; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; }
.opt-row input { cursor:pointer; }
</style>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/leads_filter.html
```html
{# leads_filter.html (v0.9) — dedicated filter screen (items 8 of
   Srikanth's spec). His spec described a two-pane "list of categories
   on the left, options revealed per category" layout — that's a
   desktop pattern that doesn't fit a phone-width screen, so this
   builds it as an ACCORDION instead: tap a category to expand its
   options directly below it, same proven pattern as lead_detail.html's
   card accordion. Same spirit (categorized, one thing open at a time),
   adapted for mobile-first. Flagging this adaptation explicitly rather
   than silently reinterpreting the spec.

   One GET form, submitted once via "Apply Filters" at the bottom —
   not per-category — so every selection across every category applies
   together in a single request, same as the old top-bar form did.

   v0.9 (2026-08-04) — Pipeline Stage changed from radio (single-value
   name="stage") to checkbox multi-select (name="stages"), mirroring
   bulk_reassign_filter.html's existing Pipeline Stage checkbox block
   exactly. Requires app.py v0.33 / cls_db.py v2.44.

   v0.8 (July 2026) — item 4 of Srikanth's bug-fix batch: Date Range's
   plain From/To inputs replaced with an 11-option quick-select dropdown
   (Today / Yesterday / Last 7 days / Last 14 days / Last 30 days /
   This week / Last week / This month / Last month / Maximum / Custom),
   mirroring cls_reports.py's QUICK_RANGES pattern (see app.py's
   DATE_PRESETS). Selecting anything except "Custom" auto-submits the
   form immediately (Srikanth wants results without a manual Apply
   click); "Custom" reveals the original From/To date inputs and still
   requires "Apply Filters", unchanged from before. Old bookmarked URLs
   with raw date_from/date_to and no date_preset keep working exactly
   as before — app.py's _parse_lead_filters() detects and labels the
   matching preset, or shows "Custom" if the dates don't match one. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Filter Leads{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style>
.filter-accordion-item {
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:10px;
  margin-top:10px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--card);
}
.filter-accordion-header {
  width:100%; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  background:transparent; border:none; padding:14px 16px;
  font-size:15px; font-weight:700; text-align:left; cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--ink); font-family:inherit;
}
.filter-accordion-header .fa-current { color:var(--blue); font-weight:400; font-size:13px; margin-left:6px; }
.filter-accordion-chevron { color:var(--ink-soft); transition:transform .15s ease; font-size:13px; }
.filter-accordion-item.open .filter-accordion-chevron { transform:rotate(180deg); }
.filter-accordion-body { display:none; padding:0 16px 16px 16px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.filter-accordion-item.open .filter-accordion-body { display:block; padding-top:12px; }

.opt-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 0; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; }
.opt-row input { cursor:pointer; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('leads_list') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to leads</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px; margin-bottom:14px;">Filter Leads</h2>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('leads_list') }}" id="filterForm">
  <input type="hidden" name="q" value="{{ filters.q }}">

  <div id="filterAccordion">

    {# ── DATE RANGE ── (v0.8: quick-select dropdown, item 4) #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.date_preset %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="date">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('date')">
        <span>Date Range{% if filters.date_preset %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ date_preset_labels.get(filters.date_preset, 'Custom') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <div class="field-label">Quick select</div>
        <select name="date_preset" id="datePresetSelect" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:10px;" onchange="onDatePresetChange(this)">
          <option value="" {% if not filters.date_preset %}selected{% endif %}>— Select —</option>
          {% for key in date_preset_order %}
          <option value="{{ key }}" {% if filters.date_preset == key %}selected{% endif %}>{{ date_preset_labels[key] }}</option>
          {% endfor %}
        </select>
        <div id="customDateFields" style="{% if filters.date_preset != 'custom' %}display:none;{% endif %}">
          <div class="field-label">From</div>
          <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:10px;">
          <div class="field-label">To</div>
          <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" style="width:100%;">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── SORT BY ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item" data-fa="sort">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('sort')">
        <span>Sort By<span class="fa-current"> · {{ sort_labels.get(filters.sort_by, sort_labels['recent']) }}</span></span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% for key, label in sort_labels.items() %}
        <label class="opt-row">
          <input type="radio" name="sort_by" value="{{ key }}" {% if filters.sort_by == key %}checked{% endif %}>
          {{ label }}
        </label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── PIPELINE STAGE (multi-select, v0.33) ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.stages %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="stage">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('stage')">
        <span>Pipeline Stage{% if filters.stages %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.stages|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% for s in stages %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="stages" value="{{ s }}" {% if s in filters.stages %}checked{% endif %}> {{ s }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── STAGE CHANGE REASON ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.stage_reason %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="reason">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('reason')">
        <span>Stage Change Reason{% if filters.stage_reason %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.stage_reason }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="stage_reason" value="" {% if not filters.stage_reason %}checked{% endif %}> Any / not set</label>
        {% for r in stage_reasons %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="stage_reason" value="{{ r }}" {% if filters.stage_reason == r %}checked{% endif %}> {{ r }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── CAMPAIGN ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.campaign %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="campaign">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('campaign')">
        <span>Campaign{% if filters.campaign %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.campaign }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <input type="text" name="campaign" value="{{ filters.campaign }}" placeholder="e.g. FB_Naishka_July" style="width:100%;">
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── PROJECT ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.project %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="project">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('project')">
        <span>Project{% if filters.project %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.project }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="project" value="" {% if not filters.project %}checked{% endif %}> All projects</label>
        {% for p in projects %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="project" value="{{ p }}" {% if filters.project == p %}checked{% endif %}> {{ p }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── SOURCE ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.source %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="source">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('source')">
        <span>Source{% if filters.source %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.source }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="source" value="" {% if not filters.source %}checked{% endif %}> All sources</label>
        {% for s in source_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="source" value="{{ s }}" {% if filters.source == s %}checked{% endif %}> {{ s }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── SUB-SOURCE ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.sub_source %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="subsource">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('subsource')">
        <span>Sub-source{% if filters.sub_source %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.sub_source }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="sub_source" value="" {% if not filters.sub_source %}checked{% endif %}> Any</label>
        {% for s in sub_source_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="sub_source" value="{{ s }}" {% if filters.sub_source == s %}checked{% endif %}> {{ s }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── BUDGET ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.budget %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="budget">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('budget')">
        <span>Budget{% if filters.budget %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.budget }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="budget" value="" {% if not filters.budget %}checked{% endif %}> Any</label>
        {% for b in budget_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="budget" value="{{ b }}" {% if filters.budget == b %}checked{% endif %}> {{ b }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── CONFIGURATION (multi-select) ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.configuration %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="config">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('config')">
        <span>Configuration{% if filters.configuration %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.configuration|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% for c in configuration_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="configuration" value="{{ c }}" {% if c in filters.configuration %}checked{% endif %}> {{ c }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── PROPERTY TYPE (multi-select) ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.property_type %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="ptype">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('ptype')">
        <span>Property Type{% if filters.property_type %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.property_type|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% for p in property_type_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="property_type" value="{{ p }}" {% if p in filters.property_type %}checked{% endif %}> {{ p }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {# ── FACING (multi-select) ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.facing %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="facing">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('facing')">
        <span>Facing{% if filters.facing %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.facing|join(', ') }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        {% for d in facing_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="checkbox" name="facing" value="{{ d }}" {% if d in filters.facing %}checked{% endif %}> {{ d }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>

    {% if can_view_all_owners and owner_options %}
    {# ── OWNER (oversight roles: admin + manager) ── #}
    <div class="filter-accordion-item{% if filters.owner %} open{% endif %}" data-fa="owner">
      <button type="button" class="filter-accordion-header" onclick="toggleFA('owner')">
        <span>Owner{% if filters.owner %}<span class="fa-current"> · {{ filters.owner }}</span>{% endif %}</span>
        <span class="filter-accordion-chevron">▾</span>
      </button>
      <div class="filter-accordion-body">
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="owner" value="" {% if not filters.owner %}checked{% endif %}> Everyone</label>
        {% for o in owner_options %}
        <label class="opt-row"><input type="radio" name="owner" value="{{ o }}" {% if filters.owner == o %}checked{% endif %}> {{ o }}</label>
        {% endfor %}
      </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

  </div>

  <div class="write-form-row" style="margin-top:20px; margin-bottom:24px;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Apply Filters</button>
    <a href="{{ url_for('leads_list', q=filters.q) }}" class="btn">Clear All</a>
  </div>
</form>

<script>
function toggleFA(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-accordion-item').forEach(function(item){
    if (item.dataset.fa === name) {
      item.classList.toggle('open');
    } else {
      item.classList.remove('open');
    }
  });
}

// v0.8 — item 4: selecting any preset except "Custom" resolves to
// concrete dates server-side and auto-applies immediately (Srikanth
// wants results "directly without manually applying dates"). "Custom"
// just reveals the From/To inputs and waits for the existing
// "Apply Filters" button, same as before this change.
function onDatePresetChange(sel){
  var customBox = document.getElementById('customDateFields');
  if (sel.value === 'custom') {
    customBox.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  customBox.style.display = 'none';
  if (sel.value !== '') {
    document.getElementById('filterForm').submit();
  }
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/leads_list.html
```html
{# leads_list.html (v0.10) — top filter bar removed per Srikanth's spec.
   Header is now just "Leads (N)" + Add lead. Filter/Search/Fields
   moved to the bottom icon bar (_leads_list_actionbar.html) — Filter
   and Search open dedicated full-screen panels; Fields stays an
   in-place popover, just relocated.

   v0.10 (2026-08-04) — "Filters active" banner condition checks
   filters.stages (list) instead of filters.stage (single value) —
   Pipeline Stage is now a checkbox multi-select (app.py v0.33 /
   cls_db.py v2.44).

   v0.9 (July 2026, Task 5 of the APX v0.7 batch) — the "Upd" field
   (stage_updated_at, see v0.8's note below — that trade-off is why
   this is being retired rather than chased further) is REPLACED with
   lead age in days (cls_db.py v2.28's get_leads_page() age_days,
   computed from cls_created_at). Shown only for active leads — None
   for Booked/Lost/Unqualified (DRIP_TERMINAL_STAGES), which render
   nothing at all rather than a dash or a stale number, per Srikanth's
   "active leads only" instruction. Still gated behind the SAME
   'updated' key in the Fields popover/ALL_LIST_FIELDS (no schema/
   field-list change requested) — the popover checkbox itself still
   reads "Updated" (it capitalizes the raw key), which no longer quite
   matches what the column shows now; flagged as a minor follow-up,
   not fixed here since it wasn't asked for.

   v0.8 (July 2026) — item 3 (Option A) of Srikanth's bug-fix batch: the
   "Upd" field now shows stage_updated_at instead of cls_updated_at.
   ROOT CAUSE (see cls_db.py v2.19's Option B for the source-of-truth
   companion fix): upsert_selldo_lead() (Job B's per-lead sync call) was
   setting cls_updated_at=now() on every sync pass, even a true no-op —
   so "Upd" read as today for every lead regardless of whether anyone
   had touched it. stage_updated_at only ever moves on a REAL stage
   change, so it's immune to that bug. TRADE-OFF: stage_updated_at won't
   reflect non-stage edits (notes, contact/property edits) made in the
   CRM itself — a lead edited today but with no stage change will still
   show an older "Upd" date. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Leads{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style>
/* v0.5 — lead score badge. Self-contained here since base.html's
   shared stylesheet isn't part of this edit. */
.score-badge {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  min-width:26px; height:20px; padding:0 6px; border-radius:10px;
  font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; line-height:1;
}
.score-badge.score-hot  { background:var(--red); }
.score-badge.score-warm { background:#E0A030; }
.score-badge.score-cold { background:var(--ink-soft); }
</style>
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin:0;">Leads <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:400; font-size:16px;">({{ result.total }})</span></h2>
  <a href="{{ url_for('new_lead') }}" class="btn btn-primary">+ Add lead</a>
</div>

{% if owner_unlinked_warning %}
<div style="background:#FDEDED; color:var(--red); border:1px solid #F5C6C6; padding:12px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; margin:16px 0;">
  Your account isn't linked to a Sell.do owner name yet, so no leads are showing.
  Ask your admin to set this — it's a one-line fix via <code>create_admin.py</code>.
</div>
{% endif %}

{% if filters.q or filters.stages or filters.project or filters.owner or filters.date_from or filters.date_to
      or filters.stage_reason or filters.campaign or filters.source or filters.sub_source or filters.budget
      or filters.configuration or filters.property_type or filters.facing %}
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin:14px 0; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); flex-wrap:wrap;">
  <span>Filters active{% if filters.q %} · searching "{{ filters.q }}"{% endif %}</span>
  <a href="{{ url_for('leads_list') }}" class="btn" style="padding:4px 12px; font-size:12px;">Clear all</a>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% if result.rows %}
<div class="lead-card-list" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
  {% for lead in result.rows %}
  <div class="lead-card">
    <a href="{{ url_for('lead_detail', cls_id=lead.cls_id) }}" class="lead-card-stretch" aria-label="View {{ lead.full_name or 'lead' }}"></a>
    <div class="lead-card-head">
      <span class="lead-card-no">#{{ lead.crm_lead_no or '—' }}</span>
      <span class="lead-card-name">{{ lead.full_name or '(no name)' }}</span>
      <span class="score-badge score-{{ lead.lead_score_band|lower }}" title="Lead score: {{ lead.lead_score }}">
        {{ lead.lead_score }}
      </span>
      <span class="badge stage-{{ (lead.current_stage or 'other')|replace(' ', '') }}">
        {{ lead.current_stage or 'Unknown' }}
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="lead-card-grid">
      {% if 'phone' in active_fields and lead.phone_norm %}
      <span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">Ph</span>
        <a href="tel:+91{{ lead.phone_norm }}" class="lead-card-phone">{{ lead.phone_norm|fmt_phone }}</a>
      </span>
      {% endif %}
      {% if 'project' in active_fields %}
      <span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">Project</span> {{ lead.project_bucket }}</span>
      {% endif %}
      {% if 'owner' in active_fields %}
      <span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">Owner</span> {{ lead.lead_owner or '—' }}</span>
      {% endif %}
      {% if 'source' in active_fields %}
      <span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">Source</span> {{ lead.source or '—' }}</span>
      {% endif %}
      {% if 'updated' in active_fields and lead.age_days is not none %}
      <span class="lc-field"><span class="lc-label">Age</span> {{ lead.age_days }}d</span>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p><strong>No leads match these filters.</strong></p>
  <p>Try the Filter or Search icons below to adjust or clear them.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% if result.total_pages > 1 %}
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:10px; margin-top:16px; align-items:center;">
  {% set base_args = filters.copy() %}
  {% set _ = base_args.update({'fields_submitted': 1, 'fields': active_fields}) %}
  {% if result.page > 1 %}
    <a class="btn" href="{{ url_for('leads_list', page=result.page-1, **base_args) }}">← Previous</a>
  {% endif %}
  <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px;">Page {{ result.page }} of {{ result.total_pages }}</span>
  {% if result.page < result.total_pages %}
    <a class="btn" href="{{ url_for('leads_list', page=result.page+1, **base_args) }}">Next →</a>
  {% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% include "_leads_list_actionbar.html" %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/leads_search.html
```html
{# leads_search.html (v0.11) — dedicated search screen (item 7 of
   Srikanth's spec). Every OTHER currently-active filter is carried
   forward as a hidden input so searching doesn't silently clear a
   filter someone already set.

   v0.11 (2026-08-09) — Caption updated for cls_db.py v2.51's rewritten
   search classification: "#"/"apx-" now does an EXACT lead-ID match
   (was a LIKE match — "#2" no longer also hits 20/200/etc), and a
   bare all-digits term (no prefix) now matches phone ONLY, not name/
   email. No form/route change.

   v0.10 (2026-08-04) — Pipeline Stage carry-forward changed from a
   single hidden <input name="stage"> to a loop over filters.stages
   (name="stages"), same pattern already used below for configuration/
   property_type/facing — matches leads_filter.html's radio->checkbox
   conversion (app.py v0.33 / cls_db.py v2.44). The "Clear search" link's
   stage=filters.stage query param likewise swapped to
   stages=filters.stages.

   v0.9 (July 2026) — item 1 of Srikanth's bug-fix batch (cls_db.py
   v2.19): lead-ID search is now PREFIX-GATED, not implicit. A bare
   numeric term like "250" used to also match lead ID 250 alongside
   name/phone/email — it no longer does. Only a term starting with "#"
   or "apx-" matches by lead ID, and does so EXCLUSIVELY (name/phone/
   email are not searched in that case). Caption/placeholder updated to
   document this explicitly. No form/route change — same GET to
   leads_list, same field name `q`.

   v0.8 — Search by Lead ID (cls_db.py v2.16, now superseded by v2.19
   above). #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Search Leads{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('leads_list') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to leads</a>

<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Search Leads</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:-8px;">
  Search name, phone, or email — or type "#" or "apx-" followed by the
  lead number (e.g. #250, or apx-250) to match that Lead ID exactly.
  A phone number on its own (digits only) matches by phone only.
</p>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('leads_list') }}" class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ filters.q }}" placeholder="Search name, phone, email, or #250 for lead ID"
         autofocus style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">

  {# Carry every other active filter forward untouched #}
  {% for v in filters.stages %}<input type="hidden" name="stages" value="{{ v }}">{% endfor %}
  <input type="hidden" name="project" value="{{ filters.project }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="owner" value="{{ filters.owner }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="date_preset" value="{{ filters.date_preset }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="sort_by" value="{{ filters.sort_by }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="stage_reason" value="{{ filters.stage_reason }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="campaign" value="{{ filters.campaign }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="source" value="{{ filters.source }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="sub_source" value="{{ filters.sub_source }}">
  <input type="hidden" name="budget" value="{{ filters.budget }}">
  {% for v in filters.configuration %}<input type="hidden" name="configuration" value="{{ v }}">{% endfor %}
  {% for v in filters.property_type %}<input type="hidden" name="property_type" value="{{ v }}">{% endfor %}
  {% for v in filters.facing %}<input type="hidden" name="facing" value="{{ v }}">{% endfor %}

  <div class="write-form-row">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Search</button>
    {% if filters.q %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('leads_list', stages=filters.stages, project=filters.project, owner=filters.owner, date_from=filters.date_from, date_to=filters.date_to, date_preset=filters.date_preset, sort_by=filters.sort_by, stage_reason=filters.stage_reason, campaign=filters.campaign, source=filters.source, sub_source=filters.sub_source, budget=filters.budget, configuration=filters.configuration, property_type=filters.property_type, facing=filters.facing) }}" class="btn">Clear search</a>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</form>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/login.html
```html
{# login.html (v2) — Chunk B cosmetic: submit button now uses the new
   scoped .btn-pill-green class (base.html v0.18) instead of
   btn/btn-primary — green, oval/pill, this button only.

   v1 — two changes:
   1. Heading changed from literal "APX" to "Asian Properties CRM"
      (app.py/settings.html session's user-facing branding pass — "APX"
      only ever appears elsewhere in this codebase inside Python/Jinja/
      JS comments, never rendered markup, so this heading was the only
      genuine occurrence). The old subtitle line directly below it also
      said "Asian Properties CRM" — now-redundant with the heading, so
      it's REMOVED rather than left duplicating the exact same text
      right under itself. Flagging this specific adjustment since it
      goes slightly beyond a literal find-replace — happy to restore a
      (different) subtitle line if you'd rather keep two lines there.
   2. NEW "Show password" checkbox next to the password field — plain
      JS toggling the input's type between "password"/"text", no new
      dependency, matching this page's existing plain-form style. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Log in{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div style="max-width:360px; margin: 60px auto 0;">
  <div class="card">
    <h2 style="margin-top:0; margin-bottom:4px;">Asian Properties CRM</h2>

    {% if error %}
      <p style="background:#FDEDED; color:var(--red); border:1px solid #F5C6C6; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px;">
        {{ error }}
      </p>
    {% endif %}

    <form method="POST" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;">
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Email</div>
        <input type="email" name="email" required autofocus style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Password</div>
        <input type="password" id="passwordInput" name="password" required style="width:100%;">
        <label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-top:6px; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); cursor:pointer;">
          <input type="checkbox" onchange="togglePasswordVisibility(this)">
          Show password
        </label>
      </div>
      <button type="submit" class="btn-pill-green" style="margin-top:6px; width:100%; border:none;">Log in</button>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function togglePasswordVisibility(checkbox) {
  document.getElementById('passwordInput').type = checkbox.checked ? 'text' : 'password';
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/missed_calls_list.html
```html
{# missed_calls_list.html (v1, 2026-08-16) — Task 3 Part A, Change 3.
   List behind the dashboard's new "Missed Calls" card. Mirrors
   due_list.html's markup (same lead-card-list/lead-card classes), but
   each row is a call_log_staging row (call_timestamp, raw_phone),
   not a lead row — cls_db.get_missed_calls_list() joins in
   full_name/crm_lead_no for display. Criteria: a missed call with no
   later outgoing call back to the same matched lead. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Missed Calls{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0;">Missed Calls <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:400; font-size:16px;">({{ calls|length }})</span></h2>

<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:0;">
  Missed calls with no callback made since. A call drops off this list the
  moment an outgoing call is placed to the same lead.
</p>

{% if calls %}
<div class="lead-card-list">
  {% for call in calls %}
  <a href="{{ url_for('lead_detail', cls_id=call.cls_id) }}" class="lead-card">
    <div class="lead-card-head">
      <span class="lead-card-no">#{{ call.crm_lead_no or '—' }}</span>
      <span class="lead-card-name">{{ call.full_name or '(no name)' }}</span>
      <span class="badge" style="background:var(--red);">Missed</span>
    </div>
    <div class="lead-card-grid">
```

## FILE: crm/templates/reminders_tomorrow.html
```html
{# reminders_tomorrow.html (v0.11) — Tomorrow's Site Visits: WhatsApp
   reminder page. Reached from the Dashboard tile, the drawer
   "Reminders" link, or directly. Salespeople see only their own leads'
   visits (route scopes the query); admins/managers see all of them.

   v0.11 — PWA deep-link fix. The button used to be a <form method=post>
   submit that the server 302-redirected to https://wa.me/..., which
   itself redirects to whatsapp://... — in an installed/standalone PWA
   that redirect chain loses user-gesture status, so the OS blocks the
   whatsapp:// custom scheme (net::ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME). Each button
   is now a real <a href="https://wa.me/...">, so the tap is a direct,
   un-intercepted top-level navigation. The mark-sent logging call still
   happens (fired via fetch(..., {keepalive:true}) on click, not
   awaited, no preventDefault) — see app.py's reminder_mark_sent(),
   which now returns 204 instead of redirecting since the browser
   navigates via the anchor's own href independently. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Tomorrow's Site Visits{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0; margin-bottom:4px;">Tomorrow's Site Visits ({{ visits|length }})</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:0; max-width:560px;">
  Tap Open WhatsApp to send tomorrow's reminder. You'll review the message inside WhatsApp
  before it sends.
</p>

{% if visits %}
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; margin-top:16px;">
  {% for v in visits %}
  <div class="card">
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ v.full_name or '(no name)' }}</strong>
      {% if v.phone_raw or v.phone_norm %}
      <a href="tel:{{ v.phone_e164 }}" style="font-size:13px;">{{ v.phone_raw or v.phone_norm }}</a>
      {% endif %}
      {% if v.project %}
      <span class="badge" style="background:var(--gray);">{{ v.project }}</span>
      {% endif %}
      <span style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-left:auto;">{{ v.scheduled_at|ampm }}</span>
    </div>

    {% if v.rendered_body is none %}
    <div class="flash flash-error" style="margin-top:10px; margin-bottom:0;">
      No reminder template set up for <strong>{{ v.project or 'this project' }}</strong> yet.
      <a href="{{ url_for('whatsapp_reminder_templates_admin') }}">Add one in Settings</a>.
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-size:14px; color:var(--ink); margin-top:10px; background:var(--paper); padding:10px 12px; border-radius:8px;">{{ v.rendered_body }}</div>

    {% if not v.reminder_sent_at %}
    <a href="https://wa.me/{{ v.phone_e164 }}?text={{ v.rendered_body|urlencode }}"
       class="wa-open-link btn btn-primary"
       data-log-url="{{ url_for('reminder_mark_sent', visit_id=v.visit_id) }}"
       style="display:block; width:100%; padding:10px; font-size:15px; background:var(--green); border-color:var(--green); text-align:center; margin-top:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
      Open WhatsApp →
    </a>
    {% else %}
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; margin-top:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <span class="badge" style="background:var(--green);">✓ Reminder sent at {{ v.reminder_sent_at|ampm }}</span>
      <a href="https://wa.me/{{ v.phone_e164 }}?text={{ v.rendered_body|urlencode }}"
         class="wa-open-link btn"
         data-log-url="{{ url_for('reminder_mark_sent', visit_id=v.visit_id) }}"
         style="padding:4px 10px; font-size:12px; text-align:center;">
        Send again
      </a>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
    {% endif %}
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p>No site visits scheduled for tomorrow.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

<script>
(function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('.wa-open-link').forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var logUrl = el.getAttribute('data-log-url');
      if (!logUrl) return;
      var fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('wa_url', el.getAttribute('href'));
      // Fire-and-forget: not awaited, no preventDefault — the anchor's
      // own top-level navigation to wa.me/whatsapp:// must proceed
      // un-intercepted so the OS still treats it as a user gesture.
      fetch(logUrl, { method: 'POST', body: fd, keepalive: true });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/report_view.html
```html
{# report_view.html (v0.7) — generic template for every PLAIN-TABLE
   report (everything except Lead Stage Analysis + the chart-bearing
   Campaign Insights reports, which use report_view_charts.html
   instead — see report.template, set by app.py's report_view() route).
   Every report shapes its data into the same {columns, rows} table via
   cls_reports.build_report() — this template just renders that shape.

   v0.7 (July 2026, Task 2) — renders report.display_columns/
   report.display_rows when cls_reports.build_report() supplies them
   (the 5 mobile_transpose reports), falling back to the original
   columns/rows for every other report. Excel export is unaffected —
   export_to_excel() reads columns/rows only, never the display_* pair.

   v0.6.1: gained the shared date-range picker (_report_date_picker.html)
   in place of the old daily/weekly period toggle; Export Excel now
   carries the same from/to the page is showing, so the download always
   matches what's on screen.

   Export: Excel via /reports/<id>/export.xlsx (openpyxl, server-side).
   PDF: browser print-to-PDF (Srikanth's confirmed call, 2026-07) — the
   <style media="print"> block below hides everything except the table,
   and "Print / Save as PDF" just calls window.print(). No PDF library. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}{{ report.title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style media="print">
  .appbar, .nav-drawer, .nav-scrim, .no-print { display: none !important; }
  main.wrap { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  .report-table { font-size: 11px; }
</style>
<style>
  .report-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 14px; }
  .report-table th, .report-table td {
    text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .report-table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .report-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--paper); }
  .report-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('reports_home') }}" class="no-print" style="font-size:14px;">← All Reports</a>
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:10px;">
  <div>
    <h2 style="margin:0;">{{ report.title }}</h2>
    <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin:4px 0 0;">{{ report.description }}</p>
  </div>
  <div class="no-print" style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0;">
    {% if report.is_live %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('report_export_excel', report_id=report.id) }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    {% else %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('report_export_excel', report_id=report.id, **{'from': report.date_from, 'to': report.date_to}) }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    {% endif %}
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="window.print();">Print / Save as PDF</button>
  </div>
</div>

{% include "_report_date_picker.html" %}

{% if report.caveat %}
<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px; background:#FBF6E9; border-color:#EAD9A0;">
  <p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0;">{{ report.caveat }}</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% set view_columns = report.display_columns if report.display_columns else report.columns %}
{% set view_rows = report.display_rows if report.display_rows else report.rows %}
{% if report.rows %}
<div class="report-table-wrap">
  <table class="report-table">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        {% for key, label in view_columns %}
        <th>{{ label }}</th>
        {% endfor %}
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for row in view_rows %}
      <tr>
        {% for key, label in view_columns %}
        <td>{{ row.get(key, '—') if row.get(key, '—') is not none else '—' }}</td>
        {% endfor %}
      </tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:14px;">
  <p>No data yet for this report{{ '' if report.is_live else ' in the selected date range' }}.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/report_view_charts.html
```html
{# report_view_charts.html (v0.6.1) — NEW template for chart-bearing
   reports: Lead Stage Analysis (4 views: by owner/project/campaign +
   site visits by campaign) and the Campaign Insights reports that carry
   a single chart (Campaign Lead Volume, Campaign Stage Distribution,
   Campaign Conversion Rate, Campaign First-Response Time, Site Visits
   by Campaign). Selected via report.template — app.py's report_view()
   route picks this over report_view.html per the report's "template"
   key in cls_reports.REPORTS. Campaign Lost Reason Breakdown stays on
   report_view.html (plain table, no chart — see cls_reports.py's C4
   design note: reason-cardinality reads better as a table than bars).

   Charting: Chart.js via CDN (Srikanth's confirmed call, 2026-07) — the
   ONLY template in this app that loads it, so every other report page
   stays dependency-free. Every chart is ALWAYS rendered alongside its
   full accessible table (not behind a toggle) — the table is the same
   data Excel export uses, and print-to-PDF hides the (unreliable to
   print) canvas and keeps the table, via the print stylesheet below.

   A single-chart report (report.views is None) is normalized into a
   one-item list here so the same loop renders both shapes — see the
   `views` Jinja variable below. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}{{ report.title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style media="print">
  .appbar, .nav-drawer, .nav-scrim, .no-print { display: none !important; }
  main.wrap { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  .report-table { font-size: 11px; }
  .chart-canvas-wrap { display: none !important; }
</style>
<style>
  .report-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 10px; }
  .report-table th, .report-table td {
    text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .report-table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .report-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--paper); }
  .report-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
  .chart-canvas-wrap { position: relative; height: 320px; margin-top: 10px; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('reports_home') }}" class="no-print" style="font-size:14px;">← All Reports</a>
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:10px;">
  <div>
    <h2 style="margin:0;">{{ report.title }}</h2>
    <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin:4px 0 0;">{{ report.description }}</p>
  </div>
  <div class="no-print" style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0;">
    {% if report.is_live %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('report_export_excel', report_id=report.id) }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    {% else %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('report_export_excel', report_id=report.id, **{'from': report.date_from, 'to': report.date_to}) }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    {% endif %}
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="window.print();">Print / Save as PDF</button>
  </div>
</div>

{% include "_report_date_picker.html" %}

{% if report.caveat %}
<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px; background:#FBF6E9; border-color:#EAD9A0;">
  <p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0;">{{ report.caveat }}</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% set views = report.views if report.views else [{"title": report.title, "columns": report.columns, "rows": report.rows, "chart": report.chart}] %}

{% for view in views %}
<div class="card" style="margin-top:18px;">
  {% if report.views %}<h3 style="margin-top:0; margin-bottom:0; font-size:15px;">{{ view.title }}</h3>{% endif %}
  {% if view.rows %}
    {% if view.chart %}
    <div class="chart-canvas-wrap no-print">
      <canvas id="chart-{{ loop.index }}"></canvas>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
    <div class="report-table-wrap">
      <table class="report-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {% for key, label in view.columns %}
            <th>{{ label }}</th>
            {% endfor %}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {% for row in view.rows %}
          <tr>
            {% for key, label in view.columns %}
            <td>{{ row.get(key, '—') if row.get(key, '—') is not none else '—' }}</td>
            {% endfor %}
          </tr>
          {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  {% else %}
    <p class="empty-state" style="margin:10px 0 0; padding:24px;">No data yet for this view{{ '' if report.is_live else ' in the selected date range' }}.</p>
  {% endif %}
</div>
{% endfor %}

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.4/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function() {
  var CHART_VIEWS = {{ views | tojson }};
  CHART_VIEWS.forEach(function(view, i) {
    if (!view.chart || !view.rows || !view.rows.length) return;
    var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-' + (i + 1));
    if (!canvas) return;
    var cfg = view.chart;
    var isHorizontal = cfg.type === 'horizontal_bar';
    var isStacked = cfg.type === 'stacked_bar';
    var datasets = cfg.datasets.map(function(ds) {
      return { label: ds.label, data: ds.data, backgroundColor: ds.color };
    });
    new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'bar',
      data: { labels: cfg.labels, datasets: datasets },
      options: {
        indexAxis: isHorizontal ? 'y' : 'x',
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        scales: {
          x: { stacked: isStacked },
          y: { stacked: isStacked, beginAtZero: true },
        },
        plugins: { legend: { display: datasets.length > 1 } },
      },
    });
  });
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/reports.html
```html
{# reports.html (v0.6.2) — Categorized Reports landing page. Categories +
   cards are entirely config-driven from cls_reports.CATEGORIES via
   visible_categories(current_user) — admin_only reports are simply
   absent from a salesperson's list here (Srikanth's call: hide, don't
   grey-out), not a template-level if-check per report. Add a report by
   adding one entry to cls_reports.REPORTS and one id to a category in
   cls_reports.CATEGORIES; nothing here needs to change.

   v0.6.2 — Categories now collapse-by-default dropdowns (native
   <details>, no JS). No <details open> anywhere, so every category
   starts closed on page load; opening one is independent of the
   others (native <details> behavior). Chevron is an inline SVG,
   rotated via CSS on details[open]. cls_reports.py untouched — this
   is presentation-only. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Reports{% endblock %}

{% block head %}
<style>
  details.report-cat{
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    margin: 0 0 4px;
  }
  details.report-cat > summary{
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 14px 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    font-size: 14px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  details.report-cat > summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display: none; }
  details.report-cat > summary:hover{ background: var(--paper); }
  .report-cat-title{ flex: 1; }
  .report-cat-count{
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    background: var(--paper);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px 9px;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: normal;
  }
  .report-cat .chev{
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  details.report-cat[open] .chev{ transform: rotate(180deg); }
  .report-grid{
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 4px 4px 18px;
  }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<h2 style="margin-top:0;">Reports</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:-6px;">
  {% if is_oversight %}
  Reports marked "Team" are cross-salesperson comparisons; everything else is scoped to your
  own leads when you're logged in as a salesperson. Most reports have a date-range picker on
  their own page — a few marked "Live" are point-in-time snapshots instead.
  {% else %}
  Scoped to your own leads. A few cross-salesperson comparison reports are admin/manager-only
  and aren't shown here.
  {% endif %}
</p>

{% for category in categories %}
<details class="report-cat">
  <summary>
    <span class="report-cat-title">{{ category.name }}</span>
    <span class="report-cat-count">{{ category.reports|length }}</span>
    <svg class="chev" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 12 8" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <path d="M1 1l5 5 5-5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </svg>
  </summary>
  <div class="report-grid">
    {% for r in category.reports %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('report_view', report_id=r.id) }}" class="card" style="display:block;">
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; gap:8px;">
        <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ r.title }}</strong>
        <span class="badge" style="background:{{ 'var(--blue)' if r.admin_only else 'var(--gray)' }}; flex-shrink:0;">
          {{ 'Team' if r.admin_only else r.cadence }}
        </span>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:8px 0 0;">{{ r.description }}</p>
    </a>
    {% endfor %}
  </div>
</details>
{% endfor %}

{% if not categories %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p>No reports available.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```

```html
{# v0.22 — app_version (crm/app.py APP_VERSION, injected by
   inject_current_user()) shown here as a natural landing spot for
   "what version is this CRM on", alongside the same text already in
   base.html's drawer footer. #}

<p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:18px;">APX v{{ app_version }}</p>
{% endif %}

<script>
// v0.20 — calls the native bridge android_pilot's MainActivity.kt v9
// exposes (window.AndroidBridge, a single-method JS interface). Feature-
// detected so this same button degrades gracefully to an inline message
// when viewed in a normal desktop/browser context, not the app's WebView.
function openDeviceSyncSettings() {
  if (window.AndroidBridge) {
    AndroidBridge.openDeviceSyncSettings();
  } else {
    document.getElementById('deviceSyncFallback').style.display = 'block';
  }
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```
