```html
{# settings_attendance.html (v0.30) — Attendance admin hub. Same
   card-grid pattern as settings.html.
   v0.30 — Chunk C: NEW "Who's Present Today" tile, pointing at
   settings_attendance_today() — @admin_required (not the looser
   can_view_all_leads() gate Dashboard/Export use).
   v0.29 — NEW "Dashboard & Export" tile (Build Order Step 3), pointing
   at settings_attendance_dashboard() — that route isn't @admin_required
   (a salesperson reaches the same page force-scoped to themselves via
   a link on attendance.html instead), but this hub itself still is. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Attendance Settings{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" style="font-size:14px;">&larr; Back to Settings</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Attendance</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Admin configuration for the APX Attendance pilot.
</p>

<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap:14px; margin-top:16px;">

  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance_dashboard') }}" class="card" style="display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit;">
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="26" height="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--green)" stroke-width="2"><path d="M3 3v18h18"/><path d="M18 17V9"/><path d="M13 17V5"/><path d="M8 17v-3"/></svg>
      <span style="font-weight:700; font-size:16px;">Dashboard &amp; Export</span>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:10px 0 0;">
      Monthly calendar, present/late/absent/leave totals, and Excel/PDF export.
    </p>
  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance_today') }}" class="card" style="display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit;">
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="26" height="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--blue)" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 3"/></svg>
      <span style="font-weight:700; font-size:16px;">Who's Present Today</span>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:10px 0 0;">
      Every employee's actual status right now — present, late, absent, on leave, weekoff, or not marked yet.
    </p>
  </a>

  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance_corrections') }}" class="card" style="display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit;">
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="26" height="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.12 2.12 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/></svg>

  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance_holidays') }}" class="card" style="display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit;">

      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="26" height="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--green)" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M16 2v4"/><path d="M8 2v4"/><path d="M3 10h18"/></svg>

      <span style="font-weight:700; font-size:16px;">Project GPS &amp; Geofence</span>
```

## FILE: crm/templates/settings_attendance_corrections.html
```html
{# settings_attendance_corrections.html (v0.30) — admin Settings >
   Attendance > Corrections. Approve/reject queue: one route handles
   both actions via a hidden 'action' field, same idiom as
   settings_users.html's activate/deactivate toggle form.

   v0.30 — Chunk C bugfix: the exemption form's single free-text
   new_value field (v0.29) asked admins to hand-type either a status
   string or a strict "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" datetime, with only a
   placeholder as a hint — a guaranteed source of "Time must be in
   YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format" rejections (confirmed: admins are used
   to seeing DD-MM-YYYY dates everywhere ELSE in this app, e.g. Chunk
   B's Weekoff/Leave confirm() dialogs). Replaced with: a Status
   <select> (populated from attendance_statuses, no free typing) shown
   only when Field = Status, and a proper <input type="date"> +
   <input type="time" step="1"> pair shown only when Field = Login Ts/
   Logout Ts, toggled by the Field dropdown's onchange
   (updateExemptionValueInputs()). A new hidden new_value input is
   assembled into the exact required string by prepareExemptionSubmit()
   right before the form POSTs — the visible inputs themselves are
   never named new_value, so nothing free-typed ever reaches the
   server directly. cls_db.py's create_correction_request() strptime
   check is COMPLETELY UNCHANGED — still the real last line of
   defense, this only fixes what the FORM sends it. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Attendance Corrections{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance') }}" style="font-size:14px;">&larr; Back to Attendance</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Corrections</h2>

<h3 style="font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; margin-top:20px;">Pending ({{ pending|length }})</h3>
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:10px;">
  {% for c in pending %}
  <div class="card">
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <div>
        <strong style="font-size:14px;">{{ c.full_name or c.email }}</strong>
        <span style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);"> &middot; {{ c.attendance_date }}</span>
        <div style="font-size:13px; margin-top:4px;">
          Change <strong>{{ c.field_changed.replace('_', ' ') }}</strong>:
          <span style="color:var(--ink-soft);">{{ c.old_value or '(empty)' }}</span> &rarr; <strong>{{ c.new_value }}</strong>
        </div>
        {% if c.request_note %}
        <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">"{{ c.request_note }}"</div>
        {% endif %}
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">Requested {{ c.created_at|ampm }}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
        <form method="post">
          <input type="hidden" name="correction_id" value="{{ c.correction_id }}">
          <input type="hidden" name="action" value="approve">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Approve</button>
        </form>
        <form method="post">
          <input type="hidden" name="correction_id" value="{{ c.correction_id }}">
          <input type="hidden" name="action" value="reject">
          <button type="submit" class="btn" style="color:var(--red); border-color:#F3C9C9; padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Reject</button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
  {% if not pending %}
  <div class="card empty-state"><p>No pending correction requests.</p></div>
  {% endif %}
</div>

<h3 style="font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; margin-top:28px;">Resolved</h3>
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:10px;">
  {% for c in resolved %}
  <div class="card" style="opacity:0.75;">
    <strong style="font-size:14px;">{{ c.full_name or c.email }}</strong>
    <span style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);"> &middot; {{ c.attendance_date }} &middot; {{ c.field_changed.replace('_', ' ') }} &rarr; {{ c.new_value }}</span>
    <span class="badge" style="background:{{ 'var(--green)' if c.status == 'approved' else 'var(--red)' }}; margin-left:6px;">{{ c.status }}</span>
    <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">by {{ c.actor }} {{ c.resolved_at|ampm if c.resolved_at }}</div>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
  {% if not resolved %}
  <div class="card empty-state"><p>Nothing resolved yet.</p></div>
  {% endif %}
</div>

<h3 style="font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; margin-top:28px;">Grant a Proactive Exemption</h3>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:560px; margin-top:-4px;">
  Directly set a status or time for any employee on any date — no employee request needed first.
  Applied immediately (auto-approved) and logged in Resolved above.
</p>
<div class="card" style="margin-top:10px; max-width:480px;">
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_attendance_exempt') }}" onsubmit="return prepareExemptionSubmit();" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;">
    <select name="user_id" required>
      <option value="">Select employee&hellip;</option>
      {% for u in employees %}
      <option value="{{ u.user_id }}">{{ u.full_name or u.email }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
    <input type="date" name="attendance_date" required>
    <select name="field_changed" id="exemptFieldChanged" required onchange="updateExemptionValueInputs()">
      {% for f in correction_fields %}
      <option value="{{ f }}">{{ f.replace('_', ' ')|title }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    <select id="exemptStatusSelect" style="display:none;">
      <option value="">Select status&hellip;</option>
      {% for s in attendance_statuses %}
      <option value="{{ s }}">{{ s.replace('_', ' ')|title }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    <div id="exemptDateTimeInputs" style="display:none; gap:8px;">
      <input type="date" id="exemptTimeDate" style="flex:1;">
      <input type="time" id="exemptTimeTime" step="1" style="flex:1;">
    </div>

    <input type="hidden" name="new_value" id="exemptNewValueHidden">

    <textarea name="request_note" placeholder="Note (optional — defaults to &quot;Proactive admin exemption&quot;)" rows="2"
      style="width:100%; padding:9px 11px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-family:inherit; resize:vertical; min-height:60px; box-sizing:border-box;"></textarea>
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="align-self:flex-start;">Apply Exemption</button>
  </form>
</div>

<script>
// v0.30 Chunk C bugfix — the Field dropdown decides which value-input
// set is visible (Status dropdown vs Date+Time pickers), and
// assembles the hidden new_value field into the EXACT
// "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" string create_correction_request() requires
// (cls_db.py, unchanged) right before the form submits. Neither
// visible input is itself named new_value, so nothing free-typed ever
// reaches the server directly anymore — see this file's own v0.30
// header note on the bug this replaces.
function updateExemptionValueInputs() {
  var field = document.getElementById('exemptFieldChanged').value;
  var statusSelect = document.getElementById('exemptStatusSelect');
  var dateTimeInputs = document.getElementById('exemptDateTimeInputs');
  if (field === 'status') {
    statusSelect.style.display = 'block';
    dateTimeInputs.style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    statusSelect.style.display = 'none';
    dateTimeInputs.style.display = 'flex';
  }
}

function prepareExemptionSubmit() {
  var field = document.getElementById('exemptFieldChanged').value;
  var hidden = document.getElementById('exemptNewValueHidden');
  if (field === 'status') {
    var statusVal = document.getElementById('exemptStatusSelect').value;
    if (!statusVal) {
      alert('Select a status.');
      return false;
    }
    hidden.value = statusVal;
  } else {
    var dateVal = document.getElementById('exemptTimeDate').value;
    var timeVal = document.getElementById('exemptTimeTime').value;
    if (!dateVal || !timeVal) {
      alert('Select both a date and a time.');
      return false;
    }
    // <input type="time" step="1"> normally yields 'HH:MM:SS' — padded
    // defensively in case a browser ever hands back 'HH:MM' without
    // seconds, so the assembled string always matches exactly what
    // create_correction_request()'s strptime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    // expects (that check itself is completely unchanged).
    if (timeVal.length === 5) { timeVal += ':00'; }
    hidden.value = dateVal + ' ' + timeVal;
  }
  return true;
}

// Runs once on load so the correct input set shows for whichever
// option the Field dropdown defaults to (its first <option>, 'status').
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateExemptionValueInputs);
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_attendance_dashboard.html
```html
{# settings_attendance_dashboard.html (v0.29) — APX Attendance admin
   Dashboard (Build Order Step 3). NOT admin-only server-side (see
   app.py's settings_attendance_dashboard() docstring) — a salesperson
   reaches this same template force-scoped to themselves, with the
   employee filter hidden (is_oversight is False for them).

   Export: Excel via /settings/attendance/dashboard/export.xlsx
   (openpyxl, server-side, cls_reports.export_to_excel() — the SAME
   engine Reports uses, no new one written). PDF: browser print-to-PDF,
   same convention as report_view.html — the <style media="print">
   block below hides everything except the totals/calendar, and
   "Print / Save as PDF" just calls window.print(). No PDF library. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Attendance Dashboard{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<style media="print">
  .appbar, .nav-drawer, .nav-scrim, .no-print { display: none !important; }
  main.wrap { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
</style>

<a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance') if is_oversight else url_for('attendance_home') }}"
   class="no-print" style="font-size:14px;">&larr; Back</a>

<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
  <h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Attendance Dashboard</h2>
  <div class="no-print" style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance_dashboard_export', year=year, month=month, user_id=selected_user_id or '') }}" class="btn">Export Excel</a>
    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="window.print();">Print / Save as PDF</button>
  </div>
</div>

<form method="get" class="no-print" style="display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:end; margin-top:10px;">
  <div>
    <label style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); display:block;">Month</label>
    <select name="month">
      {% for m in range(1, 13) %}
      <option value="{{ m }}" {% if m == month %}selected{% endif %}>{{ month_names[m] }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); display:block;">Year</label>
    <select name="year">
      {% for y in year_options %}
      <option value="{{ y }}" {% if y == year %}selected{% endif %}>{{ y }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
  </div>
  {% if is_oversight %}
  <div>
    <label style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); display:block;">Employee</label>
    <select name="user_id">
      <option value="">All employees</option>
      {% for u in employees %}
      <option value="{{ u.user_id }}" {% if selected_user_id == u.user_id %}selected{% endif %}>{{ u.full_name or u.email }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
  </div>
  {% endif %}
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">View</button>
</form>

<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ month_names[month] }} {{ year }} — Totals</strong>
  <div style="overflow-x:auto; margin-top:10px;">
    <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:13px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; font-size:11px;">Name</th>
          {% for s in attendance_statuses %}
          <th style="text-align:center; padding:8px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; font-size:11px;">{{ s }}</th>
          {% endfor %}
          <th style="text-align:center; padding:8px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; font-size:11px;">Geofence Breaches</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {% for t in totals %}
        <tr style="border-top:1px solid var(--line);">
          <td style="padding:8px;">{{ t.full_name or t.email }}</td>
          {% for s in attendance_statuses %}
          <td style="text-align:center; padding:8px;">{{ t[s] }}</td>
          {% endfor %}
          <td style="text-align:center; padding:8px;">{{ t.geofence_breaches }}</td>
        </tr>
        {% endfor %}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>

{% if not totals %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <p>No employees to show.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% if calendar_weeks %}
<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ calendar_user_name }}'s Calendar — {{ month_names[month] }} {{ year }}</strong>

  <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:14px; font-size:13px;">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        {% for wd in ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'] %}
        <th style="padding:6px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:600; font-size:12px;">{{ wd }}</th>
        {% endfor %}
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for week in calendar_weeks %}
      <tr>
        {% for day in week %}
        {% if day == 0 %}
        <td style="padding:6px;"></td>
        {% else %}
        {% set date_str = '%04d-%02d-%02d'|format(year, month, day) %}
        {% set row = calendar_month_data[date_str] if date_str in calendar_month_data else none %}
        <td style="padding:6px; text-align:center; border-radius:6px;
          {% if row and row.status == 'present' %}background:#E3F5E9;
          {% elif row and row.status == 'late' %}background:#FCEFD8;
          {% elif row and row.status == 'absent' %}background:#FBE3E3;
          {% elif row and row.status == 'weekoff' %}background:#EDEDED;
          {% elif row and row.status == 'leave' %}background:#E9E3F7;
          {% elif date_str in holidays %}background:#FDE9D9;
          {% endif %}
          {% if row and (row.login_geofence_breach or row.logout_geofence_breach) %}border:2px solid #FF8C00;{% endif %}">
          {{ day }}
        </td>
        {% endif %}
        {% endfor %}
      </tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div style="display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:12px; font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft);">
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#E3F5E9; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Present</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#FCEFD8; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Late</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#FBE3E3; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Absent</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#EDEDED; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Weekoff</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#E9E3F7; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Leave</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#FDE9D9; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Holiday</span>
    <span><span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; border:2px solid #FF8C00; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;"></span> Geofence breach</span>
  </div>
</div>
{% elif is_oversight %}
<p class="no-print" style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:12px;">
  Select one employee from the filter above to see their day-by-day calendar.
</p>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_attendance_holidays.html
```html
{# settings_attendance_holidays.html (v0.28) — admin Settings > Attendance
   > Holidays. Same "single add form + list with a delete button per row"
   CRUD pattern as settings_projects.html. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Holidays{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance') }}" style="font-size:14px;">&larr; Back to Attendance</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Holidays</h2>

<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px; max-width:480px;">
  <strong style="font-size:15px;">Add / update a holiday</strong>
  <form method="post" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; margin-top:10px;">
    <input type="date" name="holiday_date" required>
    <input type="text" name="label" placeholder="Label (e.g. Diwali)">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="align-self:flex-start;">Save</button>
  </form>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:16px; max-width:480px;">
  {% for h in holidays %}
  <div class="card" style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
    <div>
      <strong style="font-size:14px;">{{ h.holiday_date }}</strong>
      <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">{{ h.label or '(no label)' }}</div>
    </div>
    <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_attendance_holiday_delete', holiday_date=h.holiday_date) }}"
          onsubmit="return confirm('Remove the {{ h.holiday_date }} holiday?');">
      <button type="submit" class="btn" style="color:var(--red); border-color:#F3C9C9; padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Remove</button>
    </form>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>

{% if not holidays %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="max-width:480px; margin-top:16px;">
  <p>No holidays configured yet.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_attendance_projects.html
```html
{# settings_attendance_projects.html (v0.28) — admin Settings >
   Attendance > Project GPS & Geofence. One form per project bucket
   (sourced from cls_db.get_all_bucket_names(), same source as every
   other project dropdown in this app), each pre-filled with its
   current lat/long/radius if already configured. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Project GPS &amp; Geofence{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance') }}" style="font-size:14px;">&larr; Back to Attendance</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Project GPS &amp; Geofence</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:600px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Punches aren't blocked outside the radius — a breach is only flagged (red marker) for review.
</p>

<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap:14px; margin-top:16px;">
  {% for p in projects %}
  {% set loc = locations.get(p) %}
  <div class="card">
    <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ p }}</strong>
    <form method="post" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; margin-top:10px;">
      <input type="hidden" name="project_bucket" value="{{ p }}">
      <label style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft);">Latitude</label>
      <input type="number" step="any" name="latitude" value="{{ loc.latitude if loc else '' }}" style="width:100%;">
      <label style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft);">Longitude</label>
      <input type="number" step="any" name="longitude" value="{{ loc.longitude if loc else '' }}" style="width:100%;">
      <label style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft);">Radius (meters)</label>
      <input type="number" step="1" name="radius_meters" value="{{ loc.radius_meters if loc else 1500 }}" style="width:100%;">
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="align-self:flex-start; margin-top:4px;">Save</button>
    </form>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>

{% if not projects %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <p>No projects configured yet — add one from Settings &gt; Projects first.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_attendance_today.html
```html
{# settings_attendance_today.html (v1) — APX Attendance Chunk C.
   Admin-only "who's present today" view (app.py v0.37's
   settings_attendance_today(), @admin_required). Every ACTIVE
   employee, one row each, showing their ACTUAL status for today —
   not a binary present/not-present. status is the raw attendance.
   status value (present/late/absent/weekoff/leave/half_day) when a
   row exists; when none exists yet (nothing punched, no self-service
   status set), not_marked is True and this template shows "Not
   marked yet" instead of guessing/labeling it absent — those mean
   different things (hasn't acted yet vs. a recorded absence). #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Who's Present Today{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_attendance') }}" style="font-size:14px;">&larr; Back to Attendance</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Who's Present Today — {{ today }}</h2>

<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:16px;">
  {% for row in overview %}
  <div class="card">
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
      <div>
        <strong style="font-size:14px;">{{ row.full_name or row.email }}</strong>
        {% if row.not_marked %}
        <span class="badge" style="background:var(--ink-soft); margin-left:6px;">Not marked yet</span>
        {% else %}
        <span class="badge" style="background:
          {% if row.status == 'present' %}var(--green)
          {% elif row.status == 'late' %}var(--amber)
          {% elif row.status == 'absent' %}var(--red)
          {% elif row.status == 'leave' %}#7C5CBF
          {% elif row.status == 'weekoff' %}var(--ink-soft)
          {% elif row.status == 'half_day' %}var(--blue)
          {% else %}var(--ink-soft){% endif %}; margin-left:6px;">{{ row.status.replace('_', ' ')|title }}</span>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">
        {% if row.login_ts %}In: {{ row.login_ts|ampm }}{% endif %}
        {% if row.login_geofence_breach %}<span class="badge" style="background:var(--red); margin-left:4px;">Geofence</span>{% endif %}
        {% if row.logout_ts %} &middot; Out: {{ row.logout_ts|ampm }}{% endif %}
        {% if row.logout_geofence_breach %}<span class="badge" style="background:var(--red); margin-left:4px;">Geofence</span>{% endif %}
        {% if row.late_minutes %} &middot; {{ row.late_minutes }} min late{% endif %}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
  {% if not overview %}
  <div class="card empty-state"><p>No active employees.</p></div>
  {% endif %}
</div>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_bulk_jobs.html
```html
{# settings_bulk_jobs.html (v1.1) — Settings > Bulk Reassign > Past Bulk
   Jobs. Plain table, no charts — cls_db.get_bulk_jobs() (bulk_jobs
   table, cls_db.py v2.28), newest first. filters_summary is already a
   short human-readable string (built by app.py's
   _bulk_filters_summary()), so this just prints it — no second
   renderer for a filter-object shape. job_type is shown as a badge in
   case a future bulk action besides bulk_reassign starts writing to
   this same table (BULK_JOB_TYPES is written generically for that).

   v1.1 (2026-08-11) — Phase 5: NEW "Export" column, one download link
   per row to app.py's new /settings/bulk-jobs/<job_id>/export.xlsx —
   only rendered as a link when job.leads_snapshot_count > 0 (cls_db.py
   v2.53's get_bulk_jobs() now carries that count via LEFT JOIN). Jobs
   run before the bulk_job_leads migration existed have a count of 0,
   so they show plain text instead of a broken/empty-file link. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Bulk Jobs{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_bulk_reassign') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Bulk Reassign</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px; margin-bottom:14px;">Past Bulk Jobs</h2>

{% if jobs %}
<div class="report-table-wrap" style="overflow-x:auto;">
  <table class="report-table" style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">When</th>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">Type</th>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">By</th>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">Filters</th>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">Leads</th>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase;">Export</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for job in jobs %}
      <tr>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px; white-space:nowrap;">{{ job.created_at }}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;"><span class="badge" style="background:var(--gray);">{{ job.job_type }}</span></td>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;">{{ job.actor }}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;">{{ job.filters_summary }}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;">{{ job.lead_count }}</td>
        <td style="padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px;">
          {% if job.leads_snapshot_count %}
          <a href="{{ url_for('settings_bulk_job_export_excel', job_id=job.job_id) }}" class="btn" style="font-size:12px; padding:4px 10px;">Download</a>
          {% else %}
          <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:12px;">Not available for jobs before this date</span>
          {% endif %}
        </td>
      </tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p>No bulk jobs run yet.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_campaign_routing.html
```html
{# settings_campaign_routing.html (v1) — admin Settings > Campaign
   Routing. Fallback owner + CRUD for campaign_routing_rules
   (cls_db.py v2.25). "Single" picks one fixed owner for every new lead
   on a campaign; "Round Robin" cycles through 2+ owners in order. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Campaign Routing{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to Settings</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Campaign Routing</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:600px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Decides who a brand-new Meta lead is assigned to at insert time, before Sell.do syncs
  the real "Attended By". Only applies to genuinely new leads (Job A).
</p>

{# ── Fallback owner ── #}
<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px; max-width:480px;">
  <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Fallback owner</h3>
  <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:-4px;">
    If a lead's campaign has no rule configured, or the campaign is blank, assign it to:
  </p>
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_campaign_routing_fallback') }}" style="display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
    <select name="fallback_owner" style="flex:1; min-width:180px;">
      {% for u in owner_choices %}
      <option value="{{ u.owner_match_name }}" {{ 'selected' if u.owner_match_name == fallback_owner }}>{{ u.full_name or u.owner_match_name }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
      {% if fallback_owner and fallback_owner not in owner_choices|map(attribute='owner_match_name')|list %}
      <option value="{{ fallback_owner }}" selected>{{ fallback_owner }} (not an active user)</option>
      {% endif %}
    </select>
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Save</button>
  </form>
</div>

{# ── Add / edit rule ── #}
<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px; max-width:560px;">
  <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">{{ 'Edit rule' if edit_rule else 'Add a routing rule' }}</h3>
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_campaign_routing_save') }}">
    <div class="field-label">Campaign name *</div>
    {% if edit_rule %}
    <input type="text" name="campaign_name" required readonly
           value="{{ edit_rule.campaign_name }}"
           style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px; background:var(--paper);">
    {% else %}
    <input type="text" name="campaign_name" required
           placeholder="e.g. Camp5_Naishka_08-05-2026"
           style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">
    {% endif %}

    <div class="field-label">Rule type *</div>
    <div style="display:flex; gap:16px; margin-bottom:14px;">
      <label style="font-size:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
        <input type="radio" name="rule_type" value="single" id="ruleTypeSingle"
               {{ 'checked' if not edit_rule or edit_rule.rule_type == 'single' }} onchange="toggleRuleType()"> Single
      </label>
      <label style="font-size:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
        <input type="radio" name="rule_type" value="round_robin" id="ruleTypeRR"
               {{ 'checked' if edit_rule and edit_rule.rule_type == 'round_robin' }} onchange="toggleRuleType()"> Round Robin
      </label>
    </div>

    <div class="field-label">Owner(s) *</div>
    <div id="ownerRows" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
      {% if edit_rule and edit_rule.owners %}
        {% for o in edit_rule.owners %}
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
          <select name="owners" style="flex:1;">
            {% for u in owner_choices %}
            <option value="{{ u.owner_match_name }}" {{ 'selected' if u.owner_match_name == o }}>{{ u.full_name or u.owner_match_name }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
          </select>
          <button type="button" class="btn owner-row-remove" onclick="removeOwnerRow(this)" style="padding:5px 10px;">×</button>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
      {% else %}
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
          <select name="owners" style="flex:1;">
            {% for u in owner_choices %}
            <option value="{{ u.owner_match_name }}">{{ u.full_name or u.owner_match_name }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
          </select>
          <button type="button" class="btn owner-row-remove" onclick="removeOwnerRow(this)" style="padding:5px 10px;">×</button>
        </div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="btn" id="addOwnerBtn" onclick="addOwnerRow()" style="margin-top:8px; padding:5px 12px; font-size:13px;">+ Add owner</button>

    <div style="margin-top:16px;">
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{ 'Save changes' if edit_rule else 'Add rule' }}</button>
      {% if edit_rule %}
      <a href="{{ url_for('settings_campaign_routing') }}" class="btn" style="margin-left:8px;">Cancel</a>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </form>
</div>

{# ── Existing rules ── #}
<h3 style="margin-top:24px; font-size:16px;">Existing rules ({{ rules|length }})</h3>
{% if rules %}
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;">
  {% for r in rules %}
  <div class="card">
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <div>
        <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ r.campaign_name }}</strong>
        <span class="badge" style="background:{{ 'var(--blue)' if r.rule_type == 'single' else '#7C5CBF' }}; margin-left:6px;">
          {{ 'Single' if r.rule_type == 'single' else 'Round Robin' }}
        </span>
        {% if not r.active %}
        <span class="badge" style="background:var(--red); margin-left:6px;">Inactive</span>
        {% endif %}
        <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">{{ r.owners|join(', ') }}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
        <a href="{{ url_for('settings_campaign_routing', edit=r.campaign_name) }}" class="btn" style="padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Edit</a>
        <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_campaign_routing_toggle', campaign_name=r.campaign_name) }}">
          <input type="hidden" name="active" value="{{ '0' if r.active else '1' }}">
          <button type="submit" class="btn" style="padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">{{ 'Deactivate' if r.active else 'Activate' }}</button>
        </form>
        <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_campaign_routing_delete', campaign_name=r.campaign_name) }}"
              onsubmit="return confirm('Delete the routing rule for {{ r.campaign_name }}?');">
          <button type="submit" class="btn" style="color:var(--red); border-color:#F3C9C9; padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Delete</button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p>No routing rules yet. New leads use the fallback owner above.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

<script>
var ownerOptionsHtml = document.querySelector('#ownerRows select') ? document.querySelector('#ownerRows select').innerHTML : '';

function addOwnerRow() {
  var wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;';
  wrap.innerHTML = '<select name="owners" style="flex:1;">' + ownerOptionsHtml + '</select>' +
    '<button type="button" class="btn owner-row-remove" onclick="removeOwnerRow(this)" style="padding:5px 10px;">×</button>';
  document.getElementById('ownerRows').appendChild(wrap);
}

function removeOwnerRow(btn) {
  var rows = document.getElementById('ownerRows');
  if (rows.children.length > 1) {
    btn.parentElement.remove();
  }
}

function toggleRuleType() {
  var isSingle = document.getElementById('ruleTypeSingle').checked;
  var rows = document.getElementById('ownerRows');
  var addBtn = document.getElementById('addOwnerBtn');
  if (isSingle) {
    while (rows.children.length > 1) { rows.removeChild(rows.lastChild); }
    addBtn.style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    addBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
  }
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', toggleRuleType);
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_cross_reassign.html
```html
{# settings_cross_reassign.html (v1, 2026-08-31) — admin Settings >
   Cross-Reassign Rules. CRUD for cross_project_reassign_rules
   (cls_db.py v2.75/v2.77). Cloned from settings_campaign_routing.html's
   structure (list + add/edit form on one page, same card/badge/btn
   language) — adapted for a rule keyed on (source_bucket, target_
   bucket) instead of a single campaign_name, and with the active
   checkbox folded into the same add/edit form/upsert call instead of a
   separate toggle route. "Single" sends every matching lead's auto-
   reassignment to one fixed owner; "Round Robin" cycles through 2+
   owners in order. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Cross-Reassign Rules{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to Settings</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Cross-Reassign Rules</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:600px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Decides where a lead automatically goes when it's marked Lost or Unqualified on a
  project with a rule configured, and who picks it up on the new project. Fires at
  most ONCE per lead, ever — see cls_db.py's changelog on the permanent guard.
</p>

{# ── Add / edit rule ── #}
<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px; max-width:560px;">
  <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">{{ 'Edit rule' if edit_rule else 'Add a cross-reassign rule' }}</h3>
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_cross_reassign') }}">
    <div class="field-label">Source project *</div>
    {% if edit_rule %}
    <input type="text" name="source_bucket" required readonly
           value="{{ edit_rule.source_bucket }}"
           style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px; background:var(--paper);">
    {% else %}
    <select name="source_bucket" required style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">
      <option value="" disabled selected>Choose the project a lead is leaving…</option>
      {% for b in buckets %}
      <option value="{{ b }}">{{ b }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="field-label">Target project *</div>
    {% if edit_rule %}
    <input type="text" name="target_bucket" required readonly
           value="{{ edit_rule.target_bucket }}"
           style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px; background:var(--paper);">
    {% else %}
    <select name="target_bucket" required style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">
      <option value="" disabled selected>Choose the project a lead moves to…</option>
      {% for b in buckets %}
      <option value="{{ b }}">{{ b }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="field-label">Rule type *</div>
    <div style="display:flex; gap:16px; margin-bottom:14px;">
      <label style="font-size:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
        <input type="radio" name="rule_type" value="single" id="ruleTypeSingle"
               {{ 'checked' if not edit_rule or edit_rule.rule_type == 'single' }} onchange="toggleRuleType()"> Single
      </label>
      <label style="font-size:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
        <input type="radio" name="rule_type" value="round_robin" id="ruleTypeRR"
               {{ 'checked' if edit_rule and edit_rule.rule_type == 'round_robin' }} onchange="toggleRuleType()"> Round Robin
      </label>
    </div>

    <div class="field-label">Owner(s) *</div>
    <div id="ownerRows" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
      {% if edit_rule and edit_rule.owners %}
        {% for o in edit_rule.owners %}
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
          <select name="owners" style="flex:1;">
            {% for u in owner_choices %}
            <option value="{{ u.owner_match_name }}" {{ 'selected' if u.owner_match_name == o }}>{{ u.full_name or u.owner_match_name }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
          </select>
          <button type="button" class="btn owner-row-remove" onclick="removeOwnerRow(this)" style="padding:5px 10px;">×</button>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
      {% else %}
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
          <select name="owners" style="flex:1;">
            {% for u in owner_choices %}
            <option value="{{ u.owner_match_name }}">{{ u.full_name or u.owner_match_name }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
          </select>
          <button type="button" class="btn owner-row-remove" onclick="removeOwnerRow(this)" style="padding:5px 10px;">×</button>
        </div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="btn" id="addOwnerBtn" onclick="addOwnerRow()" style="margin-top:8px; padding:5px 12px; font-size:13px;">+ Add owner</button>

    <div style="margin-top:14px;">
      <label style="font-size:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
        <input type="checkbox" name="active" value="1" {{ 'checked' if not edit_rule or edit_rule.active }}> Active
      </label>
    </div>

    <div style="margin-top:16px;">
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{ 'Save changes' if edit_rule else 'Add rule' }}</button>
      {% if edit_rule %}
      <a href="{{ url_for('settings_cross_reassign') }}" class="btn" style="margin-left:8px;">Cancel</a>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </form>
</div>

{# ── Existing rules ── #}
<h3 style="margin-top:24px; font-size:16px;">Existing rules ({{ rules|length }})</h3>
{% if rules %}
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;">
  {% for r in rules %}
  <div class="card">
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <div>
        <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ r.source_bucket }} → {{ r.target_bucket }}</strong>
        <span class="badge" style="background:{{ 'var(--blue)' if r.rule_type == 'single' else '#7C5CBF' }}; margin-left:6px;">
          {{ 'Single' if r.rule_type == 'single' else 'Round Robin' }}
        </span>
        {% if not r.active %}
        <span class="badge" style="background:var(--red); margin-left:6px;">Inactive</span>
        {% endif %}
        <div style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;">{{ r.owners|join(', ') }}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
        <a href="{{ url_for('settings_cross_reassign', edit=r.id) }}" class="btn" style="padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Edit</a>
        <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_cross_reassign_delete', rule_id=r.id) }}"
              onsubmit="return confirm('Delete the rule {{ r.source_bucket }} → {{ r.target_bucket }}?');">
          <button type="submit" class="btn" style="color:var(--red); border-color:#F3C9C9; padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Delete</button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p>No cross-reassign rules yet. A Lost/Unqualified lead just stays on its current project.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

<script>
var ownerOptionsHtml = document.querySelector('#ownerRows select') ? document.querySelector('#ownerRows select').innerHTML : '';

function addOwnerRow() {
  var wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;';
  wrap.innerHTML = '<select name="owners" style="flex:1;">' + ownerOptionsHtml + '</select>' +
    '<button type="button" class="btn owner-row-remove" onclick="removeOwnerRow(this)" style="padding:5px 10px;">×</button>';
  document.getElementById('ownerRows').appendChild(wrap);
}

function removeOwnerRow(btn) {
  var rows = document.getElementById('ownerRows');
  if (rows.children.length > 1) {
    btn.parentElement.remove();
  }
}

function toggleRuleType() {
  var isSingle = document.getElementById('ruleTypeSingle').checked;
  var rows = document.getElementById('ownerRows');
  var addBtn = document.getElementById('addOwnerBtn');
  if (isSingle) {
    while (rows.children.length > 1) { rows.removeChild(rows.lastChild); }
    addBtn.style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    addBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
  }
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', toggleRuleType);
</script>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_lead_scoring.html
```html
{# settings_lead_scoring.html (v1) — admin Settings > Lead Scoring.
   Edits app_settings['lead_score_config'] (cls_db.py v2.26), which
   compute_lead_scores() reads fresh on every call — a save here takes
   effect immediately, no restart. Band labels (Cold/Warm/Hot) are
   fixed, not editable in this version — only their point thresholds
   (hot_threshold/warm_threshold) are. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Lead Scoring{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to Settings</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Lead Scoring</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:600px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Points behind each lead's score badge. A lead scoring at or above the Hot threshold
  shows Hot; at or above Warm (but below Hot) shows Warm; otherwise Cold.
</p>

<form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_lead_scoring') }}">

  <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Points per stage</h3>
    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap:12px;">
      {% for stage in all_stages %}
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">{{ stage }}</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="stage_{{ stage }}" value="{{ config.stage_points[stage] }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Opportunity temperature bonus</h3>
    <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:-4px;">Only applied when current stage is Opportunity.</p>
    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap:12px;">
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Warm</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="temp_warm" value="{{ config.temperature_points.Warm }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Hot</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="temp_hot" value="{{ config.temperature_points.Hot }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Activity points</h3>
    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap:12px;">
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Site visit conducted</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="site_visit_conducted" value="{{ config.site_visit_conducted }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Site visit no-show</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="site_visit_no_show" value="{{ config.site_visit_no_show }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Follow-up completed</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="follow_up_completed" value="{{ config.follow_up_completed }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Note, per day</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="note_points_per_day" value="{{ config.note_points_per_day }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Call tap, per day</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="call_tap_points_per_day" value="{{ config.call_tap_points_per_day }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Staleness decay</h3>
    <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:-4px;">
      A lead loses points for sitting untouched, unless its current stage is exempt below.
    </p>
    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap:12px;">
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Decay after (days)</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="decay_after_days" value="{{ config.decay_after_days }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Points per period</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="decay_points_per_period" value="{{ config.decay_points_per_period }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:12px;">
      <div class="field-label">Exempt stages (ctrl/cmd-click to select multiple)</div>
      <select name="decay_exempt_stages" multiple style="width:100%; min-height:140px;">
        {% for stage in all_stages %}
        <option value="{{ stage }}" {{ 'selected' if stage in config.decay_exempt_stages }}>{{ stage }}</option>
        {% endfor %}
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Band thresholds</h3>
    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap:12px;">
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Hot threshold (score ≥)</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="hot_threshold" value="{{ config.hot_threshold }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">Warm threshold (score ≥)</div>
        <input type="number" step="any" name="warm_threshold" value="{{ config.warm_threshold }}" required style="width:100%;">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="margin-top:16px;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Save</button>
  </div>
</form>
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_projects.html
```html
{# settings_projects.html (v1) — admin Settings > Projects. CRUD for the
   project_aliases table (cls_db.py v2.24). One form handles both "add
   an alias to an existing bucket" and "create a brand-new bucket" —
   a brand-new bucket is just an alias whose project_bucket equals
   itself, per cls_db.add_project_alias()'s docstring. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Projects{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to Settings</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Projects</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:600px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Sell.do exports store project names with spelling/spacing variation. Each alias below
  maps one raw name onto the single "bucket" name it displays under across the CRM,
  dashboard, and reports. To add a brand-new project, add it below with the alias and
  bucket name set the same.
</p>

<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Add alias / new project</h3>
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_projects') }}">
    <div style="display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <div style="flex:1; min-width:200px;">
        <div class="field-label">Alias (raw name as it appears in Sell.do) *</div>
        <input type="text" name="alias" required placeholder="e.g. Naishka Prism" style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div style="flex:1; min-width:200px;">
        <div class="field-label">Project bucket (display name) *</div>
        <input list="bucketList" type="text" name="project_bucket" required placeholder="e.g. Naishka Homes" style="width:100%;">
        <datalist id="bucketList">
          {% for b in buckets %}<option value="{{ b.bucket }}">{% endfor %}
        </datalist>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:12px;">
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Save</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</div>

<h3 style="margin-top:24px; font-size:16px;">Existing buckets ({{ buckets|length }})</h3>
{% if buckets %}
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;">
  {% for b in buckets %}
  <div class="card">
    <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ b.bucket }}</strong>
    <div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin-top:10px;">
      {% for a in b.aliases %}
      <span class="badge" style="background:var(--ink-soft); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 6px 4px 10px;">
        {{ a }}
        <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_project_alias_delete', alias=a) }}"
              onsubmit="return confirm('Remove alias {{ a }} from {{ b.bucket }}?');" style="display:inline;">
          <button type="submit" aria-label="Delete alias" style="background:none; border:none; color:#fff; cursor:pointer; padding:0; font-size:13px; line-height:1;">×</button>
        </form>
      </span>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>
{% else %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p>No project aliases yet.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_telephony.html
```html
{# settings_telephony.html (v3) — Settings > Telephony (Phase B). Two
   independent forms, deliberately not nested (HTML disallows nested
   <form> tags): the top form saves every user's recording-folder path in
   one Save click (settings_lead_scoring.html's "one input per item, one
   Save button" pattern). The per-user "Generate Token" buttons below are
   each their own small form (settings_users.html's per-row-form pattern)
   so saving paths can never accidentally regenerate someone's token.
   Placeholder folder patterns are examples only — an admin types the
   actual path for that salesperson's phone.

   v2 — NEW "View Synced Recordings →" link to the new
   settings_telephony_recordings.html report page.

   v3 — self-scoped access (app.py v0.27's settings_telephony() route).
   `users`/`company_wide` are now the same shape either way — the
   template just iterates whatever list the route hands it (a
   salesperson's `users` list has exactly one row: their own) — so no
   structural change was needed here, only this conditional intro line
   so the page doesn't read like a stray admin page to a salesperson.

   v4 — label-only fix: this token was originally issued for the 2
   Telephony endpoints only, but as of cls_db.py v2.42 the SAME token
   also authorizes the 4 /api/attendance/* endpoints (Build Order Step
   4) — "API tokens" was no longer accurate. Renamed to "Mobile App API
   Token" and reworded the description + regenerate-confirm text below
   to say what it actually gates today. No functional change — same
   route, same generate_api_token()/verify_api_token(), same one
   token per user.

   v5 (2026-08-07) — Option C self-service token-sync redesign
   (app.py v0.38 / cls_db.py v2.47). Manual "Generate Token" (which
   showed the raw value for an admin to relay by voice — the flow
   that caused this morning's two failures) is retired. The per-row
   button is now "Revoke Token", an admin kill-switch only — it posts
   to the renamed settings_telephony_revoke_token route and shows no
   token value, since none is generated here anymore. Employees get
   their own token via the app's new "Sync my token" button instead.
   "View Synced Recordings →" changed from a plain text link to a
   styled button — same destination, no functional change. Recording
   folder paths above are UNCHANGED — confirmed load-bearing
   (MainActivity.kt's findRecordingFileNear() scopes MediaStore
   search with it), left exactly as before. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Telephony{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to Settings</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Telephony</h2>
{% if company_wide %}
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:640px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Phase B pilot config: where each salesperson's phone stores call recordings, and the
  bearer token their app uses to report call-log data. Recordings are only ever fetched
  for calls matching an existing lead — see TELEPHONY_RECORDING_POLICY.md.
</p>
{% else %}
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:640px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Your recording folder path and API token — used by your phone's sync app. Recordings
  are only ever fetched for calls matching an existing lead — see
  TELEPHONY_RECORDING_POLICY.md.
</p>
{% endif %}
<p style="margin-top:8px;">
  <a href="{{ url_for('settings_telephony_recordings') }}" class="btn" style="text-decoration:none; display:inline-block;">View Synced Recordings →</a>
</p>

<form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_telephony') }}">
  <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Recording folder paths</h3>
    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;">
      {% for u in users %}
      <div>
        <div class="field-label">
          {{ u.full_name or u.email }}
          <span class="badge" style="background:{{ 'var(--blue)' if u.role == 'admin' else ('#7C5CBF' if u.role == 'manager' else 'var(--ink-soft)') }}; margin-left:6px;">
            {{ u.role or 'salesperson' }}
          </span>
        </div>
        <input type="text" name="path_{{ u.user_id }}" value="{{ u.recording_folder_path }}"
               placeholder="Music/Recordings/Call Recordings/" style="width:100%;">
      </div>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="margin-top:16px;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Save</button>
  </div>
</form>

<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <h3 style="margin-top:0; font-size:16px;">Mobile App API Token</h3>
  <p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:-4px;">
    One token per person, used by the Asian Properties CRM mobile app for BOTH
    call-recording sync and Attendance punch-in/out. Employees get their own token
    by tapping "Sync my token" in the app — nothing to generate or relay here.
    "Revoke Token" is a kill-switch for a lost phone or departing employee: it
    immediately stops that user's current token from working, for BOTH Telephony
    sync and Attendance punch-in/out, until they sync a new one in the app.
  </p>
  <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:10px;">
    {% for u in users %}
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom:10px;">
      <span style="font-size:14px;">{{ u.full_name or u.email }}</span>
      <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_telephony_revoke_token', user_id=u.user_id) }}"
            onsubmit="return confirm('Revoke the app API token for {{ u.full_name or u.email }}? Their current token will stop working immediately, for BOTH Telephony sync and Attendance punch-in/out, until they tap \'Sync my token\' in the app again.');">
        <button type="submit" class="btn" style="padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Revoke Token</button>
      </form>
    </div>
    {% endfor %}
  </div>
</div>

{% if not users %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p>No users found.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_telephony_recordings.html
```html
{# settings_telephony_recordings.html (v3) — Settings > Telephony >
   Synced Recordings. Filtered/paginated table of every call_recording
   activity_log row, with inline playback and per-row delete.

   Patterns reused rather than invented: date-preset quick-select mirrors
   _report_date_picker.html's auto-submit-unless-Custom behavior (app.py's
   own DATE_PRESETS dict, not cls_reports.py's separate copy — established
   convention, see _parse_bulk_filters()'s docstring in app.py); table
   markup + .report-table/.report-table-wrap styling copied from
   report_view.html/bulk_reassign_preview.html (these classes live locally
   in report_view.html, not base.html); pagination copied from
   leads_list.html's Page X of Y / Prev/Next pattern; <audio> player copied
   from lead_detail.html's call_recording timeline branch, unchanged; the
   Delete button's confirm() matches settings_users.html's Deactivate
   button style. Row actions are plain inline buttons (View Lead + Delete)
   — no dropdown/kebab menu, confirmed with Srikanth: nothing like that
   exists anywhere else in this codebase.

   v2 — Delete now requires TWO sequential confirm() dialogs (chained via
   && so the second only fires if the first is accepted, and the form
   only submits if both are) — Srikanth's explicit ask for extra
   friction before a permanent, unrecoverable delete. No new JS function
   needed; same plain inline onsubmit style as every other confirm-guarded
   action in this codebase.

   v3 — four changes:
   1. Self-scoped access (app.py v0.27's settings_telephony_recordings()
      route). NEW `company_wide` boolean (matching dashboard_
      booking_summary.html's existing naming, per Srikanth's request)
      wraps the Lead owner / Activity owner filter <select> blocks —
      redundant for a salesperson since every row they're shown is
      already their own (server-side force-scoped, this template never
      re-derives that).
   2. Filter row changed from flex-wrap (uneven wrapping at real screen
      widths) to a CSS grid (repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr))) so
      every filter box gets a consistent width and lines up in neat
      rows. Apply/Clear moved to their own row below, no longer
      stretched to filter-box width.
   3. Delete <form> (whole cell, not just the button) is now wrapped in
      {% raw %}{% if current_user.role == 'admin' %}{% endraw %} — a
      salesperson's/manager's Actions column shows ONLY "View Lead".
      Admin-only (not WRITE_ANYWHERE_ROLES/managers), matching the
      stricter precedent Bulk Reassign already set for destructive-at-
      scale actions — confirmed assumption, flag back if managers should
      also get Delete. Server-side settings_telephony_recording_delete()
      KEEPS its unchanged @admin_required decorator regardless — this is
      defense in depth, not the only gate.
   4. Lead # is now also a link to the same lead_detail destination
      "View Lead" already uses (additive — View Lead button unchanged).
      Recording column's <audio> width raised from max-width:220px
      (collapsed the native player to a play-button-only control at
      that width) to min-width:280px/width:320px so the native scrubber
      and time display render fully; the table already scrolls
      horizontally (.report-table-wrap), so this is safe on narrow
      screens. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Synced Recordings{% endblock %}

{% block head %}
<style>
  .report-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 14px; }
  .report-table th, .report-table td {
    text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .report-table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .report-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--paper); }
  .report-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_telephony') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to Telephony</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">
  Synced Recordings
  <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:400; font-size:16px;">({{ result.total }})</span>
</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:640px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Every call recording synced from a salesperson's phone. Play back, review, or remove a
  wrong entry — deleting here removes both the activity log entry and the recording file.
</p>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('settings_telephony_recordings') }}" id="recordingsFilterForm"
      class="card" style="margin-top:16px;">

  <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap:10px;">

    <div>
      <div class="field-label">Date range</div>
      <select name="date_preset" id="datePresetSelect" onchange="onRecordingsDatePresetChange(this)"
              style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px; width:100%;">
        <option value="" {% if not filters.date_preset %}selected{% endif %}>— All time —</option>
        {% for key in date_preset_order %}
        <option value="{{ key }}" {% if filters.date_preset == key %}selected{% endif %}>{{ date_preset_labels[key] }}</option>
        {% endfor %}
      </select>
    </div>
    <div id="customRecordingsDateFields"
         style="display:{{ 'flex' if filters.date_preset == 'custom' else 'none' }}; gap:6px; align-items:flex-end;">
      <div style="flex:1;">
        <div class="field-label">From</div>
        <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ filters.date_from }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px; width:100%;">
      </div>
      <div style="flex:1;">
        <div class="field-label">To</div>
        <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ filters.date_to }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px; width:100%;">
      </div>
    </div>

    <div>
      <div class="field-label">Call status</div>
      <select name="call_status" onchange="this.form.submit()" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px; width:100%;">
        <option value="" {% if not filters.call_status %}selected{% endif %}>All</option>
        <option value="answered" {% if filters.call_status == 'answered' %}selected{% endif %}>Answered</option>
        <option value="missed" {% if filters.call_status == 'missed' %}selected{% endif %}>Missed</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    {% if company_wide %}
    <div>
      <div class="field-label">Lead owner</div>
      <select name="lead_owner" onchange="this.form.submit()" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px; width:100%;">
        <option value="">All</option>
        {% for o in lead_owner_options %}
        <option value="{{ o }}" {% if filters.lead_owner == o %}selected{% endif %}>{{ o }}</option>
        {% endfor %}
      </select>
    </div>

    <div>
      <div class="field-label">Activity owner (who synced it)</div>
      <select name="activity_owner" onchange="this.form.submit()" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px; width:100%;">
        <option value="">All</option>
        {% for u in activity_owner_options %}
        <option value="{{ u.email }}" {% if filters.activity_owner == u.email %}selected{% endif %}>{{ u.full_name or u.email }}</option>
        {% endfor %}
      </select>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div>
      <div class="field-label">Lead name</div>
      <input type="text" name="search" value="{{ filters.search }}" placeholder="Search…" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px; width:100%;">
    </div>

  </div>

  <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:12px;">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="height:34px; padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Apply</button>
    {% set has_active_filter = filters.date_preset or filters.call_status or filters.search
        or (company_wide and (filters.lead_owner or filters.activity_owner)) %}
    {% if has_active_filter %}
    <a href="{{ url_for('settings_telephony_recordings') }}" class="btn" style="height:34px; padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Clear</a>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</form>

<script>
function onRecordingsDatePresetChange(sel){
  var customBox = document.getElementById('customRecordingsDateFields');
  if (sel.value === 'custom') {
    customBox.style.display = 'flex';
    return;
  }
  customBox.style.display = 'none';
  if (sel.value !== '') {
    sel.form.submit();
  }
}
</script>

<div class="report-table-wrap">
  <table class="report-table">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Lead #</th>
        <th>Lead Name</th>
        <th>Call Status</th>
        <th>Duration</th>
        <th>Activity Owner</th>
        <th>Lead Owner</th>
        <th>Date &amp; Time</th>
        <th>Recording</th>
        <th>Actions</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {% for r in result.rows %}
      <tr>
        <td><a href="{{ url_for('lead_detail', cls_id=r.cls_id) }}">#{{ r.crm_lead_no or '—' }}</a></td>
        <td>{{ r.full_name or '(no name)' }}</td>
        <td>
          {% if r.duration_seconds == 0 %}
          <span class="badge" style="background:var(--red);">Missed/Unanswered</span>
          {% else %}
          <span class="badge" style="background:var(--green);">Answered</span>
          {% endif %}
        </td>
        <td>{{ (r.duration_seconds // 60) }}:{{ '%02d'|format(r.duration_seconds % 60) }}</td>
        <td>{{ r.actor_name }}</td>
        <td>{{ r.lead_owner or '—' }}</td>
        <td>{{ r.created_at }}</td>
        <td>
          {% if r.file_exists %}
          <audio controls preload="none" style="display:block; min-width:280px; width:320px;">
            <source src="{{ url_for('serve_recording', lead_id=r.cls_id, filename=r.recording_file_path) }}" type="audio/mpeg">
          </audio>
          {% else %}
          <span style="color:var(--red); font-size:12px;">File missing</span>
          {% endif %}
        </td>
        <td>
          <div style="display:flex; gap:6px;">
            <a href="{{ url_for('lead_detail', cls_id=r.cls_id) }}" class="btn" style="padding:4px 10px; font-size:12px;">View Lead</a>
            {% if current_user.role == 'admin' %}
            <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_telephony_recording_delete', activity_id=r.activity_id) }}"
                  onsubmit="return confirm('Permanently delete this recording and its activity log entry for {{ r.full_name or r.cls_id }}? This cannot be undone.') && confirm('Are you absolutely sure? The recording file and its activity log entry will be permanently removed — this cannot be recovered.');">
              <button type="submit" class="btn" style="color:var(--red); border-color:#F3C9C9; padding:4px 10px; font-size:12px;">Delete</button>
            </form>
            {% endif %}
          </div>
        </td>
      </tr>
      {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>

{% if not result.rows %}
<div class="card empty-state" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <p>No synced recordings match these filters.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% if result.total_pages > 1 %}
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:10px; margin-top:16px; align-items:center;">
  {% set base_args = filters.copy() %}
  {% if result.page > 1 %}
    <a class="btn" href="{{ url_for('settings_telephony_recordings', page=result.page-1, **base_args) }}">← Previous</a>
  {% endif %}
  <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px;">Page {{ result.page }} of {{ result.total_pages }}</span>
  {% if result.page < result.total_pages %}
    <a class="btn" href="{{ url_for('settings_telephony_recordings', page=result.page+1, **base_args) }}">Next →</a>
  {% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_user_activity.html
```html
{# settings_user_activity.html (v0.12) — admin Settings > User Activity
   Log. Full session-level audit trail: one card per login session,
   chronological "Logged in" -> actions -> "Logged out"/"Still active",
   sourced from cls_db.get_user_timeline(). Optional filters (user +
   date range) are plain GET querystring params, same no-JS-state
   pattern as leads_filter.html/the reports date picker — "Custom"
   dates always shown since this screen has no quick-preset dropdown,
   just From/To (simpler than reusing _report_date_picker.html, which
   is coupled to cls_reports.py's `report` object). Admin-only — linked
   only from settings.html's tile, never from base.html's nav drawer. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}User Activity Log{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_home') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to Settings</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">User Activity Log</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:600px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Every logged-in session and the actions taken during it. Admin-only.
</p>

<form method="get" action="{{ url_for('settings_user_activity') }}"
      style="margin-top:16px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
  <select name="user_id" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;">
    <option value="">All users</option>
    {% for u in users %}
    <option value="{{ u.user_id }}" {% if selected_user_id == u.user_id %}selected{% endif %}>
      {{ u.full_name or u.email }}
    </option>
    {% endfor %}
  </select>
  <input type="date" name="date_from" value="{{ date_from }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;" aria-label="From date">
  <span style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);">to</span>
  <input type="date" name="date_to" value="{{ date_to }}" style="height:34px; font-size:13px; padding:4px 8px;" aria-label="To date">
  <button type="submit" class="btn" style="padding:5px 14px; font-size:13px;">Apply</button>
</form>

<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; margin-top:16px;">
  {% for s in timeline %}
  <div class="card">
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;">
      <strong style="font-size:15px;">{{ s.actor }}</strong>
      {% if not s.logout_at %}
      <span class="badge" style="background:var(--green);">Still active</span>
      {% elif s.logout_reason == 'superseded' %}
      <span class="badge" style="background:var(--ink-soft);">Superseded</span>
      {% else %}
      <span class="badge" style="background:var(--ink-soft);">Ended</span>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    <ul style="list-style:none; padding:0; margin:10px 0 0; font-size:13px;">
      {% for ev in s.events %}
      <li style="padding:5px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--border, #EEE); display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px;">
        <span>
          {{ ev.label }}
          {% if ev.type == 'action' and ev.cls_id %}
          <span style="color:var(--ink-soft);">— lead {{ ev.cls_id }}</span>
          {% endif %}
          {% if ev.type == 'login' and ev.ip_address %}
          <span style="color:var(--ink-soft);">({{ ev.ip_address }})</span>
          {% endif %}
        </span>
        <span style="color:var(--ink-soft); white-space:nowrap;">{{ ev.at|ampm if ev.at else '' }}</span>
      </li>
      {% endfor %}
    </ul>
  </div>
  {% endfor %}
</div>

{% if not timeline %}
<div class="card empty-state">
  <p>No activity in this range.</p>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

```


## FILE: crm/templates/settings_user_new.html
```html
{# settings_user_new.html (v1) — admin Settings > Team > Add User. Form
   wrapper around cls_db.create_user(). owner_match_name is shown/required
   only for salesperson/manager roles, mirroring create_admin.py v1.3's
   terminal-prompt logic exactly: admins see/write everything and need
   nothing extra; managers are "player-coach" roles that carry their own
   leads too, so they need the Sell.do "Attended By" link just like a
   salesperson does. #}
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}Add User{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<a href="{{ url_for('settings_users') }}" style="font-size:14px;">← Back to Team</a>
<h2 style="margin-top:10px;">Add User</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:600px; margin-top:-6px;">
  Creates a new CRM login. The person can sign in immediately with the email and
  password below.
</p>

<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px; max-width:480px;">
  <form method="post" action="{{ url_for('settings_user_new') }}">
    <div class="field-label">Full name</div>
    <input type="text" name="full_name" value="{{ form.full_name }}" placeholder="e.g. Elohar Peddi" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">

    <div class="field-label">Email (login id) *</div>
    <input type="email" name="email" value="{{ form.email }}" required style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;">

    <div class="field-label">Password *</div>
    <input type="password" name="password" required minlength="8" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:4px;">
    <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:14px;">At least 8 characters.</div>

    <div class="field-label">Role *</div>
    <select name="role" id="roleSelect" required style="width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;" onchange="toggleOwnerField()">
      {% for r in roles %}
      <option value="{{ r }}" {{ 'selected' if form.role == r }}>{{ r }}</option>
      {% endfor %}
    </select>

    <div id="ownerFieldWrap" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      <div class="field-label">Owner name (Sell.do "Attended By" text) *</div>
      <input type="text" name="owner_match_name" id="ownerField" value="{{ form.owner_match_name }}" placeholder="e.g. Elohar Peddi" style="width:100%;">
      <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;" id="ownerFieldHint">
        Open Sell.do, find one of their leads, and copy the exact "Attended By" text.
        Matching is case-insensitive, but spelling must be exact otherwise.
      </div>
    </div>

    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Create login</button>
```
